source: Christian Harp — 640 hymns (Portuguese original with English translation overlay)

hymns.title: Showers of Blessing
stanzas: God has surely promised
To send showers of blessing;
He gives us strength and courage,
And rich blessings without measure.
Christ has granted us
The holy Comforter,
Filling us with perfect peace,
For the reign of love.
Give us, Lord, abundantly
Your great joy and power;
A lasting fountain of love,
Place within our being.
Make Your servants devout,
Give them virtue and courage,
Granting Your precious gifts,
From the holy Teacher.
chorus: Showers of blessing,
Showers we ask of You, Lord;
Send us constant showers,
Showers of the Comforter.

hymns.title: Longing Memory
stanzas: Oh! what a fond memory
I have you, O Zion,
Land that I love so much,
Because you are from my heart.
I will fly to you,
When my Lord returns;
For He went to heaven,
And he'll come get me soon.
Beautiful, very beautiful, is hope,
Of those who watch over you,
For they receive strength,
Which is only found there;
Those who seek to reach
In your lap, O Zion,
They will be free from sin
And of all temptation.
The Holy Scripture says,
How beautiful your feet are
Of those who good news
They take it to the infidels;
And, if it is so beautiful to speak
Of these magnitudes, here,
That will not be the enjoyment
The grace that exists there!
chorus: Yes, I will strive for this land beyond;
And there I will end the many struggles of falling short;
There is my good Lord, whom I long to see;
He is everything to me, and without Him I cannot live.

hymns.title: Full Peace
stanzas: Full peace and holy joy,
I have it in you, O my Jesus!
For I believed in Your death on the cross;
Only trusting in the Lord
In this world I will live,
Chanting hallelujahs to my King!
The love of Jesus Christ
It's too big for me,
For Your grace has filled me with endless love.
My Jesus went to glory,
But one day I will see Him,
Chanting hallelujahs to my King!
This world doesn't want
So kind Savior,
Not knowing how to thank His great love.
I, however, am enjoying
From the favor of His law,
Chanting hallelujahs to my King!
When the Israelite people
With Jesus agreeing,
Giving glory to His name, without ceasing.
In that time, heaven and earth
They will be the same flock,
Chanting hallelujahs to my King!
chorus: Oh! Glory to my Jesus!
For he is worthy of praise;
He is my King, my good Shepherd,
And my Lord.
Like the angels, who praise Him,
I will also praise Him,
Chanting hallelujahs to my King!

hymns.title: God Will Watch Over You
stanzas: Do not be discouraged, God will provide;
God will watch over you;
Under His wings He will welcome you;
God will watch over you.
If your heart palpitates with pain,
God will watch over you;
You have already tasted His tender love.
God will watch over you.
In discouragements, in trials,
God will watch over you;
Remember Him in temptations;
God will watch over you.
Whatever you ask, He will do;
God will watch over you;
And what you need, you won't deny.
God will watch over you.
Whatever you are, don't be afraid, come!
God will watch over you;
He understands you and loves you well!
God will watch over you.
chorus: God will take care of you
In your living, in your suffering;
Your gaze will follow you;
God will watch over you.

hymns.title: O Holy Fire Descend
stanzas: Spirit, soul and body,
I offer you, Lord,
Like a true host,
In oblation of love.
I am yours, O Jesus Christ!
Your blood bought me;
I want Your grace,
For I am always of You.
divine spirit,
The promise is from the Father;
Thirsty the soul asks,
To You, the holy anointing.
chorus: I consecrate everything to God
In Christ, the living altar;
O descend, holy fire,
From heaven you come to seal!

hymns.title: On the Curse of the Cross
stanzas: You. in the curse of the cross,
You elevated Your love,
In praying, Lord Jesus:
“Father, forgive the transgressor.”
The evil tempter is the author of perdition,
From sin, evil and pain, From sickness and affliction.
You took, oh good Jesus,
Sin, evil and pain,
And the disease on the cross;
You are the great Savior!
God is good, he always wants the good of the oppressed sinner;
God has no evil in Himself;
“God is light, God is love!”
chorus: Do you want, do you want, with vigor,
Many souls awaken;
Do you want, do you want, O Lord!
Transform, redeem, heal;
Oh! Yes! Oh! Yes!
You all want to renew.

hymns.title: Christ Heals Yes!
stanzas: Against the evils of this world,
God is worth us alone;
There is no evil that God cannot heal,
Because he feels sorry for us.
Spilled His pure blood
To redeem me;
When anointed I am with oil,
I'm cured, finally!
Only our soul is very safe,
Hidden in Jesus;
He is the balm of life,
He poured it out on the cross.
Glory to God! Eternal glory,
We gave Him praise;
Glory, songs and hosannas
Give to the Redeemer!
chorus: Christ heals, yes,
Christ heals, yes.
His love for us is Immense;
It heals, yes!

hymns.title: Christ, the Faithful Friend
stanzas: Christ Jesus is a faithful friend,
He alone, He alone.
And in my weaknesses he is with me,
He alone, He alone.
There is no more noble and worthy friend,
No, there is not; no, there isn't.
Neither more humble nor more benign,
No, there is not; no, there isn't.
To forgive the sinner,
He alone, He alone;
And for His saints he always watches,
He alone, He alone.
God, in His Son, is pleased,
In Him alone, in Him alone;
But His glory has distributed to me,
His alone, His alone.
In Him we have a firm guide,
In Him alone, in Him alone;
The night fills with joy,
He alone, He alone
chorus: And in the struggles of each day,
Christ never leaves me alone;
For He is my sure guide,
He alone, He alone.

hymns.title: March Soldiers of Christ
stanzas: March, soldiers of Christ Jesus,
March, march and face
The enemy of good and light;
Soldiers, advance!
March, soldiers, raise high
The pavilion of salvation;
To Belial, firm, bold, overcome;
I defeated corruption.
Take your armor of war,
The helmet, yes, of salvation:
And the sword: take the Bible,
And then you will win.
Forward, forward, trusting in Jesus,
You will be strong for His love,
March undefeated, soldiers of the light,
Jesus is the winner.
chorus: Yes, advance, not retreat;
Without fear, with value,
March, fight, for Christ will
At the forefront - Advance!

hymns.title: I Praise You
stanzas: Glory to God, the Eternal Father,
Whose throne is the heavens;
The universe belongs to Him.
Glory, yes, to our God.
Glory to the Son, dearly beloved,
That deserves the praise.
Let us give glory to His name,
To the Lamb, to the Redeemer.
Let us, to the Holy Spirit, give
A thousand praises for His gift;
By His immense grace,
Glory to Him, He is good!
Glory, glory to the blessed Father,
Glory, glory to Jesus;
Glory give to the Holy Spirit.
To the triune God, our light.
chorus: I praise you! I praise you!
Oh! Jesus, my Savior!
Give Him glory, O redeemed ones!
For His blood cleanses the sinner.

hymns.title: O Christian, Go Forward
stanzas: O Christians, go forward, go forward!
For Jesus and His Church to fight;
With the Word, that flaming sword,
Come on, come on, brothers, fight.
O Christians, go forward, go forward!
Bring good news to the lost;
Through cities and towns ahead,
Salvation let us proclaim.
O Christians, go forward, go forward!
For we already see the dawn breaking,
From that day when Christ, triumphant.
In this world you will always reign.
O Christians, go forward, go forward!
Let us be vexilaries of faith;
And the vanguard of the shining army
What a glorious victory there will be!
O Christians, go forward, go forward!
With courage, without fearing anything;
With Jesus, divine commander,
We, brothers, will win.
chorus: O Christian, always forward in the work!
The Gospel with faith to preach;
The Lord invites us to work,
Let us, therefore, fight with Jesus.

hymns.title: Come Now, Sinner
stanzas: Sinner, see the light, shine for you,
There from the Savior's cross,
Where life gave;
and on His side redeeming blood flows.
In the darkness of the Garden my Lord prayed So distressed;
When He mourned, His blood sweated,
In Gethsemane in pain!
See the Savior with his wounded hands
Calling you, oh sinner!
Eternal life has those who believe in Him
And accept His love.
Come to Christ, come confessing,
already, Your sins, and will hear you,
And in your heart you will feel forgiveness,
For Jesus will forgive you.
chorus: Oh come now, how are you!
Come now, to the Savior;
His life gave, he suffered everything;
Don't delay! Come now, sinner!

hymns.title: Jesus Bought Me
stanzas: Jesus bought me from the world here,
Sweet words are for me;
Jesus bought me and will give me
Eternal joy, heavenly home.
Jesus bought me and will give me
Eternal joy, heavenly home.
Jesus bought me from slavery,
Peace I enjoy through His forgiveness;
I'm looked down on a little here,
But I hope to cum there.
I'm looked down on a little here,
But I hope to cum there.
Jesus bought me, and I was left
Forever free from the harsh law!
Now I wait until He comes,
So that you can take me to Your future.
Now I wait until He comes,
So that you can take me to Your future.
O come, friends, and join us,
I quickly heard the voice from heaven;
- What takes time will not arrive,
Because you get lost and you will die.
- What takes time will not arrive,
Because you get lost and you will die.
Jesus bought me and will give me
Place at the tables, wait there.
Hear the invitation, O sinner,
For Jesus Christ is the Savior.
Hear the invitation, O sinner,
For Jesus Christ is the Savior.

hymns.title: Enjoyment in Jesus
stanzas: Oh! what joy I feel in Jesus,
Who expired for me on the cross;
My soul gave divine light,
Glory to my Jesus!
I am now free from sin,
He took me out of the abyss,
On the eternal rock he established me;
Glory to my Jesus!
Divine praise Jesus gave me;
Harmony that comes from heaven;
I will sing, joyfully, Christ is mine,
Glory to my Jesus!
This news I will proclaim;
Many will arrive like this,
And the glory receive, without equal,
Glory to my Jesus!
chorus: How much glory I see in Jesus,
Holy joy and blessed light,
Whose rays shine there on the cross,
In which Jesus died.
I always want to walk forward,
It's time to get to heaven.

hymns.title: Conversion
stanzas: Oh! how blind I walked and lost I wandered,
Far, far from my Savior!
But from heaven He came down, and His blood shed
To save such a poor sinner.
I heard about this unparalleled grace,
Who brought our Jesus from heaven;
But I made myself deaf, I didn't want to convert
To the Lord, who died for me on the cross.
But one day I felt my sin, and I saw
Upon me the sword of the law;
I ran away in a hurry, in Jesus I hid,
And I have found a safe shelter in Him.
How blessed, then, is this heart of mine,
Knowing the exalted love
That led my Jesus to suffer on the cross;
To save such a poor sinner.
Author: D.I.W Dr Isaac Watts
chorus: It was on the cross, it was on the cross,
where one day I saw
My sin punished in Jesus;
It was there, by faith, that I opened my eyes,
And now I rejoice in Your light

hymns.title: Awakening to Work
stanzas: I can have empty hands,
With Jesus can I find myself?
I did nothing, and the days go by,
What can I present to you?
I will no longer fear death;
I will win by being safe;
What will be my luck,
If you enter the empty sky?
Entering the heavenly home,
How will I go to the Savior?
How many souls will I take,
For my faithful Lord?
Of sin, bound in bonds,
I spent years in vain labor;
I wish I could get them back,
To serve my Lord.
Let us wake up, It is daytime;
Let us work fervently;
And let us take, with joy,
Many souls to the Lord.
chorus: I can have empty hands,
With Jesus, do I meet?
How many souls could
To the Lord to present?

hymns.title: Thinking About Jesus
stanzas: In the hours I spend thinking about Jesus
I undo the darkness, seeking the light;
What hours of life, so sweet for me,
Jesus invites me to come up to Him!
Of life flying, without any fear;
Above seeking love from the veil;
What a sweet venture, what a happy aspect,
What a new nature my soul blesses.
From the sea the roar, from the breeze the languor
From the bird the cry of sweet love,
The chords of the heavens speak to me,
The hymns of God bring to my ears!
My anxious soul already wants to travel
The glorious path I will see;
What a beautiful thing; oh! what a veilless light!
Jesus reveals to me mysteries of heaven.

hymns.title: Grateful Nova
stanzas: Grateful new God proclaims
Today, to the sinful world!
Sweet new revealed,
There on the Savior's cross;
Blind and astray, the man,
Of the ways of the Lord,
Unaware and suspicious
Of this God, the God of love.
With offerings and dead works,
Worthless sacrifices,
Deceived, the man thinks,
Propitiate Your Creator,
He invents ways to save himself;
Cry out, pray in your favor,
To supposed mediators,
Despising the God of love.
Divine light, shine!
Show the sad sinner,
Who are united on the cross
Justice and love.
Speak to wounded hearts,
Show yourself, Savior God;
And without end, we will proclaim:
"God is light! God is love!"
chorus: Grateful new, sweet new,
It comes from the lips of the Lord;
Listen with joy:
“God is light, God is love.”

hymns.title: Christ's Invitation
stanzas: Behold, the voice of Christ cries,
Over the turbulent sea
Of this dangerous life:
"Come and take shelter in Me."
When once in Galilee,
That sweet voice sounded,
Therefore, the listening heart,
Everything, ready, abandoned.
About the seductive voices,
Of worldly attractions,
The gentle voice of Christ cries out:
“Give me your hearts!”
Whether in the midst of pleasures,
Whether in the day of affliction,
Still cry out, patient:
“Do you love Me, O Christian?”
On the narrow and holy path,
Already trampled by Jesus,
Following Him, He calls you:
“Come, Christian, walk in the light!”
From this anguished cross,
Where His love shines,
Listen to the voice that invites you,
Hear and follow, sinner!

hymns.title: Look at the Lamb of God
stanzas: Free from sin do you want to remain?
Look at the Lamb of God!
He died on the cross, to save you;
Look at the Lamb of God!
If you are tempted, in hesitation,
Look at the Lamb of God!
He will fill your heart.
Look at the Lamb of God!
If you are tired and without any more vigor,
Look at the Lamb of God!
He wants to give you His divine! love,
Look at the Lamb of God!
If shadows come to fall on your path,
Look at the Lamb of God!
He, with His grace, wants to supply everything.
Look at the Lamb of God!
chorus: Look at the Lamb of God,
Look at the lamb of God,
Because only He can save you.
Look at the Lamb of God!

hymns.title: Glorious Dawn
stanzas: The glorious dawn comes,
From the day there in Belém
Born of God, the Son;
What a beautiful day and light,
In which Jesus came down to us,
From the sky showing the trail.
How many saints remember today,
And remember the story
From Jesus, the King of Glory!
Jesus was born there in Bethlehem,
Bringing us the ultimate good
From heaven - freedom;
Granted us perfect peace,
Consolation that satisfies
For all eternity!
How we were torn apart,
Strayed and lost!
Today we are redeemed!
Christ will dwell with us
With His power He will watch over us,
Giving us deliverance;
And will always guide us
For His grace will give us
In all the suffering,
Scuta: Always fight hard.
It's death, because it helps
You have in Christ, who does not change!
Jesus came down to save us,
The sun of grace comes to shine,
Joyful jubilees;
Jesus, O our good Shepherd,
Come guide us with Your love;
There we belong;
Souls saved, forgiven,
Freed today they pray,
Reverent worship You!

hymns.title: Lord's Supper
stanzas: In our soul we take.
Your body, O Jesus!
As a voluntary offering,
That you gave us there on the cross.
In figure, Your blood
We drink, O Lord,
For only in Him is there virtue
To save the sinner.
Come, grant to Your Church
The forgiveness of Your love,
So that on both emblems,
Let us contemplate You, Lord.
O Lord, by Your Spirit
Comes to reside in us,
For Your body and Your blood
We can discern.
chorus: As bread from heaven you came down,
Let us receive You;
For united to Your body,
Yes, we want to live.

hymns.title: Glory to Jesus
stanzas: The saints sing with fervor,
To whom for me was immolated,
On the cross, suffering my sin.
God is the Justifier
Whoever believes in His Envoy
Yes, in His most beloved Son.
He received praise from His Father,
And with power he was exalted,
That's why he's glorified.
Of the "purifying blood",
I always want to remember,
And have more confidence in Him.
For us, on the cross, he suffered pain,
We were bought with blood,
And from sin rescued.
chorus: Glory to Jesus!
Glory to Jesus!
Glory to Jesus, the Savior!

hymns.title: Pentecostal Power
stanzas: At Pentecost it happened
What Jesus said,
Because suddenly from the sky
A wind blew,
That came to fill the whole house
And hearts with great power.
In each one came to rest
The precious light,
The Preceptor who came to stay
Like the servants of Jesus;
It was the holy fire of the Lord.
Who filled them with His vigor.
And they began to speak, full of power,
In other languages exalt
What did you order to bring
The rich gifts of His love
And the consoling power.
And who wants to receive
This salutary water.
That is promised to whoever believes
And humble wait,
Persevering in prayer,
Your heart will have power.
chorus: Power, power, Pentecostal power.
Oh, come and inflame us,
Also renew ourselves;
Oh come, yes, come, oh divine flame,
Baptize your servants.

hymns.title: Jesus You are Good
stanzas: My Jesus, You are good;
You are everything to me!
You were dead, but you live in me;
You deserve praise,
O Lamb of God!
You are everything, yes, everything to me!
I want to give You praise,
For you are King over kings;
You are everything, but I am nothing;
Fill my heart
Of tenderness and peace;
Eternal honor and glory I give You.
Your name is love,
Because You love me,
And I want to walk in this love;
I am triumphant,
Trusting in You,
My Jesus, great Comforter.
O Anointed One of God,
You bring peace and forgiveness;
Salvation, life, you have for Yours;
What a message from heaven
And transformation,
Sent from the throne of God!

hymns.title: Beautiful Jerusalem
stanzas: How glorious, Christian, to think
In the city that has no equal,
Where the walls are made of pure jasper.
And the streets of gold and crystal;
Think how glorious it will be
See the triumphant crowd.
That singing, awaits the arrival
Of those who overcome tribulation.
Think how glorious it will be
See the river of life and light,
Whose banks are strewn with lilies,
They are the glory of our Jesus;
There will be perpetual dawn there,
For God himself will illuminate it;
And the Lamb, with His wife,
Night and day it will shine.
Think of the heavenly melody
That the earth will be filled with Beulah;
And from the harps the sweet harmony
When you cross the Jordan you will hear it.
Even in pains that lead to death,
Be constant, don't go back,
Your inheritance, your eternal luck,
It is Jesus, the Faithful, the Truthful.
If it is glorious to think of greatness,
In the pleasures that come here,
What will it be like to enjoy the riches
What do the saved await there?
The charms of the world cannot
Overshadow this glory beyond;
You don't want to live, my friend,
In this beautiful Jerusalem?

hymns.title: Love That Wins
stanzas: Love, for love you came down!
Love, that for love you died!
Oh! how much pain you didn't suffer,
My heart to conquer,
And my love wins!
Love, that with love you followed!
Me, that without love You saw!
Oh! how much love you felt for me,
My Savior, my good Jesus,
Suffering on the cross!
Love, you forgive me everything!
Love, that you even bless!
A defendant you are fond of!
By You defeated, O Savior,
Here I am at Your feet, Lord!
Love, that you never, never change,
That in Your arms you hold me,
Surrounding me with a thousand happiness!
Accept it now, Salvador.
My humble love!

hymns.title: God Will Guide You
stanzas: You are full of sadness and pain,
Without any help, not even a Savior?
Hear the message of your good Jesus,
And have more courage, take up your cross.
Every load for you, He wants to take; Painful soul, hear His speech;
Thorny path He has already walked,
He endured an outrageous death for you.
If you are tempted, God will help you, Always trusting, he will set you free;
Follow in the footsteps of your Savior, Believing in God, continue, whatever it may be.
chorus: God will guide you with His strong hand;
You can rest in tribulation;
Let your life be free from regret;
In sadness and hardship God will guide you.

hymns.title: The Precious Blood
stanzas: Oh! what precious blood,
My Lord poured,
When, to rescue us,
He suffered!
Oh! what precious blood,
Blood of Jesus,
That for us, was shed
Over the cross!
Oh! what precious blood,
Redeeming blood!
Yes, with this you redeemed us,
Redeemer!
Oh! what precious blood,
Atoning blood!
Here's what's worth it
The evildoer!
Oh! what precious blood,
Purifier!
That washes away every stain
The sinner!
Oh! what precious blood,
Speak to us of peace;
Everything the law requires,
Satisfies!
Oh! what precious blood.
Through Him I will enter
Without fear, in the presence
From my King!
Oh! what precious blood,
From the good Savior!
Today, everyone expresses
Your love!

hymns.title: I'm not mine
stanzas: I'm not mine! By Christ saved,
Who died for me on the cross,
I happily confess,
That I belong to the good Jesus.
I'm not mine! By Him redeemed,
When the blood spilled;
In His grace trusting,
That my soul rescued.
Never mine! I trust you
Everything I call mine;
I deliver everything into Your hands;
My Lord, I am all Yours!
Never mine! O sanctify
All that I am, Lord!
From vanity and pride,
Come free me, Salvador.
chorus: I'm not mine! Oh! I'm not mine!
Good Jesus, I am all Yours!
Today and forever,
Good Jesus, I am all Yours!

hymns.title: Glory to My Jesus
stanzas: The Savior suffered for me,
Glory! Glory to my Jesus!
Praise, with me, the Redeemer!
Glory! Glory to my Jesus!
He carried my sins,
Glory! Glory to my Jesus!
And on the cross he rescued me.
Glory! Glory to my Jesus!
I know I'm forgiven,
Glory! Glory to my Jesus!
And, of course, I'm going to heaven!
Glory! Glory to my Jesus!
And when the war here ends,
Glory! Glory to my Jesus!
In heaven, better, I will sing,
Glory! Glory to my Jesus!
chorus: Jesus! Jesus! O Savior;
The name of the Lord is sweet;
Embrace me with holy love;
Glory! Glory to my Lord.

hymns.title: My Christ! My Christ!
stanzas: Who came down from heaven for me,
Everything in my place suffered,
And for me on the cross he died?
It was Christ! It was Christ!
Who brought me, which shepherd,
Your lamb with love?
Who wanted to be my Savior?
It was Christ! It was Christ!
Who with gentle compassion,
Did it melt my heart?
Did you give me complete salvation?
It was Christ! It was Christ!
Who says: “I will not leave you,
Nor will I forsake you,
Will I always help you?”
It's Christ! And Christ!
Who is worthy of praise?
Who deserves my love?
It is Jesus, my Savior,
My Christ! My Christ!
chorus: My sins atoned:
He freed me from all the pain!
He rescued me from the curse,
My Christ! My Christ!

hymns.title: With Your Holding Hand
stanzas: With Your hand, hold mine tight,
For I am so weak, O Savior!
That I don't dare to take even a single step
Without Your support, my Jesus Lord!
With Your hand, hold mine tight,
And more and more united to You, Jesus.
Oh bring me, may I never stray
From You, Lord, my life and light!
With Your hand, hold mine tight,
And, through the world, I will happily follow:
Even where the shadows fall darkest
Seeing your face, I will fear nothing.
And if you get to the edge of that river,
That You wanted to cross for me,
With Your hand hold mine well,
And over death I will triumph.
When you return those skies breaking,
hold my hand tight, Lord,
And, my Jesus, oh take me with you,
Where I can enjoy Your eternal love.
Author: F.C Fanny Crosby

hymns.title: Jesus Militia
stanzas: Thousands of thousands in refulgent light!
Behold the holy warriors, Jesus' militia!
Complete, yes, complete your long struggle here,
With Christ, their Lady King, they will rest there;
May sweet symphonies fill earth and heaven!
What choirs of hallelujahs break beyond the veil!
And the day has come, the triumphal day,
And Christ will finally reign in divine glory!
Then there is no more crying, nor is there any more temptation;
The pains, the sadness will forever flee,
And the redeemed will all see their Savior;
And transformed, everyone will be like the Lord.

hymns.title: The Great Love
stanzas: The great love of my Jesus
For me dying on the cross,
From perdition, to save me;
Who can tell?
The cup that Jesus drank,
The curse he suffered,
All for me, to save me,
Who can tell?
The mockery so cruel,
The bloody cross, the bitter gall,
That He suffered to save me;
Who can tell?
Incomparable Savior!
How ineffable Your love!
How impossible to fathom!
Immense and unique!
chorus: Who can His love tell?
Who can His love tell?
The great love of the Savior,
Who can tell?

hymns.title: The Exile
stanzas: From the beautiful homeland I am far away;
I'm tired;
I have saluted Jesus,
Oh, when will I go?
Little birds, beautiful flowers,
They want to enchant me;
They are earthly splendors,
But I contemplate my home.
Jesus gave me His promise;
Come get me;
My heart is in a hurry,
I want to fly now.
My sins were many,
I am very guilty;
But His blood makes me clean;
I'm going home.
Like a son of his longing home,
I want to go;
Which bird for the nest,
To flee into His arms;
Is faithful - His coming is certain,
When... I don't know.
But He tells us to be alert;
From exile I will return.
I await your coming, singing;
My home in heaven;
I will hear your footsteps sounding
Beyond the dark veil.
Little birds, beautiful flowers,
They want to enchant me;
They are earthly splendors,
But I contemplate my home.

hymns.title: Christ for Me
stanzas: Oh! What rest in Jesus I have found!
Christ for me! Christ for me!
Oh! What infinite treasures I found!
Christ for me! Christ for me!
'Others choose the world for themselves.
Seek riches, delights here;
I will always welcome You, O Jesus!
Christ for me! Christ for me!
Whether in affliction, illness or pain:
Christ for me! Christ for me!
Whether in health, strength or vigor;
Christ for me! Christ for me!
Always by my side to help me,
With His love, yes, and with His power;
In every trance ready to help me;
Christ for me! Christ for me!
On the bitter day of persecution:
Christ for me! Christ for me!
In hard trials and temptation:
Christ for me! Christ for me!
He, sin and the world won
When, for me, on Calvary he died;
And I was certain of victory;
Christ for me! Christ for me!
When I enter the valley of death,
Christ for me! Christ for me!
When before my God I find myself:
Christ for me! Christ for me!
Only in Your blood do I trust, Lord,
Only in Your always unchanging love!
I will sing again, Salvador:
Christ for me! Christ for me!

hymns.title: The Lord is King
stanzas: Proclaim to the whole world that the Lord is King!
Proclaim! Proclaim!
I proclaimed that His holy law is sweet and sweet!
Proclaim! Proclaim!
Proclaim how He is called Savior Jesus,
As He died for us on the bloody cross,
As He - the Lamb - upon the throne stands
The God of all grace, who freely gives everything.
I proclaimed that our Savior reigns in grace!
I proclaimed! I proclaimed!
That as the scepter of His kingdom He has love!
I proclaimed! I proclaimed!
I announced to the sad that He lives there;
And to all the weary He gives rest;
I told sinners that He came to save,
And to all the captives that He can set free.
I proclaimed that He will soon descend from heaven!
I proclaimed! I proclaimed!
And with all His saints will appear!
I proclaimed! I proclaimed!
Let everyone come and surrender without delay
And, with love, in everything and Christ obey
May everyone be ready when He returns,
And joyful, on that day, “King of kings”, will acclaim
chorus: Proclaim! to everyone
that the Lord is King!
Proclaim! Proclaim!
Proclaim! how soft and sweet
It is His holy law!
Proclaim! Proclaim!

hymns.title: Target More Than Snow
stanzas: Blessed be the Lamb,
Who suffered on the cross for us!
Blessed be His blood,
That for us, He poured it there!
Behold in this blood washed,
With clothes that are so white,
Redeemed sinners,
That they already stand before their God!
How thorny the crown
That Jesus endured for us!
Oh! How deep the wounds,
That proves to us how much He loved!
Behold in these wounds purity
For the greatest sinner!
For what whiter than snow,
Your blood makes us, Lord!
If we confess to You,
And let us follow in Your light,
You not only forgive,
You also purify, O Jesus;
Yes, and from all sin!
What a wonderful love!
Well, what's more white than snow.
Your blood makes us, Lord.
chorus: Target more than snow!
Target more than snow!
Yes, in that washed blood,
I will be more target than snow.

hymns.title: The City of Bom Jesus
stanzas: What can be said of your charms,
O city of the good God!
How proud you are
Among the glories of these heavens,
Since the world prepared
For Christ and for His own.
They are made of adamantine jasper
Your walls, O Zion!
These streets are golden,
That the redeemed will tread!
Bathed in celestial light,
They are always shining!
By God himself founded
Over the centuries-old rock
How safe are your doors!
Who can threaten them?
Likewise, how safe
Whoever enters there for her!
How happy are your children,
Seeing the face of the Lord!
Never feel hungry again,
Never feel the pain anymore,
With the angels enjoying
Full joy, peace and love!
The throne of the Lamb,
Night and day, without ceasing
The river of living water flows,
For everyone to indulge!
There with Christ, go your children,
Satisfied rest!
If, for Your infinite love,
I am a son of Zion,
Mock the world and mock,
Nothing matters, Savior,
For of Your eternal joy
Even here I have the pledge!

hymns.title: To Christ Crown
stanzas: Crown Christ! Who incarnated for us,
And God, the Holy God and Father, revealed it to men.
Behold His compassion! Behold His meekness!
Whoever sees Christ sees the Father; yes, see His heart.
Crown Christ! Of all the Creator,
The Son of the eternal God, of the world, the Savior, Jesus Emmanuel,
the great Redeemer!
In search of the lost, our good Shepherd comes.
Crown Christ! That on the cross, won
For us eternal redemption and to heaven he returned!
He is the King of kings! The Prince of Peace!
Jesus, of death, the winner, that Salvation brings us.
Crown Christ! Of all the Lord,
Whom the multitude of the heavens fervently acclaim!
Behold the Lamb there, who is on the throne!
Who lives and reigns there for us, and will soon return.

hymns.title: Greet Jesus
stanzas: Salute the name of Jesus!
Archangels, prostrate yourselves;
Archangels, prostrate yourselves;
To the Son of the eternal God,
With glory, glory,
Glory, glory,
With glory, crown!
O chosen generation
From the good eternal Father,
From the good eternal Father;
To the great author of salvation,
With glory, glory,
Glory, glory,
With glory, crown!
O forgiven ones, whose love
Well triumphant go,
Well triumphant go,
To the Man God, Conqueror,
With glory, glory,
Glory, glory,
With glory, crown!
O races, tribes and nations,
Honor the King of kings!
Honor the King of kings!
To those who broke your chains,
With glory, glory,
Glory, glory,
With glory, crown!

hymns.title: Sweet Home
stanzas: In the heavenly homeland, God's sweet home,
Jesus prepares a place for His own,
For far from evil, sin and pain,
With you forever, your Lord wants you to have them.
Oh! sacrosanct home of peace and love!
There on the throne, I will see my Lord,
The gentle Lamb, reigning in light,
Praised by all, blessed Jesus!
What pure delights are found in you!
What supreme joys await there,
Those whom God wants to have together,
And perpetually satisfy them!
It is not your pleasures that I long to enjoy,
But, yes, live with Jesus forever!
Never dishonor Him, never offend
Who, to win me, wanted to die for me.
chorus: Oh! Sweet, sweet home!
There, with Jesus, I will forever rest

hymns.title: Oh! What Glory!
stanzas: My Lord, who saved me,
Yours, and Yours alone, am I;
With Your blood You healed me;
Glory, glory to You I give.
To obtain such great enjoyment,
I worked long and hard;
But all effort is in vain,
I just believe that I found it.
Trusting, trusting,
Always and alone, Jesus, in You,
Your power and Your grace
You might as well save me.
Consecrated to Your service,
I want You to live;
Always giving testimony
Of Your grace and Your power.
chorus: Oh! What glory! Oh! What glory!
I enjoy in my heart!
I trust in Jesus,
And, believing, I have salvation.
Oh! What glory! Oh! What glory!
I enjoy in my heart!
I trust in Jesus,
And in His blood I found forgiveness.

hymns.title: Omnipotent Redeemer
stanzas: Omnipotent Redeemer,
Mighty Savior,
omniscient lawyer
It is Jesus, my good Lord.
A shelter always close by,
For every sinner;
A refuge always open,
It's Jesus. my Savior.
Living water! bread of life!
Sweet shade in the heat,
That invites us to rest.
It is Jesus, my Savior!
O immaculate Lamb,
That His blood shed,
My sins atoning,
My soul rescued.
Unshakable foundation!
Firm and secular rock!
Infallible! Immutable!
Who can take it from me?
The path that, safe,
Always to heaven leads,
Whoever follows Christ readily,
Whoever takes up his cross.
chorus: O Lover of my soul,
You are everything to me!
Everything I need
I think, Jesus, only in You.

hymns.title: A Royal Tassel
stanzas: A royal banner handed you the King
To you, His soldiers;
Courageous, then, defend him in everything,
Marching to the heavens.
Here are the dense battalions already formed
From the great usurper!
I declare you, today, brave champions;
Forward without fear.
Whoever I fear feels in his heart,
And weak to show,
You will not receive eternal reward,
What Christ has to give.
So let us all be loyal to Jesus,
And to His royal banner;
Those who are always faithful in battle,
With Him they will reign.
chorus: With value! No fear!
For Christ ready to suffer!
Raise His banner high,
Always firm, until you die!

hymns.title: Eternal Rock
stanzas: Eternal rock, my Jesus,
That, for me, on the bitter cross,
You were killed in my place,
Dead to save me;
In You I want to hide,
Only You can help me.
My works, I know well,
They are worthless before the law;
If I cried without ceasing.
Work without tiring,
All useless, all in vain!
Only in You is there salvation.
I bring nothing to You, Lord!
'I hope only in Your love!
I am all unworthy and filthy,
Behold, without You, I am lost!
In Your blood, O Savior,
Wash a poor sinner.
When death calls me,
And before You I present myself,
Eternal rock, my Jesus,
That for me, on the bitter cross,
You were killed in my place,
I just want to shelter myself in You.

hymns.title: The Day of Triumph
stanzas: When from heaven descending,
for His own, Jesus will return,
And the clarion of God to all proclaim,
That the great day of my King's triumph has arrived,
I, by His immense grace, will be there.
On that day, when the dead
they will hear the voice of Christ,
And from their graves they will rise again,
The redeemed gathered together will soon acclaim their King,
And, by His immense grace, I will be there.
By the world, he was rejected,
Jesus, my Savior.
They despised, insulted my Lord,
But, magnificently, the day comes
of the triumph of my King,
And, by His immense grace, I will be there.
In myself I have nothing that I can trust,
But Jesus died on the cross to save me;
I hope only in Him, yes, and I will always hope.
For, by His immense grace, I will be there.
chorus: When the day finally arrives
Of the triumph of my King,
When the day finally arrives,
By the grace of Jesus I will be there!

hymns.title: Hallelujah! I already believe
stanzas: God has promised to give salvation.
Whoever trusts in His Son Jesus.
It was such His love, that it replaced me,
And on Calvary, my soul was redeemed!
I can never doubt this love;
I can only prostrate myself at His feet.
And when, in glory, I see my good King,
With all the saints there I will sing.
chorus: Hallelujah! I already believe in Christ Jesus.
And I am already saved, by the blood of the cross!

hymns.title: Always Faithful
stanzas: Ever faithful, yes, to You we will be,
By Thy grace, O Christ, Lord!
Always faithful, yes, for You we will fight.
Under Your banner, O Jesus, Savior!
For You live, O blessed Lamb,
Who doesn't want to know You?
Who, who calls himself a true Christian,
Don't be ready, for You to suffer?
But, Salvador, how weak we are,
How can we stop falling,
If we are not kept by Yourself?
Who, even to death, can follow You?
chorus: Always faithful, brothers! Let us be brothers.
Always faithful to Christ Jesus.
Who continued for us until death,
And he freed us, dying on the cross!

hymns.title: Recognized Worship
stanzas: O my soul, without delay,
Rise up to sing,
The praises of your Christ,
And His name celebrate!
To redeem you, to redeem you,
His life He wanted to give!
My condition so sad
Met my Savior;
Who came down to earth from the heavens,
To be my Redeemer!
Oh! How big! Oh! How big!
And the love of my Lord!
Rightly condemned
What could I do,
From this pain to free me,
Forgiveness to deserve?
His blood, His blood,
Jesus wanted to pour it out for me!
With my crimes loaded,
There on the cross, in my place,
Jesus was crucified,
My soul to save;
Come everyone! Come everyone,
Already with me, I adore Him!

hymns.title: Everything is fine
stanzas: For the love of blessed God,
It's going well!
Your love is infinite:
Everything is fine!
This love has tested us.
In His dearly beloved Son,
Which, for us, was immolated.
Yes, yes, 'okay!
Christ now wields the scepter:
It's going well!
The one who died is the one who rules:
Everything is fine!
Your love is unchanging,
Your unshakable power,
Your care is tireless,
Yes, yes, 'okay!
Faith sings in sadness:
It's going well!
Sing, yes, and firmly:
Everything is fine!
For if God is the one who guides us,
Tenderly watches over us,
With kindness, night and day.
Yes, yes, 'okay!
Along rough paths,
It's going well!
Or through stormy seas,
Everything is fine!
Everything obeys Jesus;
Always the same remains!
Not one of His people forgets!
Yes, yes, 'okay!
Whether in life or in death,
It's going well!
How happy is our lot!
Everything is fine!
Redeemed by blood,
And from the world apart.
Always guarded by Jesus.
Yes, yes, 'okay!

hymns.title: The Hope of the Church
stanzas: Until the Savior returns,
Surrounding the Lord's table,
We came to celebrate Supper,
Of Christ, death announce,
And with humble devotion,
Give worship to God.
Until the Savior returns,
Here let us show His love;
With great faith and gratitude,
Let us partake of this bread,
Obedient to Jesus,
Thus remembering His cross!
Until the Savior returns,
Drinking the cup of the Lord,
We want to bless your name,
And grow more and more,
The blood that He shed,
The blood that rescued us!
If the trials are hard,
If the persecutions are strong,
If the struggles make themselves felt,
And it's hard for us to resist,
Let's not let ourselves be disturbed:
It's just until Jesus returns!
Well ready to receive Him,
We must always live here;
Time runs away, the day comes,
Glory awaits beyond,
So let us work, with fervor,
Until the Savior returns.

hymns.title: Let us praise the Redeemer
stanzas: My soul, praise the Redeemer
Jesus, your King, your Savior,
That on the cross, in your place,
His blood was given to save you!
Oh! how lost and far I have walked,
Far from God and His law!
With tender and patient love
Always followed me, the Savior!
Blessed day, when, finally,
I saw Christ on the cross, for me!
Overcome by His love,
I immediately surrendered to the Savior.
Come, afflicted soul, rest;
Here is Christ ready to forgive!
Trust in Him, with your heart,
And yours will be the great forgiveness.
chorus: Yes, on the cross, in my place,
Jesus died to save me!
I am safe and secure in Him,
For with His blood He saved me.

hymns.title: Closer to Your Cross
stanzas: My Lord, I am Yours - I have heard Your voice
Calling me, with love;
More, to You, closer I want to be,
O blessed Savior!
Following You alone, I consecrate myself,
Constrained by love,
And, joyfully, I already declare myself Yours,
To serve You, Lord.
Oh! What pure and holy delight it is,
At Your holy feet you will find me,
And with living and reverent faith,
With my Savior speak.
chorus: Closer, closer to Your cross
I want to be, O Savior!
Closer, closer, closer to Your cross
Take me, O my Lord!

hymns.title: All in Christ
stanzas: Before, I always worked with fear,
But rest, now in my Savior;
Dantes "waited"; Today, “I know it well”
That I am saved in Christ, my blessed King.
Before, I desired blessing from the Lord;
Today, more of Christ, more of His love!
Not only the blessing, which he so readily gives,
But He Himself is the source in whom everything is.
Before, I doubted, it was always “the me”:
Today, I know Christ well, beyond the veil,
Eternal priest, you entered there for me;
In Him I am complete, in Him I am accepted.
Dantes wanted the world; Today, it’s just Jesus!
Before, it was darkness: today, it is full light;
Before, the fear, today, the sweet peace,
I leave everything to Christ, He satisfies me.
chorus: Everything! All in Christ’
Who died for me.
All! All in Christ!
Christ is all mine.

hymns.title: Revive us Lord
stanzas: God present is with us.
Everyone ready to save;
About thirsty souls,
He wants His blessing to pour out.
Behold You, Lord, we lift
Our poor hearts;
In Your great and rich grace,
Hear our petitions!
Makes our faith more alive,
Our love is more ardent;
Fill us with holy zeal,
Of courage and fervor.
chorus: Send, oh send the rich rains
Of Your blessing, Savior!
We beg you! We wait!
Live us, Lord!

hymns.title: Fear Not
stanzas: “Do not be afraid! With you, I will always be!
Oh! rich promise from the kind King;
Like a star that shines, there in the darkness,
This beautiful promise shines in my heart.
The whitest lilies, behold, they are withered!
The most beautiful days, how quickly they go!
Christ, the lily of the valley, will never change:
Christ, the heavenly light, will always be with me!
And if I have to pass through the waters,
Your eternal arms will keep me;
Yes, even in the fire. who comes to try me,
My Lord promises to always be with me!
chorus: Be with me! Be with me!
Yes, Jesus promises me,
Always be with me.
Be with me! Be with me!
Yes, Jesus promises me,
Always be with me.

hymns.title: I believe, yes
stanzas: Know you endless love,
A sinner was I;
In my thinking there was no place
For Christ and heaven.
For when I saw Jesus for myself,
Suffering on the cross,
My heart, without hesitation,
He received love and light.
With tears, I asked for forgiveness,
And pain, I also felt;
Then Jesus came and said to me:
“It was for you that I died.”
I know that God, in His Son,
See me perfect and healthy;
There is no more fear, only blessed love,
I enjoy it in my heart.
chorus: I believe, yes, I already believe, yes,
Jesus died for me;
By His blood, which He shed,
I was finally freed.

hymns.title: Exultation of the Believer
stanzas: Come, sing and sing
Praises to Jesus,
That, for our salvation,
He died on the bitter cross,
His blood spilled, he washed me from everything,
More target than the snow made me.
Come join us
In the war against evil;
And with our Savior,
On a triumphal march,
Proclaim to all, His grace and His power.
His blood spilled to save us!
The Captain of Salvation
It is Christ, the Savior;
The King of kings, the Redeemer.
Jesus, our Lord;
He will overcome everything, victory will give us;
Glory, saved, will lead us.
chorus: The blood of Jesus washed me, washed me!
The blood of Jesus washed me, washed me!
Joyfully I will sing praises to my King,
To my Lord Jesus, who saved me.

hymns.title: God Will Take Care of You
stanzas: At all times, brother, the Lord
He will take care of you.
Christ, who speaks of life and love,
He will take care of you.
In every trial, brother, the Lord
Will take care of you
Christ, who is your beloved Shepherd,
He will take care of you.
Everywhere, brother, the Lord
He will take care of you.
Christ, who gives us power and value,
He will take care of you.
Coming to death, brother, the Lord
He will take care of you.
Christ will be your faithful guide:
He will take care of you.
chorus: God will take care of you,
God will take care of you,
Rest in Him, always here,
Well, God, take care of you.

hymns.title: I found Jesus
stanzas: I found Jesus, I found Jesus,
Oh! incomparable enjoyment!
Well, I'm saved, I already have light
And inexplicable peace!
My sins atoned
The blood of the Lamb;
My darkness has dispelled;
I am heir of God!
Jesus sought me far away,
Lost I found myself!
And saved me from sin,
Which tormented me,
I belong to my good Redeemer,
To my best friend,
That freed me from all the pain,
And it's always with me.
Oh! What a pleasure, oh! What a pleasure!
Jesus is my beloved!
I want to be the Savior
A consecrated servant;
For he has already given me salvation,
That we were promised,
To my tired heart
Filled with new life.
I wish my Jesus to praise,
In sweet harmony;
In Christ, I found everything,
For everything was lacking;
And without ceasing, the Savior,
Love me tenderly;
What will I say to such love?
"I love you forever!"

hymns.title: Wake up, wake up
stanzas: Behold we march to that good country,
Where the believer (yes, it is Christ who says it),
With your Savior forever there happy,
Go with Him to rest.
Let us therefore work with zeal and vigor,
Constrained by His immense love;
Let us work for our Savior:
Behold, life will end!
Here with us is our distinguished Captain,
That assures us eternal salvation!
Behold the holy faith, the undefeated pavilion!
Come on, let's get to work!
Here we go! We have nothing to fear;
Through Jesus, we will always win,
Let us work, until dawn,
And the work here ends!
Clothed with the breastplate of Jesus,
As His servants and children, yes, of the light,
Glorying in Christ and His cross!
Come on, come on, get to work!
The lost, let us seek with love,
To the desperate, we will declare
That Jesus is ready to save everyone!
Oh yes, let's get to work!
chorus: Wake up! Wake up! Awake! Awake!
And sing! Yes, sing! The Lord will not delay.
Behold we march to that good country,
Where the believer (yes, it is Christ who says it),
With your Savior, forever there happy,
Go with Him to rest.

hymns.title: From Around the World: Hallelujah!
stanzas: From all over the world, here we are
Only trusting in You,
Remaining in Your love,
Your kingdom only seeking,
Our lives, our love,
To You we bring, Savior,
Singing: “Hallelujah!”
To live for You, in You to die,
Our parents aimed;
Just do your will,
This is what they wanted.
And we, who are Yours, too
We say, firmly: Yes, Amen’
And: "Glory! Hallelujah!”
To the saving Gospel,
So pure and glorious,
The most holy laws that You
You give us, kind Lord,
“Amen! We say with fervor,
And, for Your immense love,
We cry, “Hallelujah!”
Yes, constrained by love,
Lost we seek
Save, - win for You, Lord:
This is what we aspire to,
Always following Your law,
Loyal to You, blessed King,
We sing: “Hallelujah!”
Nor will labor be in vain,
For behold, how glorious,
The day comes when Jesus
He will come victorious;
And everyone will sing,
And joyfully he will exalt Him,
With: “Amen”, “Hallelujah!”

hymns.title: Who Will Go?
stanzas: Behold the millions, who in such ghastly darkness
They lie lost, without the Savior!
Who, who will proclaim the news,
That God, in Christ, saves the sinner?
Open doors, behold all over the world!
Christians, arise! Now move on!!
Believers in Christ! Unite your forces.
From slavery the people free!
"O come to me! The divine voice cries,
"Come!" Cry! in the name of Jesus:
To save us from eternal curse,
His blood was shed for us on the cross.
O God hasten the glorious day,
In which the redeemed will all unite,
And, in an exalted, holy, joyful choir,
Forever and ever, they will give glory to You.
chorus: “All power the Father has given me,
On earth, as in heaven!
Go, therefore, proclaim the Gospel,
And here I am with you always!”

hymns.title: Ready to Save
stanzas: Whoever believes in the Son of God,
Who, to redeem us, came down from the heavens;
Everyone who contritely comes to God,
Jesus is now ready to save.
Who, repentant, seeks forgiveness,
Opening your heart to Jesus,
Peace can be enjoyed today,
For He is now ready to save.
chorus: Yes, Jesus calls you, my Brother!
To you He offers full forgiveness;
His blood shed to rescue you,
And He is the one who wants and can save.

hymns.title: Who Wants to Go With Christ?
stanzas: Who wants to follow Jesus today?
Your flag raising, to the fight?
Whoever wants, humiliated, to always serve Him,
And obey Him. Do you want to fulfill?
Whoever follows Christ wants, with great love,
Giving Him tribute, giving Him praise;
Of His noble cause, being a defender,
And in the holy vineyard, be a worker?
Do you want to follow Him, without hesitation,
And escape from the arms of vile temptation?
Always trusting in His protection,
By faith enjoying His salvation.
chorus: Who wants to go with Christ, who will answer,
Quickly, without delay, “I, Lord, will go”?
Wherever the Master goes, will you go too?
Who will say now: “I will follow You”?

hymns.title: Joy of Having Salvation
stanzas: May you receive the sweet peace of God,
Believing in Jesus, who has already come down from heaven:
Take up your cross today,
Come from darkness to light,
And thus, Jesus will give you much joy!
You can know the love of Christ,
Your holy sustenance you can receive:
No longer will you just fight,
Christ will defend you,
And thus, Jesus will give you much joy.
Do you want to be a faithful soldier of Christ?
Always fight for Him without fear?
Come, then, to the Savior;
It will make you a great winner,
And thus, Jesus will give you much joy.
You will be able through Christ to be a light here,
If you obey the Lord Jesus!
Oh come, today, without fear,
Accept the Savior,
And thus, Jesus will give you much joy.
chorus: I enjoy having salvation,
I enjoy your heart.
You will enjoy joy,
When you enjoy peace,
Who brought you Christ, on the bloody cross!

hymns.title: Jesus Broke My Shackles
stanzas: Jesus broke my shackles,
He bought me with blood;
My soul, from prisons,
Eternal rescued.
It is my peace, and protection,
My good Comforter;
Sure help in distress,
Medicine for pain,
I will fear no danger,
Being in Jesus;
I will no longer suffer pain;
Jesus is my light.
Jesus, Your name I will praise,
With all my heart;
I will announce joyfully to the world
Such a great salvation.
chorus: Hallelujah! Christ saves the lost sinner!
Hallelujah! Christ saves the lost with love!

hymns.title: Christ will return
stanzas: We Hallelujah will give to Christ,
When we see Him in the clouds return,
Dressed in splendor and glory,
Your chosen ones will snatch.
Behold, I am trusting in the Lord,
I gave my whole being to Jesus.
All pleasures I have left,
In Jesus Christ I have found my joy.
What will His coming be like for you?
Will it bring joy to your heart?
Or will it make you suffer even more?
Are you afraid that it will only bring you a curse?
Christ has given me the promise
That with Him, I will also reign;
Soon my Jesus will be proclaimed
Over the earth, for all: "The King".
chorus: Christ Jesus will soon return,
It will come back, it will come back,
His people come, yes, to snatch;
Jesus will soon return!

hymns.title: Holy are You, Lord
stanzas: Holy! Holy! Great eternal God,
With joy we praise You.
King of kings and Creator of the heavens.
Humiliated we adore You;
Honor and glory we aim at You,
For the veil was torn on the cross.
Worship Him earth, sky and sea;
The whole Church, its messengers,
Gathered together, come and beg
Heavenly gifts, for you are heirs
Of God, and with Jesus co-heirs
Of glory that will never end.
King of centuries, great eternal God!
You are truthful and incomprehensible,
Creator of the earth and the heavens;
You are the invisible Elder,
You dwell in the inaccessible light,
There your redeemed ones will live.
chorus: Holy forever art Thou, Lord
In battles you are the winner!

hymns.title: The veil was torn
stanzas: The veil was torn, the entrance was open:
We have confidence to enter there,
Where divine glory revealed,
Once, we couldn't aim;
By Christ, entering, we fear nothing there;
Glory shines without dazzling us;
In the light we are and we remain
Firm, calm, no longer wavering.
With you there, Lord, we meet,
For you have already taken us to the holy Father,
In whose grace accepted, we always stand,
In whose love so great draws us
To You, O Son - in You, O beloved!
And only in You do we have acceptance;
And who, having already been washed in blood,
Exempt from eternal perdition.
O God, we praise You with all our hearts,
Because you wanted to bring us closer,
When separated from You we are,
By Thy divine law, violate,
Your holy followers, consecrated,
In the blood of the blessed Savior,
Worship and adoration we present to You,
Why did you call us, oh good Lord!

hymns.title: Come, Come to Me
stanzas: Sinner listens to the voice of the Lord:
"If you are tired, come and rest;
Come, don't stop; without any fear,
Leave your burden and come and rest.”
Come to God, hungry, poor nonetheless;
There is heavenly manna, already prepared;
The party is free, for you and for me,
Christ invites you, come and you will have supper.
Are you straying far from the fold?
Stop wandering and come to the good Shepherd;
In the mountains and valleys, are there a thousand dangers?
Return to your Savior's flock.
If you believe in Christ, you will have salvation;
Joy, perfect peace, everything that is necessary;
Christ does not despise, nor will he reject
Everyone who is contrite will come to Him.
chorus: Come, come to Me and you will rest;
Take My Yoke and I will guide you;
I am humble, meek, I give You my peace;
Oh come, today, and I will save you.

hymns.title: Christ Will Come
stanzas: Perhaps Christ will come at the break of dawn,
With holy archangels, and with a sonorous voice;
He will bring the dead out of the tombs;
Jesus, soon, comes to look for us.
Perhaps he will return when the day fades,
Or one night the light shines;
Brothers, wait for Jesus to appear!
Jesus, soon, comes to look for us.
We will see His splendor and glory,
From the world, then, we will finally leave,
Thus, we will enjoy great joy in heaven;
Jesus, soon, comes to look for us.
chorus: Christ, who is to come, will come!
He will not delay, yes, Jesus is coming;
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Amen! Hallelujah! Amen!

hymns.title: In Jesus You Have the Palm of Victory
stanzas: Tempted, don't give in, giving in is sinning,
Better and nobler, will triumph,
Take courage, O believer, master your evil.
God can save you from a fatal fall.
Avoid sin, seek to please
To God, whom you must exalt in the body;
Do not stain your lips with an impure voice;
Defend your soul from atrocious addiction.
Be meek and benign, as if dead.
On the eternal rock, establish your faith;
True is your saying: is your being from God?
Wait for the crown, you can win.
chorus: In Jesus you have the palm
Of victory, my soul;
And also sweet calm
By the blood of the cross!

hymns.title: Come, O Prodigal
stanzas: Come, O prodigal, come without delay, call you God,
Hear Him calling, yes, calling you;
You, who wander around, listen to the voice of the heavens,
Oh listen to the voice of love.
With patience and tenderness the Lord calls you,
Hear Him calling, yes, calling you;
Come while the gentle Savior calls you,
Oh listen to the voice of love!
There in the Father's house, there is abundance of bread;
Hear Him calling, yes, calling you;
The table is ready with all the provisions,
Oh listen to the voice of love!
chorus: God waits for you. lost, prodigal, come;
God waits for you, lost, prodigal, come

hymns.title: Save the Contact
stanzas: Do you want, in this world, to be a winner?
Do you want to sing in struggles and pain?
Do you want to be happy, like a good fighter?
Keep in touch with your Savior!
In this world, many live in pain,
Whose hearts overflow with grief;
Give them the message of unparalleled love;
You must keep contact with God!
Do you want to obtain communion with God?
Will his glory in you always remain?
May the world see Christ in you!
Keep contact with the supreme Being.
Let the Spirit implant in your being,
The love of Christ, divine pleasure;
Do you want, in this world, all evil to win?
Keep the contact and you will have power!
chorus: Keep contact with your Savior,
And the cloud of evil will not cover you;
Along the happy path you will walk
Going in contact with your Savior.

hymns.title: My Strong Redeemer
stanzas: I wander in great darkness,
The Savior found me,
Lost, even, without salvation;
His blood washed my soul.
In my sins and vile trouble,
The light showed me, the Lord;
And made me see that there in perdition
His great love reached me.
I enjoy this great salvation,
My name is already in heaven;
And I received the divine! anointing,
That God still gives to the faithful.
On a joyful day, Christ will return,
And to heaven I will ascend;
My body transformed, so it will be,
Which is Christ Jesus. my King.
chorus: Jesus is my strong Redeemer;
He is my great Savior,
Who freed me on the cross, with much love,
Christ is my King and my Lord.

hymns.title: Your Grace is Enough for Me
stanzas: When I feel weak, I no longer have vigor,
I no longer see the brightness of the sun, of clear light;
Jesus is with me, he is my Comforter;
He never leaves me, because he always leads me.
When the storm comes against me fierce,
In the darkness sailing with my vessel,
Christ Jesus encourages me, I hear His voice;
"Behold, I am with you, why fear then?"
When the darts of the daring enemy reach me,
That cunningly seeks life to take me away,
I cry then to Christ, my true Savior,
Who gives me victory, if I trust in Him.
chorus: Your grace is enough for me, for me,
Your grace is enough for me;
In the life below, in heaven too,
Your grace is enough for me.

hymns.title: Christ Calls You
stanzas: Christ calls you, you. sinner,
He calls you, with a voice of love;
Leave your sins and come to the Lord.
Christ calls you helpful
Leave the paths of the world of horror,
Come to Jesus, come with love;
Christ saves you, come, sinner;
Christ calls you to you!
Glorious Christ will come with power;
Are you ready to ascend?
Only by His blood can you overcome.
Christ calls you to you!
The compassionate voice of the Savior,
I call you now with holy love;
Come to the source, come sinner,
Christ calls you to you!
chorus: Christ calls you, calls you!
Christ calls you, come sinner!
Christ calls you with a voice of love.
Christ calls you to you!

hymns.title: Can Save
stanzas: Only in Christ can we
Salvation receive;
New concert we have
Who wanted to die on the cross.
When you forgive sins
Life wants to grant us.
We were bought by blood
The vain way of living.
Your heart already gives
Who can save you;
And who carries the pain:
Christ can deliver you!
Christ wants to give you now
Real peace and rest;
He wants to reveal himself to you at this time:
Immense and real grace.
chorus: Can save, can save,
He takes away your sins and wants to save you,
Can save, can save,
He takes away your sins and wants to save you.

hymns.title: A Kind Savior
stanzas: A gentle Savior I have,
Whom I never knew before;
Now, joyfully, I come
Telling everyone I saw Him.
Of all, he is the most beautiful,
Image of the glory of God;
It made me happy and happy,
And heir to the glory of heaven.
If the wicked lie in wait for me.
On the path that I must follow,
Jesus will give me a good sword,
And the ties I will have to cut.
You gave me life and love,
Because You loved me,
Yes, he returned to heavenly glory,
My blessed luck, anyway.
chorus: Everyone, everyone will see,
Everyone, everyone will see;
Glorious and kind Jesus,
Yes, everyone, everyone will see.

hymns.title: I can't explain
stanzas: Closer to Jesus, I always try to get,
More beautiful than the gold of the sun, I look at You.
In thoughts, dreams, I have never seen so much glory;
For He is more beautiful than I ever predicted!
The bright morning star in my light;
The lily of the valley is the good Lord Jesus;
Soft and sweet is the smell that only comes from You;
For He is more beautiful than I ever predicted!
If sorrows come to disturb me, He has the balm;
Take me in Your arms and thus I rest well;
On the cross, Jesus took my sin upon Himself;
For He is more beautiful than I ever predicted!
chorus: I can't explain
How sweet is Jesus;
But, face to face, in Your home,
I will see You, Jesus!

hymns.title: The Great “I am”
stanzas: Do not disturb your heart,
Because I am always faithful!;
I close the "lion's" mouth,
In the grave I am with Daniel.
Whoever has the faith of Abraham,
The world will always win;
Who wants to have a firm heart.
You also need to believe.
An earthquake and wind, after.
From heaven, a fire and great fury.
Elijah heard my voice,
Voice of the Eternal, voice of love.
One day, Estêvão saw
The sky opened and saw me;
Stoned, he succumbed,
But he was faithful, until the end.
Established in Me, Eternal Rock,
Thus the believer never falls;
Seek the heavenly gift,
That comes from My Father's house.
chorus: I am the one, the great “I AM”
And where you are, I am also;
Didn't I say, a long time ago:
“I asked, I asked... it will be given”?
I asked with faith and fervor
And I will give you the Comforter.

hymns.title: Let the Spirit of God Enter
stanzas: Of the Holy Spirit, it is written,
That you are the temple, yes, the temple of God;
You have already received, after you believed,
The glorious gift descended from heaven?
What saves you also washes you,
To cleanse your soul of stains;
Cleansed from vile sins,
The Holy Spirit can now enter.
O pilgrims, see destiny,
Enter the land of milk and honey,
Sanctified, called by God,
You will be guided by a faithful guide.
chorus: Let me in, to live,
The Spirit of God;
Promised gift, already granted,
Blessed gift from the high heavens.

hymns.title: Satisfied with Christ
stanzas: Oh! 'I am satisfied with Christ,
Because He saved my soul;
And on the tree, suffering,
His great love revealed.
Oh! 'I am satisfied with Christ,
From being sad, I became happy,
Hearing His holy Gospel,
And believing in what He tells me.
Oh! 'I am satisfied with Christ,
And I know you'll be back soon;
It will come with glorious power,
In order for His people to take.
chorus: Oh! 'I am satisfied with Christ,
I confess it by my Savior:
Although nothing is worthy,
I enjoy His great love.

hymns.title: My Testimony
stanzas: I am justified;
Christ Jesus delivered me;
He is my Mediator,
Also, my good Savior.
I was sanctified,
When I prayed to Him;
He said to me: take;
Use my grace.
I was redeemed, too,
Work of my Supreme Good;
I got everything for free;
Nothing by works of law.
He gave me the promise,
From the holy Guide of heaven;
He also told me: stay,
And baptism wait.
When I sought Him,
And I was baptized,
I spoke strange tongues,
And my Lord I exalted.
Now, I'm going to work,
And many souls win;
The ones He saved
When on the cross he expired.
chorus: Jesus, I am Yours, and You are mine;
You will guide me to heaven;
With grace and peace it satisfies me
Christ, my true Master.

hymns.title: Reveal to Us Lord
stanzas: Jesus, my King, Master and Lord,
Your love reveals to me,
As long as I live here,
Until I see the end of life.
The thousand blessings of Your love,
What splendor will surround me;
Your gaze will be, Jesus,
The grateful light of the heart.
I will see your smiles shine,
If you don't walk in the vile world:
I will enjoy true pleasure,
Spring time of peace.
And when I go to heaven to live,
And rest from my days,
Happy living I will receive
From You, my King, my holy God!
chorus: Reveal to us, Lord Jesus, my Savior,
The thousand wonders of Your divine love;
And with true praise, fervent gratitude;
Lift up to YOU, Jesus Lord, our heart.

hymns.title: Sublime and Great Love
stanzas: Tell me, yes, about Jesus,
For in the mind, I record
How did you suffer
On the cross, to free me:
His passion and death,
Starting in the garden,
There was no one else who had
Such suffering!
Tell me how you felt
The rude death on the cross,
Supporting the accusation
From the enemies of the light;
Tell me how it goes
To the evildoer His peace,
Saying, "Today, with me,
You will be in Paradise."
Tell me how you cried,
Speaking to Jerusalem;
Prophets you make die,
When to you they come;
Tell me how you still cry,
Because of the sinner,
Who doesn't want His Gospel,
Proclaimed with love.
Tell me how the Lord
A good testimony he gave.
Satisfying the law,
When the cup drank;
I also said these words,
With His love so deep;
Father, forgive their blindness,
Which is typical of the sinner.
Tell me how, too,
Came to the Jewish people,
People who loved so much,
Wanting to give you the heavens;
How He still loves today
To every sinner,
Giving you peace and rest,
For the Gospel of love.
chorus: Just love! Just love!
Just love! Sublime and great love!

hymns.title: There is Peace and Joy
stanzas: There is peace and joy in the kingdom of light;
To the homeland of the redeemed, Jesus leads us,
In the kingdom of heaven there is joy and peace;
God's children have true power.
There is peace and joy in the kingdom of heaven;
The saved there sing praises to God;
Give glory to Jesus! Because he loved us;
For us His blood He shed!
Jesus has promised the Comforter!
The Holy Spirit, the instructor;
He also promised, in the kingdom of heaven,
A holy place, next to our God.
Firmed in the promise so great and effective,
Now in this world I enjoy peace;
I wait for Jesus, in the clouds to descend,
And in His glory receive me.

hymns.title: Nivea Luz
stanzas: Jesus, I long for the purity of heaven,
Your beautiful presence in my heart
I break the idols, Jesus takes me;
Oh give me the purity of the snowy light.
Jesus, help me while I deal,
Putting everything on the holy altar;
To You I surrender; I placed myself in the flames;
O give me the purity of the snowy light!
Jesus, with insistence, humbly, I prayed
May the perfect blood purity give me;
Wash me in the open fountain on the cross
O give me the purity of the snowy light!
Jesus, right now, I wait for your hand
That a good heart will create in me;
Those whom the Spirit asks of God,
You always give the purity of the snowy light!
chorus: White light, white light,
Oh give me the purity of the snowy light.

hymns.title: The Kind Savior
stanzas: My kind Savior
My sins carried;
It was Jesus, the Redeemer,
That freed me from death.
Oh! What love of my Jesus,
Who became incarnate in man,
To suffer for me, on the cross;
And my crimes forgave.
There is no other name like it
To the good name of Jesus,
Because deliver me from evil
And lead me to glory.
With Jesus, joyfully, I go
Your grace publish,
Because He called me
He came to work in Sua.
chorus: Oh! What a Savior I have!
His blood redeemed me,
When, on the rough wood,
My punishment He fulfilled.

hymns.title: There is work ready
stanzas: There is work ready for you, Christian;
That demands all your devotion;
Come, joyfully, to obey Christ,
For only you, O believer, can do it!
For every believer, the Master has prepared
A sure job, when he rescued him,
The work to which Jesus calls you here.
How will it be done, if not for you?
You may be humble, but if you are for God,
He is seen from the high heavens.
And the effort made will not be in vain
If you have Christ, full approval!
How many are lost, without salvation!
How many need consolation!
How Christ loves them, makes them understand,
Because only you, the believer, can do it!
chorus: For Jesus working,
Readily, faithfully, work!
In Serving Him, what a pleasure!
And only you, oh believer, can do it.

hymns.title: In God's Jerusalem
stanzas: When the fight of this life
Hard work if it ends,
We will say goodbye to this world;
To heaven then we will go,
With Jesus finding us
In the Jerusalem of God.
The path is long,
But Jesus will guide me,
When, through the trials here pass;
For looking at Him, I follow.
To briefly be,
In the Jerusalem of God.
As we leave this world,
For the divine! mansion,
We will enjoy perfect salvation;
And Jesus we will contemplate
Extending His hand to us,
In the Jerusalem of God.
When, united with the saved,
There in the Lord's homeland,
Let us contemplate Jesus, the Savior,
We will always rejoice
Where there is perfect love;
In the Jerusalem of God.
chorus: Oh! what joy and joy,
When the people arrive there,
In Jerusalem! In Jerusalem!
Always there singing hosannas,
For the King is on the throne,
In the Jerusalem of God.

hymns.title: Hear, O Sinner
stanzas: Hear, hear, O sinner!
Listen carefully, pay attention
To Jesus, the Savior,
Who brought forgiveness from heaven;
Hear His gentle voice;
It is worthy of acceptance.
Hear what the Lord says,
For His message of love;
"Will be free from fear
Everyone who comes to Me”;
Come to Christ, Savior,
And accept His love.
Hear, hear, O sinner!
And meditate carefully;
Leave the world deceiving;
From Jesus, you will have forgiveness;
He says, “Whoever believes in Me,
There must be Salvation.”
I have heard, my friends,
Do not hesitate;
Come to the Son, even of God;
Give Him your heart;
He says, “Whoever believes in Me,
There will be no condemnation.”

hymns.title: Let the Light Penetrate
stanzas: If you fear fighting the enemy,
If you are in darkness and have no power,
May the beautiful light of God shine within you;
And you will be happy like that.
If your faith is weak in the Lord,
And you show no fruit or any fervor,
May the beautiful light of God shine in you
And you will be happy like that.
If we are in the light, what a divine light!
If the blood of Jesus always cleanses us,
We have clarity in our hearts,
And we live in the light.
If from God, the Comforter Spirit,
Brings the light from heaven, divine radiance,
Penetrating Him into your heart.
Then you will live on love.
If you happily go to the unmatched mansion,
Oh face the darkness, which will move away,
May the beautiful light of God shine within you,
And you will be happy like that.
chorus: Let the light penetrate!
Let the light penetrate!
May the beautiful light of God shine within you;
And you will be happy like that.

hymns.title: There is a Holy Way
stanzas: There is a holy path, to the sky of full light,
Sometimes thorny, it leads us to glory;
It is the right path for every sinner;
Jesus is the Savior, Jesus is the Savior.
There is unshakable peace for those who are in the light;
For an incomparable price
bought me Jesus
The gift of the beloved Father satisfies my soul,
Jesus is my peace, Jesus is my peace.
There is a power that heals the sad heart,
That gives relief to the soul, peace and consolation,
And keep my garment, too, in snowy light;
Power of my Jesus, power of my Jesus!
There is a glorious end, beyond the dark veil;
At the end of the thorny path is heaven;
And when the veil of darkness is removed,
I will see Jesus then, I will see Jesus then.

hymns.title: Will you be watching?
stanzas: Will you be watching when Jesus comes?
Anxious, waiting, when Jesus comes?
Will you hear the welcome when Jesus comes?
Will you shout smiling when Jesus comes?
Do you just hope to prepare yourself when Jesus comes?
What will be your part when Jesus comes?
Will you be joyful when Jesus comes?
Sad or hopeful when Jesus comes?
Oh! What a glorious service, when Jesus comes!
Full of sublime joy, when Jesus comes!
chorus: Oh! What a night! Solemn night!
Will your light shine when Jesus comes?
Oh, be ready, oh, be ready!
Oh, be ready, when Jesus comes.
Oh, be ready, oh, be ready!
Oh be ready when Jesus comes!

hymns.title: Behold the Day to Decline
stanzas: Here is the day to decline,
Invites us to meditate
In Your great great love,
O blessed Savior,
And praise you!
Glorious in power!
Infinite in knowing!
The fullest perfection
In justice and forgiveness
You make us see!
In the deep darkness,
Hear our petition,
Come protect your children,
And always be sure to have them
In Your hand.
When everything finally passes,
Heavens, stars, land and sea,
By the cross of the Savior,
Make us in Your great love,
Be with you!
chorus: Holy! Holy! Holy Lord of heaven
Let the whole earth praise thee;
In heaven, everything worships you,
Kind God!

hymns.title: The Good Comforter
stanzas: Who wants to go, through Jesus, to proclaim new
In dens of affliction, misery, evil and pain?
Christians, announce that the Father wants to pour
The good Comforter.
In the world of horror, the light finally shone
Who came to dispel the shadows of terror;
Our Father also sent His faithful
The good Comforter.
It is the Comforter who brings salvation
To those who imprisoned the great tempter:
Say that he has come now, with all his heart,
The good Comforter.
Oh! Great eternal love! Oh! Divine enjoyment!!
What do I have to proclaim the gift of my Lord
For it already lives in me, heavenly power,
The good Comforter.
chorus: The good Comforter, the good Comforter
That God promised us, the world has already descended;
Oh, go proclaim that God wants to pour out
The good Comforter.

hymns.title: The Royal Anointing
stanzas: The Lord has not left us as orphans,
But as you promised us,
He sent us the good Comforter,
Who filled us with the power of heaven,
Of His divine love!
O believers, God also invites you
To come seek His power;
And to everyone, who humble comes
The Holy Guest will receive:
Praying obtains.
A Pentecost, Jesus promised,
To each one's heart;
Prostrate, let us pray to God,
With faith. in powerful prayer,
To become the power of heaven.
chorus: You have already received the royal anointing
Of the Consoling Spirit?
God wants to use you to save others,
If you receive the Comforter.

hymns.title: Believe in the Promise
stanzas: Today, Jesus can save you;
Just believe in the promise;
From your sins cleanse;
Just believe in the promise.
From above, Jesus will give power;
Just believe in the promise;
In His joy you will overcome;
Just believe in the promise.
His grace comes to receive;
Just believe in the promise;
Jesus wants to give you everything.
Just believe in the promise.
Come and receive peace from the Lord,
Just believe in the promise;
You will be full of the Comforter.
Just believe in the promise.
chorus: Believe in the promise of Jesus,
Just believe in the promise;
Blessing from heaven, life in flux!
Just believe in the promise.

hymns.title: Let us walk in the Light
stanzas: There is a light, blessed light,
That comes to us from the heavens;
The face of the Lord Jesus
It reflects the love of God.
There is a glorious light
Guiding our walk,
In the holy steps of Jesus,
'We're just going to get home.
There is a light, the holy light
In which we can see
In the beautiful sky, glory flows,
That we will receive.
In holy and blessed light.
Surrounded by splendor,
He who died on the cross will come,
Our beloved Lord.
chorus: Let us walk in the light
Let us walk in the light of God.
Let us walk in the light
Let us walk in the light of God.

hymns.title: Jesus Looks for the Sheep
stanzas: Behold, Jesus looked for the sheep, which wandered
He strayed from the fold of the Lord;
Through the mountains suffering, whether it's sunny or raining,
Christ seeks His sheep, with love.
With His feet the good Shepherd, already wounded, what a horror,
To descend into the dark rocks,
And tired of walking, even more, still crying:
“O my sheep, where are you?”
If you hear the sheep moaning, what a pleasure
Fill the heart of the good Shepherd immediately!
And running without stopping, 'til the sheep hugs,
And bring her to His shoulder with love.
Already at home, the Shepherd, Oh! Rejoice with sweetness,
For the stray sheep he found;
And so, also Jesus, with the angels there in the light,
Rejoice for the souls you saved!
chorus: With love..., the Pastor...
Behold, He calls His sheep, without ceasing;
May today, the sinner
listen to the voice of love,
Of Jesus, who seeks to save.

hymns.title: The Glorious Hope
stanzas: You have in you, O sinner,
The glorious hope?
And Christ your trust,
What sustains you with vigor?
Mine is Jesus, oh Jesus, it's Jesus,
Mine is Jesus,
That gives me security.
If nothing else satisfies you,
Here in the world, oh lost one,
And if you feel down,
What will your peace be?
Mine is Jesus, it's Jesus, Jesus,
Mine is Jesus,
That doesn't leave me helpless.
And when your end comes,
And cover you with the veil of death,
What will your luck be?
Will you suffer? Will you cum?
Mine is Jesus, it's Jesus, it's Jesus,
Mine is Jesus,
That turned me from weak to strong.
Come to Jesus, come sinner,
Come take your first step;
How strong is your arm,
What will make you a winner?
Mine is Jesus, it's Jesus, it's Jesus,
Mine is Jesus,
For her I break all ties.

hymns.title: Long live Christ
stanzas: Long live Christ, eternal wealth,
My shield, life and steadfastness,
Your grace - Oh! make me
Shine in His love.
Long live Christ, rock already chosen,
The pure and perfect truth;
My livelihood - great contentment,
That makes me walk in the light.
Long live Christ, my eternal luck;
My treasure is after death;
Comfort me, encourage me
Living in perfection.
Long live Christ, the Lord of glory,
That always gives victory to believers,
And the promised life,
Who, for us, won on the cross.
Long live Christ, Leader of the saints!
Long live Christ, I sing strongly!
Because he loves me and pours
In my being, heavenly peace.

hymns.title: Stand firm on promises
stanzas: Standing firm in the promises of my Savior,
I will sing praises to my Creator;
I remain in the dispensation of Your love,
Firm in the promises of Jesus.
Firm in my promises, I will not fail,
When the storms come to ravage me;
For the living Word, I will fight.
Firm in the promises of Jesus.
Firm in promises, I always see it this way,
Purification in the blood, for me;
Full freedom in Jesus without end.
Firm in the promises of Jesus.
Firm in the promises of the Lord Jesus,
In love linked with His cross.
Every day I rejoice more in the light.
Firm in the promises of Jesus.
chorus: Steady, Steady,
Firm in the promises of Jesus, the Christ;
Firm, firm,
Yes, stand firm in the promises of Jesus.

hymns.title: Fight for Jesus
stanzas: For Jesus we will fight,
Continuing our walk;
And with Him, then, in heaven,
We will enjoy peace.
In Jesus we have power;
Let us move forward, without fear;
Trusting in His love.
We will fight, until we win.
Believers, look to Jesus,
By faith, always, yes, fight;
The enemy, o fight;
I announced the Gospel.
Scripture tells us this:
That Jesus is for you and me,
The path, the true light,
That takes us to heaven, anyway.
chorus: Let us all fight against evil,
And let us follow Jesus;
He is our General
And the glory of the future!

hymns.title: Come to Jesus
stanzas: If anyone desires, come to Jesus,
Water and bread of life, He leads you.
The hand reaches out to him, asks him for light,
If anyone wishes, come.
If anyone desires, peace will be enjoyed;
Christ who calls you will set you free;
With His holy arms He will embrace you
If anyone wishes, come!
If someone wishes, he will not die,
For eternal life will always be enjoyed;
This is the promise that Jesus gives you.
If anyone wishes, come!
chorus: If anyone wants, if anyone wants,
Come today and receive forgiveness,
For Jesus calls you, oh, he does not call in vain,
If anyone wishes, come!

hymns.title: Cry out: Jesus, Jesus!
stanzas: O cry out in tribulation: Jesus, Jesus.
With all your heart: Jesus, Jesus,
Surely he will help you: Jesus, Jesus,
And he will give you joy and peace: Jesus, Jesus.
Do you want a good Savior? Jesus, Jesus,
Who loves the vile sinner? Jesus, Jesus,
And who has the power to save? Jesus, Jesus,
And for heaven to take you? Jesus, Jesus.
There is one who can heal you: Jesus, Jesus.
And keep you from corruption: Jesus. Jesus.
Only one name gives salvation: Jesus, Jesus.
Joy, peace, forgiveness: Jesus, Jesus.
Accept, in your heart: Jesus, Jesus;
