Thus, you will have salvation, Jesus, Jesus;
Embrace, with tender love: Jesus, Jesus;
Who cries for you, sinner, Jesus, Jesus.

hymns.title: What a Change!
stanzas: What a change my good Jesus made in me,
Coming to my heart
He gave me divine peace, he gave me joy and light,
Entering Him into my heart.
I was lost, Jesus saved me,
Entering my heart
My countless sins, His blood washed away,
Coming to my heart!
And now, from heaven, certainty gave me,
Entering my heart
His Spirit, the seal and pledge bestowed,
Coming to my heart.
I don't fear passing through the valley of death!
With Him in my heart;
The celestial city will transport me,
The guard of my heart.
chorus: Entering my heart!
Entering my heart!
What a change in me
My good Jesus did,
Coming to my heart.

hymns.title: The Sovereign Name
stanzas: There is no on earth and heaven either,
A name with sweetness,
As this one to whom praise befits,
Of every creature.
Descending into the world, the light from heaven
He dressed in a human body;
To the holy Son, then, was given
The sovereign name.
Delivered to death on the cross,
Above it was written
The lovely name of Jesus,
For us, damn there.
From death the great winner
The hand of the Father sitting,
For us He is intercessor,
And the only Lawyer.
Jesus, my tender Savior,
You are my hope,
I trust only in Your love;
And get me to safety.
chorus: Jesus, the light is You from heaven!
Jesus, our beloved)
Jesus, the true God,
Exalted by all!

hymns.title: The Celestial Director
stanzas: Day by day comes to guide me
My Jesus and my Lord!
I'm not mine because you bought me
With Your redeeming blood;
I want you to live together,
For life until the end;
May it become so true,
“No longer I, but Christ in me.”
May it become so true.
“No longer I, but Christ in me.”
Every moment comes to guide me.
The heavenly Director!
You have already made an address in me,
You are my Dominator;
o transform my life;
May your will be mine;
I want to walk, step by step,
Trusting in Your power.
I want to walk, step by step,
Trusting in Your power.
If greater intimacy
For me it is possible;
I want to be attracted more
To you, sweet Savior!
Oh! Let it remain in You, dwelling
My secret pavilion,
Hidden, entirely,
In You, my salvation,
Hidden, entirely,
In You, my salvation.

hymns.title: Accept Jesus’ Forgiveness
stanzas: If you are tired of sinning,
Accept Jesus' forgiveness.
If you want to find a new life,
Accept Jesus’ forgiveness,
If you wish to obtain a pure life,
Accept Jesus' forgiveness.
He is the source that cleanses your being;
Accept Jesus' forgiveness.
If you can't calm your struggles,
Accept Jesus’ forgiveness,
If your desires cannot be tamed,
Accept Jesus' forgiveness.
If you want to unite with the saints,
Accept Jesus' forgiveness.
If you wish to go to heaven,
Accept Jesus' forgiveness.
chorus: Come to Jesus, sinner.
For you he died there on the cross.
It's time, come without fear;
Accept Jesus' forgiveness.

hymns.title: Work and Pray
stanzas: I want to work for my Lord,
Taking the Word with love;
I want to sing and pray,
And I want to be busy,
Yes, in the vineyard of the Lord.
I want to work every day;
Slaves of sin free;
Lead them to Jesus,
Our guide, our light,
Yes, in the vineyard of the Lord.
I want to be a valuable worker,
Trusting in the power of the Savior;
If you want to work,
You will also find a place,
Yes, in the vineyard of the Lord.
chorus: Work and pray.
In the harvest and in the vineyard of the Lord;
My desire is to pray,
And busy I want to be
Yes, in the vineyard of the Lord.

hymns.title: I'm free
stanzas: I wandered the path of horror,
Oppressed by sin and fear.
When the Savior I saw,
I heard your tender voice,
My Jesus set me free by His love.
I wandered the path of horror.
Not thinking about the Savior's love;
I wandered without having light,
Far from the Lord Jesus,
But freed, today I sing praise to God.
I wandered the path of horror,
But now I want to walk with my Lord,
I want to hear Your tender voice,
And follow Him always after,
Glory be given to our good Shepherd.
chorus: I'm free! I'm free!
By the grace of Jesus I am free;
I'm free! I'm free!
Hallelujah! By faith, I am free!

hymns.title: The Lord Saves Every Sinner
stanzas: Hallelujah! The Lord saves every sinner!
Salvation! Salvation!
Jesus Christ has the power to overcome all evil,
Salvation! Salvation!
I trust in Jehovah, He gives holiness;
Salvation! Salvation!
I have peace and I live now, His grace is in me.
Salvation! Salvation!
I will always speak what I know, exalting my King,
Salvation! Salvation!
For His blood has already shed, to make me His son,
Salvation! Salvation!
We will sing, always there, when we leave here;
Salvation! Salvation!
Exalting the Savior, we will praise with fervor
Salvation! Salvation!
chorus: Salvation and redemption!
Hallelujah! Christ has already loved me and saved me.
I give glory and hallelujah, to Jesus who saved me.

hymns.title: Face to Face
stanzas: In the presence of Christ,
In His glory, that will be;
There in heaven, in full joy,
My soul will see Him.
Oh! what a glory it will be to see Him;
May I aim at Him!
Behold, soon the day cometh;
That His glory will show.
How much joy there is in Christ,
When there is no more pain,
When the danger ceases,
And enjoy full love.
Face to face, how glorious
There must be existence,
Seeing the face of those who came,
Our souls redeem.
chorus: Face to face, I hope to see Him;
In the beyond the sky of light;
Face to face in full glory,
I will see my Jesus.

hymns.title: Inexhaustible is Your Love
stanzas: May the good Savior be praised
Free is His love, free is His love.
There is prepared for the sinner,
Precious source of love;
And if you want to trust in Christ,
Free is His love, free is His love;
You will enjoy eternal life,
Inexhaustible is His love.
Why should you be living in sin?
Free is His love, free is His love.
Christ calls you, come without delay,
Inexhaustible is His love;
Leave darkness for divine light,
Free is His love, free is His love;
Today Jesus wants to free you from evil,
Inexhaustible is His love.
Oh! If you believe, you will receive forgiveness,
Free is His love, free is His love;
The moment comes when you will bless;
Inexhaustible is His love;
Christ awaits you, listen to the call;
Free is His love, free is His love;
Faith in His name will save you.
Inexhaustible is His love.
chorus: Suit, his name is Jesus: do you want to go?
O sinner, O sinner!
He left for us, as he ascended,
Precious source of love.

hymns.title: Night of Peace
stanzas: Night of peace, night of love;
Everything sleeps around!
Among the stars that scatter light
Bela, indicating the baby Jesus,
Shine the star of peace,
Shine the star of peace.
Night of peace, night of love;
Listen to the faithful shepherd
Celestial choirs that sing peace,
That this sublime night brings us,
Our good Redeemer,
Our good Redeemer.
Night of peace, night of love;
Oh! What a beautiful glow.
It hovers over the face of sweet Jesus!
And in the nativity scene of the world, the light!
Star of eternal brilliance,
Star of eternal brilliance.

hymns.title: Wonderful is Jesus
stanzas: Wonderful is Jesus,
From my life the light,
For saving me, forgiving me,
Lead me to Zion.
I could never know,
What is the great pleasure,
Someone who is lost, regretful,
Grace comes to receive.
He found me in the darkness,
Forever loved me;
Abundant life, I enjoy it a lot.
I have someone who saved me.
Christ is everything to me,
It will also be for you;
I walk, always praising Him,
For He saved me!
chorus: Wonderful, yes, wonderful!
It is Christ, for he saved me!
Wonderful and most glorious,
It is Christ, who lives in me.

hymns.title: Divine Fire
stanzas: Divine fire, we cry out to you;
Come from above, come, come down here;
Oh, come and awaken us with your brilliance;
Come inflame us with your heat.
Come down, Consoling Spirit,
Come down and fill us with holy love,
Come down to the world, show us Jesus;
Give us power, life, grace and light.
Burn in my soul, oh flame of love
It burns in my chest and gives me value;
Consume all the remains of evil;
Come down now, you Pentecostal fire!
chorus: Come down from above, blessed fire,
Heavenly power descends!
Come down from above, blessed fire,
Come, call Pentecostal!

hymns.title: Christ will return
stanzas: One day, Christ will return;
When he ascended, he promised it;
It will come as it rose;
You will see King Jesus, His people.
The messengers of the Lord,
They claim that Jesus will come;
And the comforting power
The faithful promises will reveal to us.
Oh! enjoyment without comparison
On my Savior's day,
With the very large crowd,
We will rise to meet the Lord.
Welcome, my Lord,
In Your glorious light;
And our faith will have value;
We say: “Now, come Lord Jesus”.
chorus: Very soon, Jesus will come,
His people will see Him joyful;
Watching, everyone must always be,
In order to see Him return.

hymns.title: Worship
stanzas: Worship the King of the Universe!
Earth and heavens, sing His praise!
Every being in the great submerged sea,
Praise the Dominator!
Worship Him, mighty angels,
You who behold His glory!
You, redeemed, already victorious;
Thanks, I gave Him more!
Sun and moon, stellar choirs,
Your majesty announces,
Large hosts, hundreds of thousands,
Show His power!
Winds! Rains! Damn! Thunderstorms!
Reveal the strong Creator!
You say, O high mountains,
How great is my Lord!
Tall cedars! Green grass!
This symphony I increased;
Birds, worms, every giant being;
Thank you to God, praise!
Men! Young people! Old men and boys!
Worship your Redeemer!
Kings and wise men, great ones, little ones,
Give Him true praise!
chorus: Let us all praise Him together!
Great Savior and Redeemer!
Let us all praise Him!
Regal Dominator!

hymns.title: I wish I could come today!
stanzas: Our Savior comes again;
I wish I could come today!
To reign with power and love!
I wish I could come today!
Now for His Wife, come this time;
Who awaits Him in prayer;
Out of the world of entremez;
I wish I could come today!
The power of evil will end;
I wish it could be today!
Unparalleled pleasure will begin;
I wish it could be today!
All the dead in Christ will be
Raptured by their Lord;
When will these glories come here?
I wish it could be today!
In holiness he must find us,
Behold, He can come.
All, watching, with joy and peace,
Behold, He can come.
The signs are multiplied;
In the east you see the dawn;
Soon, the believers will rise;
I wish I could come today!
chorus: Glory, glory, endless joy, he will bring;
Glory, glory, in crowning the fiei;
Glory, glory, will take us away;
Glory, glory! Christ comes again!

hymns.title: Blessedness of the Believer
stanzas: Blessed is he who trusts
In the Lord, as Abraham did;
He believed, even though he did not see,
And so, faith was not in vain.
Happy is he who faithfully follows
In the holy ways of the Lord,
In tribulation he is patient,
Waiting on your Savior.
The heroes of the Holy Bible,
They didn't enjoy their trophies right away;
But they always carried the heavy cross,
To obtain power from the heavens,
And then they went out into the world,
As messengers of the Lord,
With courage and deep love,
Proclaiming Christ the Savior.
Whoever wants from God to have the crown,
You will go through more tribulation;
No one flies to holy heights,
Without the wings of humiliation;
The Lord has given to His dear ones,
Part of His glorious being;
Whoever in the heart is most wounded,
There will be more of that glory.
When the flowers here already fade,
Those in the sky begin to shine;
When hopes fade,
The afflicted believer will pray;
The most beautiful hymns and poems,
They were written in tribulation,
And from the sky, the beautiful melodies,
They heard each other, in the darkness.
Yes, you trust, completely;
In the immense grace of the Lord;
Let discouragement be far from you
And trust in His holy love.
Hallelujah be the motto,
Of the hero and all the victor;
And from the strongest sky comes the breeze,
That takes you to the bosom of the Lord.

hymns.title: The Lord of the Harvest Calls
stanzas: The Lord of the harvest is calling:
“Whoever wants to go looking for Me
Souls that in the world are crying;
Without participating in salvation?”
The prophet to God approaching,
Consider yourself a sinner,
But, the holy fire burning him,
Make him useful to his Lord.
Many are those who expire
Without hope of seeing God:
Go quickly and announce to them,
May Jesus take them to heaven.
The work will soon be finished,
Blessings will the servants enjoy;
And Jesus will greet them: “Welcome”,
This glory I hope to achieve.
chorus: Speak God! Speak God!
Touch me with coals from the altar;
Speak God! Speak God!
Yes, joyfully, I obey Your command.

hymns.title: Give Your Heart
stanzas: O sad, lost soul,
What vacancies without direction!
Accept life from God,
Give your heart!
Jesus doesn't want your money;
Freely gives you salvation!
And I enjoy it very true:
Give your heart!
Of the risen Christ
Accept true forgiveness,
If you want to be freed,
Give your heart away.
Now is the acceptable time
The day when there is salvation.
To Christ, sweet, adorable
Give your heart away.
chorus: Give, today, to Christ,
Your heart, your heart.
For in Him you will find peace, forgiveness,
Give your heart away.
Give, today, to Christ,
Your heart, your heart.
For in Him I would find peace, forgiveness,
Give your heart away.

hymns.title: The Savior Fountain
stanzas: O sinner, come to the fountain,
With your burden of pain,
Come and bury him in the waters;
You will find peace in the Lord.
How are you, come to the source,
Jesus is waiting;
And your stained soul
White and pure it will be.
The Savior does not despise
Whoever, repentant, believes.
Eternal life waiting
From His hands receive.
Come and be healed at the source;
Jesus wants to give you peace;
Come, humbled and contrite,
Purify your soul.
chorus: Come quickly, come quickly!
You don't want to miss just one moment;
Jesus hopes to save you;
Mercy to you, He has.

hymns.title: Christ is Mine!
stanzas: Meek Shepherd already lived in the world and He is mine,
Giving us life, He suffered for us and He is mine;
Grace so vast I cannot fathom, but He is mine.
I am forgiven, I can now sing that He is mine.
There is a friend of unparalleled love and He is mine;
Always the strongest, the most firm and loyal and He is mine.
I am so unworthy to be one of His, but He is mine.
I will enjoy His love, there in heaven, because He is mine.
He sent us the Comforter, it's mine too.
Full of grace, peace and love, and everything is mine.
Nothing denies me of His rich gifts, for everything is mine.
Great treasures, so pure and good, are all mine.
chorus: Christ is mine! Christ is mine!
Wonderful, but right is to say:
Jesus is mine!

hymns.title: From Value to Value
stanzas: Only in You, my Lord, do I desire to be,
And also receive Your light;
From value to value just because You advance,
Oh, bring me to You, my Jesus.
The path, Lord, makes me know more,
That takes me to holy Zion;
By Your great favor, and with great pleasure
I will enter the eternal mansion.
Your hand, O Lord! Please protect me,
And free me from the evils here;
In the morning of splendor, I too want to be
Of the faithful, who will be resurrected.
chorus: I desire, O God, to dwell in Jesus;
For my soul yearns for You;
From value to value, and in faith increase,
So that they see Christ in me.

hymns.title: Workers of the Lord
stanzas: We are workers for the Lord,
We go to the harvest, with love,
Proclaiming salvation
Of Christ and His forgiveness;
So let's work for love
Of Christ, our Savior,
That blood was shed for us,
And on Calvary he expired.
The Gospel, preach,
To everyone, yes, call,
And, without fear, the news comes
And raise the flag
In our hands God trusted,
The grace that sent us.
Give the news, do not waver,
May you obtain victory.
The hours will soon pass,
And they will never come to you again,
If you don't talk about Jesus,
Some will never see the light.
Even today there is forgiveness,
The world lies in perdition,
Oh! do not despise the favor
From the loving Savior.
chorus: Come to the harvest now, for Jesus calls you;
“Everyone must work,” the Lord proclaims,
Soon, everything will end, you will not be able to harvest;
Come believers, come work.

hymns.title: In the book list
stanzas: Your name, written in full, is in the heavens
In the book of the Lamb, in the book of the good God,
We will have victory, looking at the Lord;
For this, we give glory and great praise.
Joyful we walk in the grace of the Lord;
And in her we find consoling power!
From Christ we receive help and strength;
Forward, let us march, without any more fear.
We creatures are redeemed by Jesus,
In which we were elected, to enjoy the light,
We have, as our inheritance, Jesus in the high heavens,
Also the hope of seeing God.
Happy, let us raise our eyes to the heavens,
We already have writings, the names, there by God;
Feeling great joy, serving the Lord,
To the Almighty, to the Redeemer.
chorus: Your name written, brother, is by God,
In the book of life, in the list of His children,
Your name written, brother, is in heaven;
Oh! glory, hallelujah! Amen.

hymns.title: Jesus at the Door of the Heart
stanzas: Who is beating like that,
What fills me with emotion?
Who will look for me?
I feel it beating in my heart.
Who will it be? Who could it be?
I feel it beating in my heart!
What will I do? What am I going to do?
I'm in the valley of the decision.
Who do I hear me knocking?
- I am Jesus, the good Jesus:
Open quickly, without fear
I want to give you my light.
Come in, come in, Savior,
My heart I want to give you,
Only in you did I find love,
Even in me you want to live.
chorus: Whoever knocks says gently:
I am Jesus, I came to save you;
Open up, hard heart,
Inside you I want to have dinner.

hymns.title: The Precious Name
stanzas: Your name is precious, beloved Savior,
And great, glorious, fills us with love,
We all worship You with true faith,
We also humble ourselves, at Your holy feet.
Your name is sacred, it gives us consolation;
Through Him, real forgiveness was given to us from heaven;
Revive hope, increase our love,
Give firm confidence and more of Your vigor.
Your name is our life and peace, O Savior!
The ark offered to the poor sinner;
Blessed by Him is the whole nation,
That she was predestined to a great vocation.
chorus: How many promised blessings
In Your name, O Savior!
Today I have life. Grace is granted,
In Your name, O Savior!

hymns.title: Jesus, Our Help
stanzas: Come to our help, oh come, Jesus!
For great sadness dims our light;
We turn to You, come and give us strength,
Cover us all with Your great love!
Come to our help, oh come Jesus!
In You we trust, You are our light;
Always protect us from the vile tempter,
Cover us all with Your great love!
Come to our help, oh come, Jesus!
Fight the enemy with Your light;
To You we cry, answer, Lord,
Cover us all with Your great love!
Come to our help, oh come, Jesus!
Full victory leads us today;
Give us Your grace, power and worth.
Cover us all with Your great love!

hymns.title: Freed from Slavery
stanzas: In Babylon, in prison,
There was Israel,
The holy people of Zion,
Suffering cruel pain.
"Sing" said the Chaldeans,
The hymns of Zion,
But this made me sadder,
The children of Abraham.
Freedmen went there for God
From vile slavery.
And every soul was filled,
Of laughter and gratitude.
How great things God has done for us!
They were already singing. then;
And what a dream it seemed
Return to Zion.
And in this world, like Babel,
There are many in prison,
Suffering cruel pain,
No consolation.
chorus: But one day, he heard,
That the voice came from the king
To return from slavery.
All the people in Jubilee,
With the harps singing,
He went in search of Zion.

hymns.title: The one who knocks is Jesus Christ
stanzas: If you are terrified of death,
And salvation you desire,
Return to the arms of the Lord,
So that you may be saved;
Open your heart wide,
And receive salvation,
Without any disturbance;
The one who knocks is Jesus Christ.
He already suffered for you, on the cross,
To give you life;
The divine and good Jesus
There are marks from the wounds;
You don't see him sobbing,
And His blood dripping?
Won't you let Him in?
The one who knocks is Jesus Christ.
If you walk in fear;
Far from the beloved Father,
Who will be your protector,
When evil comes?
Follow the one who died on the cross,
For life leads you;
He will give you light in the darkness,
The one who knocks is Jesus Christ.
chorus: You must give Him shelter.
There is no danger;
Christ just wants to save you;
At the table, dine with you.

hymns.title: Jesus, My Eternal Redeemer
stanzas: The Son of God is now descended from heaven;
The perfect work on the cross was completed;
And there His flesh, torn like a veil,
A living path to heaven has consecrated us.
Through Adam, sin entered the world;
No one could free themselves from this law;
But the Son of Man triumphed for us,
In Him we can rise from evil.
From hell, which pays the wicked, it will give,
From the fear of death, that cruel dart,
He can save you from the eternal abyss,
Only Jesus Christ, the good Emmanuel.
Very happy we seek the homeland of love,
Which God in heaven prepared for us,
Where we will always see our Lord,
Christ Jesus, who freed us from evil.
chorus: Jesus is my eternal Redeemer!
By His blood I am redeemed;
He gave me peace, comforting power;
I live content, because He loved me.

hymns.title: The Security of the Believer
stanzas: I will fear no evil,
In me is Jesus:
I will never be disturbed,
Because I already live in the light.
Jesus brought me salvation;
Also, he told me this:
Look for me in tribulation,
To have peace in Me.
On the great feast of forgiveness,
In His real power,
Granted me admission,
Who wanted to die for me.
I already have a living faith,
That will not confuse;
The love of God, how pure it is,
You will fill me with peace.
chorus: I feel very deep peace at last,
I feel peace from the cross,
By faith I feel living in me,
My Jesus, my Jesus.

hymns.title: Always guide me, My Lord
stanzas: Where will my Lord guide me,
I will follow, for His love;
It is Your hand that leads me,
Wounded for me on the cross.
I find pleasure in following You;
Rest and peace makes me feel;
Your desire is sweet to me,
Joy brings me to obey You.
I follow my Lord without fear
Who filled me with His love;
Feeling His hand close,
I can sing in the dark.
To His kingdom lead me,
Through the garden and the cross;
There the old "I" remained dead,
There my spirit revived.
chorus: Always guide me, my Lord,
Guide my steps, Savior;
You bought me on the cross;
Rule me in everything, my Jesus.

hymns.title: The Celestial City
stanzas: O heavenly Zion, rest of the saints,
Your architect is called the LORD;
We will enter into you, with joy and singing,
With those who adore the good Savior,
On a beautiful plain you are situated,
And what a majestic queen you are!
You are adorned with precious stones;
You demonstrate the glory of Christ Jesus.
Of Christ Jesus. of Christ Jesus.
You demonstrate the glory of Christ Jesus.
Your beautiful paths treated with zeal,
And your towers, what views they will make!
Of all palaces, grand is the model;
In you we will have consolation;
The doors in the wall are all beautiful;
The square is paved with gold than light;
In you these things are very glorious,
And you are completely filled with the peace of Jesus!
From the peace of Jesus, from the peace of Jesus.
And you are completely filled with the peace of Jesus.
There will never be any night in you,
Thy great everlasting light shall be;
Without the light of the sun, stars or moon.
The glory of Christ will illuminate you.
And in this splendor, of a true sun,
The saints and angels of heaven will enter,
And Jesus, the Lamb, will come first;
With Him they will reign forever.
There they will reign, there they will reign,
With Him they will reign forever.
Oh! what a great feast we are granted,
With the table set, wait for the Lord,
To everyone inscribed in the book of life,
And they no longer fear death;
Of all who were purchased by Christ,
The beautiful procession will be;
And God, who gave His beloved Son,
With Christ in glory, he will comfort them,
He will comfort them, he will comfort them,
With Christ in glory, he will console them.

hymns.title: The True Friend
stanzas: You are my true friend,
Only in You, my Redeemer, will I trust,
Defend me from the world, from danger;
Anxiously, I want to find You.
Come now, Lord, with Your immense grace
Help me carry my cross,
Making me feel real presence,
From the Divine Comforter, O Jesus!
Jesus, You are my hope,
And gladly I desire to follow Thee;
Praying to You, with perseverance,
So that you always keep me from falling.
chorus: Come take me close
From Your big and kind heart;
Always forward and right,
With Jesus, I'm walking to Zion.

hymns.title: Come to the Assembly of God
stanzas: To the Assembly of God, come with me,
Listen to the Word of God;
And you will be sure, with you,
That Jesus is the way to heaven.
Come, brother, to the Assembly of Saints,
Feel the power of the Lord
And there sing beautiful songs
Exulting in the Comforter.
In the Assembly of God you are
Humble at the feet of the Lord:
Holiness befits the Church,
To enjoy heavenly love.
We feel the holy presence
From our dear Jesus;
Your sentence was annulled:
Leave the darkness and come to the light.
chorus: Oh come, come, come, come!
Come to the Assembly and let us praise
To our good Redeemer God,
For we have no greater joy,
May we enjoy His immense love.

hymns.title: Union of the Believer With His Lord
stanzas: My soul loves You, O Lord!
And faints thirsty for love;
my consolation in affliction,
And perfect light in the darkness;
My real bread.
My soul loves You, O Lord!
Always long to walk in Your fear:
You already live in my heart
And you guide me by Your hand;
You are my salvation.
My soul loves You, O Lord!
Your face seeks with fervor:
I wish to have heavenly peace,
The holy joy, which satisfies,
And true salvation.
My soul loves You, O Lord!
For me you suffered incomparable pain;
I want to praise your name here;
Thy precepts and laws honor,
And always think of You.
chorus: My soul loves You; Lord,
From You you only receive life and love!

hymns.title: Bright path
stanzas: I go along a bright path,
Of majestic light;
Along the path you've already walked,
Our Lord Jesus;
Without remembering what happened,
Well happy singing, yes,
For I am the son of the King of kings:
Christ is mine, finally;
I have no more pleasure in the world,
I am purified,
I will never perish,
For Jesus delivered me;
He loves me and wants me well,
Everything is for me;
In Him I find praise, too.
Christ is mine, finally.
Who will separate me from Jesus?
I have Him in my heart;
He in the darkness will guide me
To happy Zion.
Always happy, without wavering,
I overcome evil, like this;
I'm happy to walk in the light.
Christ is mine, finally.
chorus: Mine, finally; mine, finally!
Christ freed me from death, yes!
Heard me, redeemed me,
Christ is mine, finally!

hymns.title: Serve Jesus
stanzas: I want to serve You, O my King Jesus,
And with you always walk in the light,
Having communion with the people of God
And from my sins cleansing.
In Your good service I take pleasure.
I will receive much grace in Him;
I will always talk like this about Your love.
And I will glorify You, my Savior.
Bring down Your grace upon me, Lord,
To work with more and more fervor,
Give me understanding and truth to know,
For joy, I do Your will.
Only in You do I trust, my Lord and King;
Only in You will I achieve victory.
And with you I always want to live here,
'You must come to Zion and welcome me.
chorus: Yes, O my Lord;
I want to follow You, O God of love.
Always serving you,
And also giving You praise.

hymns.title: I will bless Jesus
stanzas: I will praise my wise Guide,
I will praise, I will praise;
I will bless, with soul and lips,
I will bless Jesus.
I will praise those who support me,
I will praise, I will praise;
Nothing from Him separates me;
I will bless Jesus.
To those who take my care,
I will praise, I will praise;
Support my tired feet,
I will bless Jesus.
Whoever gives me victory here,
I will praise, I will praise;
Give me the crown and glory;
I will bless Jesus.
My sublime glorious King,
I will praise, I will praise;
In heavenly chorus and joy.
I will bless Jesus.
chorus: Hallelujah! I praise Jesus!
He gave me salvation on the cross!
Hallelujah to those who lead me!
Glory to my Jesus!

hymns.title: Fisherman's Corner
stanzas: In my boat rowing.
Over the waves, across the sea,
Even in good times or in hurricanes
I no longer wish to stop;
With the net I will fish,
Many fish for the kingdom of Zion,
My boat is no good,
I have no talent for fishing.
And they tell me that I shouldn't continue;
But Jesus wanted to send me,
And that's why I'm going fishing,
He must be pleased to call me.
The Lord has a way.
Which is characteristic of love,
He uses the least of the redeemed,
Everyone left me,
And he was ashamed of me,
But happy, I'm going fishing, because it's better.
If there is something of value,
And the network of love,
Whose uncle is the work of Jesus,
What a pull it always brings
The lost and without peace,
To receive light from the Lord.
When there is a storm,
And the fishing is bad,
I'm going fishing again on my boat!
Maybe this time,
I don't have any more setbacks
Because I take Jesus to teach me.
Finishing fishing,
And lying down thinking,
I enjoy the time I spent;
Well, I will have a reward
By fishing in Zion,
For the souls that I won in the world.
chorus: I will fish sinners for Christ,
In this world full of horror;
I will no longer be discouraged;
I will cast my net;
Many fish caught for the Lord.

hymns.title: For Weddings
stanzas: Full of contentment
We are, beloved Lord,
Because it's marriage
A good command of Yours.
Make them live guarded
In Your holy doctrine
And just walk guided
By Your divine hand.
Confirm this alliance,
We ask You further,
Filling them with hope
Of Your holy coming.
chorus: Gives protection to the bride and groom,
Granting Your love,
For them in unity,
Live for Your praise.

hymns.title: Speak Dear Jesus
stanzas: Speak, dear Jesus; talk to me, today!
Speak with Your goodness; stay by me;
My open heart is for Your voice to hear;
Fill me with praises and I enjoy serving You.
Speak to your children, and, in the good path,
By kindness he guides them to ask for the holy gift;
They will want to consecrate themselves to give their lives.
Obeying Christ and fervently loving Him.
As in ancient times, You revealed the law,
Show me Your will, and Your holy flock;
Let me glory in You, I want to praise You,
Sing joyfully and always honor You.
chorus: Speak to me softly! Speak, with lots of love!
Winner forever, I will set you free,
Speak to me every day, always in a tender tone;
I want to hear Your voice and in this same sound.

hymns.title: Through the Cross to Heaven I will go
stanzas: Only Jesus was transported to Calvary
Carrying a heavy cross,
And dying, there for the mortal left,
A fan of glorious light.
Only on the cross will the thirsty soul find
The source of Inspiration;
And there the burden of pain will fall;
On Calvary, there is salvation.
Through the cross I will go to the heavenly mansion.
The marked course is,
In my dark life it will be the fanal;
Into your light my soul will go.
chorus: Through the cross I will go to heaven;
Through the cross I will follow
Stop the home of peace and eternal love
Through the cross I will go to heaven.

hymns.title: Soldiers of Christ
stanzas: Soldiers of Christ who joined the fight.
Fight without fainting, fight with courage;
And the enemy is defeated,
Saying that Christ is our Lord.
Fight, O believer, the holy fight,
Continue forward through Christ Jesus;
And be very brave; you are in front,
Saying that Christ died on a cross.
The dawn approaches the magnificent day,
What prize will faith and valor have;
And in him, Jesus, great reward,
It will be awarded to whoever wins.
chorus: Soldiers of Christ, I always march forward,
Carrying the weapons of light on your right hand;
Lost souls seek triumphant
And then, take them to Christ Jesus.

hymns.title: Sweet Name of Jesus
stanzas: Oh! sweet name of Jesus!
How beautiful it is for you to sing,
With a full soul proclaim
The good name of Jesus!
I love the name of Jesus;
I never miss Your love,
And put my pain aside,
The good name of Jesus.
The name of Jesus is so pure!
That my grief could take away.
The grateful peace also gives me
The good name of Jesus.
In the sweet name of Jesus,
My soul is saved,
And in Him you will be saved;
In the good name of Jesus.
chorus: Jesus, oh my sweet King!
Jesus, true God!
Jesus, I will always praise
From the heart, Your name.

hymns.title: We Implore Your Power
stanzas: We implore, our Savior,
Your power; Your power, Your power,
Divine, renewing power,
Your power, Your power, Your power.
Blessed paternal promise!
Come and fill us with real value,
Of full heavenly power,
Your power, Your power, Your power.
With the oil, yes, come and anoint us,
Your power, Your power, Your power.
Heavenly Father, make us enjoy
Your power, Your power, Your power.
You already promised to spill
Your blessings and coat us.
For Your Word to proclaim,
With power, with power, with power.
With fire comes to inflame us,
Your power, Your power, Your power.
And from every stain cleanse us,
Your power, Your power, Your power.
Warm the cold, O Lord;
Make those who sleep wake up.
We beseech you fervently,
Your power, Your power, Your power.
Like the breeze, you want to blow
Your power, Your power. Your power.
Blessed God, come and grant us
Your power, Your power, Your power.
Perennial and sweet communion,
I want here with you, Father, to enjoy;
Quickly fill our hearts
With power, with power, with power.

hymns.title: The Lost Sheep
stanzas: The good Shepherd sought me
Already far from the fold,
And with tenderness he found me,
Fallen, sad, vile!
The wounds with love he thought,
And home in his arms he took me.
Followed me, far away
From Your place in heaven,
And he said, in a loving voice:
“I found you, you are Mine”.
I have never felt such great love
Like this one from my good Shepherd.
I am loved by Him,
What a singular grace!
For He was wounded,
In order to save myself;
So, I am His sheep,
And with His flock I go.
I proceed happily now;
God gives complete power
And saving grace;
Protect me from harm,
The good Shepherd is with me,
My steps He will guide.
chorus: Yes, Jesus loved me,
With love he sought me,
He himself restored me to God;
By His blood, He restored me to God.

hymns.title: Christ, Soon, Comes!
stanzas: The day comes, brightening,
The night has fled, the light from beyond shines;
A cry sounds: get ready!
Christ is coming soon!
O peoples, tribes and nations
How enslaved in sin you are,
Oh, I prepared the hearts!
Oh! Why are you delaying?
From death, you want to wake up;
Darkness and sins. it is light, they will flee;
Soon we will find
Crista, what is to come.
chorus: Like a strong gale, roaring Over the sea,
The message is heard, which comes from heaven;
Hear the great news, what joy it brings;
“Christ is coming soon!”

hymns.title: What will you do with Jesus Christ?
stanzas: Before Pilate' stands Jesus,
For all left in distress,
Who asks the crowd...
-"What will I do with Jesus Christ?"
Still on trial
The Nazarene in distress,
And the question is repeated, then:
-"What will I do with Jesus Christ?"
Jesus will be judged by you,
Or received with gratitude?
And, very happily, you will then say:
-"I accept Jesus Christ!"
chorus: What will you do with Jesus Christ?
Answer, today, yes;
One day I would say when I saw Him:
“What will He do with me?

hymns.title: Sing, O Pilgrims
stanzas: Sing, O pilgrims, do not tire in your work
Your faith growing, the harps are already playing
I stand on the holy and glorious mountain,
And I'm going to my heavenly homeland.
Sing, O pilgrims, while you are here;
Sing, to Jesus Christ, while you pass by;
I sang the old story of God and His love;
The eternal choir responds, with fervor.
Sing, O pilgrims, soon you will be,
Singing the best hymn, next to the King of kings,
With those who went before, and wait for us there,
We will find everyone, and nothing will disturb us.
chorus: Sing, continually,
praise forever and ever;
My heart overflows with divine praise.
Sing, continually,
Praise forever and ever;
My heart overflows with divine praise.

hymns.title: God Wanted to Save Us
stanzas: Brothers, united, let's publish
That God wanted to save us,
That God wanted to save us,
With the precious blood of Jesus,
Poured there on the cross.
Brothers, let us proclaim to the world
That God wanted to save us.
That God wanted to save us.
And that, very soon, Jesus will come,
In glorious light.
In the sound Word we found
That God wanted to save us,
That God wanted to save us,
And that in heaven we will see the Lord,
Full of love!
Joyful, we always have to sing:
That God wanted to save us,
That God wanted to save us.
By His grace, by His love,
Let us praise the Lord!
chorus: That God wanted to save us,
That God wanted to save us,
With the blood of the Lord Jesus;
O brothers, we must advance,
Looking at the cross

hymns.title: Sailing to the Celestial Land
stanzas: To the heavenly land my boat will sail,
There, where the saints are already;
When the night ends, morning will break;
Then the redeemed will enter.
This day will be joyful for me,
In which I reach the sky of light;
What peace and rest, with God, there without end!
I greet You now, O my Jesus!
O world that lies in the vile tempter
I never want to live in you,
To the heavenly party I go with fervor,
Praises to Christ I will sing!
Friends, remember that the shipwreck
It’s easy for any of you;
Jesus wants to give you an invitation to the wedding;
There's plenty of space for us.
chorus: Yes, I go through the lands, through the seas too,
Alert, Jesus will guide me; He promised me,
Never leave me in the world though,
Yes, take me to the port, with endless joy.

hymns.title: The Banner of Truth
stanzas: Of truth, let us raise the standard,
Let us raise the standard of Jesus.
Let us proclaim, with courage, everywhere,
The most solemn message of the cross.
Let us raise the standard of truth;
We will proclaim the Lord, who is light and peace;
Sinner, listen! Jesus has to give you
Salvation that you will find in Him alone.
Of the Gospel, let us raise the standard,
Come, awaken from your sleep, sinner;
That your God, that your Lord has to give you
Copious blessings of His great love.
chorus: The world is without light, without peace;
Let us bring peace, consolation,
To those who, in pain, in mourning,
No light, no peace, no salvation.

hymns.title: Christ Died for Me
stanzas: From Calvary, along the path,
The Lord Jesus ascended,
And on the cross, in horrible pain,
Work of love fulfilled!
Oh! What a glorious work
It was for God that of Jesus!
Your death so painful
He made light shine from the sky!
In this work today believing,
I have life and pleasure;
By faith, I'm reviewing
The Lord, suffer for me.
Sinner on the cross will be redeemed,
Jesus suffered an atrocious death.
For your sin takes away,
If you hear His voice.
chorus: Over the cross, over the cross,
Christ Jesus died for me;
Over the cross, over the cross,
Christ Jesus died for you.

hymns.title: Peace Light and Love
stanzas: I received free, abundant peace
By God granted, which satisfies me;
Do you want to welcome her into your heart?
Seek the Lord and His salvation,
More of His peace, more of His peace,
I want to receive from God, who is truthful.
May of His peace, more of His peace,
I want to receive from God, who is truthful.
I received free, abundant light,
Wonderful light, which Jesus gave me;
Do you want to receive it, poor sinner?
Leave the world of horror today.
More of Your light, more of Your light,
I want to receive from the Savior Jesus,
More of Your light, more of Your light,
I want to receive from the Savior Jesus.
I received abundant love freely,
The divine love of the Comforter;
Do you want to receive it? Open your heart,
And you will have more joy and true forgiveness.
More of His love, more of His love,
I want to receive from the good Comforter,
More of His love, more of His love,
I want to receive from the good Comforter.

hymns.title: The Christian Armor
stanzas: Let's go to the good fight, full of love,
Clothed in righteousness, fervent in the Lord;
With your loins tightly girded with true light,
Footwear of the Gospel of the Savior Jesus.
Of faith, the shield, that can save you
Of the flaming darts that come to throw you
The great enemy, the cunning tempter
That always seeks to swallow you, With its fury.
Enter the good fight, in the name of the Lord
With zeal, with courage, united in love;
The enemy will soon be defeated,
And under our feet Jesus will place him.
chorus: Of God the armor - of Christ the valor,
My brother, hold on - so you can be victorious.

hymns.title: Let the King of Glory In
stanzas: Do you hear? Jesus calls you
Yes, call you, oh sinner!
To Jesus, who saves and loves,
Come now, without fear.
To the world and sin
You have a place in your heart,
But the risen Jesus,
Can't you shelter?
Of pleasure, the beautiful view,
From this seductive world,
Yes, one day here will end,
With death, O sinner!
Today is an acceptable day
To come and deliver it to you
To Jesus, who is very kind,
Want, and can save you
chorus: Let the King of glory in
In yourself, O sinner;
Who is this King of glory?
Jesus is your Lord

hymns.title: Jesus' Witnesses
stanzas: O companions of this holy cause
Announce that Christ is Savior,
And good news that the lost saves
And from the slave he makes a winner;
From Amazonas, to Rio Grande,
The Gospel, bold, proclaim,
And the message, which speaks to us of peace;
Eternal glory will give you from the Father.
Perfect and glorious salvation,
That, in Jesus, the Father wanted to reveal,
Yes, we publish it everywhere.
To those whom Jesus has already come to save.
And many have already given themselves to Christ,
And these others will gather,
Yes, the Word is not sown in vain,
For whoever gave it, also makes it enjoy.
Power from above to be a witness,
It was the promise He left us,
Very few believers are waiting for Him,
Not knowing what God has bequeathed to us,
But, glory to God! There are others who woke up
And full of Pentecostal power,
They will awaken the idle believers,
To find this heavenly gift.
In the name of Jesus we proclaim,
Salvation for every sinner,
And this name heals the sick,
Who seek Him to alleviate the pain;
And the demons will be cast out,
Because Jesus promised us power,
And already a people are preparing
To meet Jesus, the King of heaven.

hymns.title: My Brothers, Let Us Rejoice
stanzas: My brothers, let us rejoice
In Jesus, the King of glory,
In this faith we receive,
In this peace, which gives victory,
In the divine Comforter,
That revives the memory,
And in us he sings hymns to Jesus.
My brothers, we gathered,
Let us sing our song
To the Lord, our beloved,
To the good God, perfect and holy;
In your joy let us jubilee,
And the mourning will dry up;
In spirit let us worship Jesus.
My brothers, in Christ we are
By the Spirit begotten,
And to be saints, we were
By Jesus already rescued;
By faith we enjoy
Freedom from sin,
And also, we rejoice in Jesus.
chorus: My brothers, let us rejoice
In Jesus, by His blessing;
So, we always have
Salvation.

hymns.title: Oh! Jesus Loves Me
stanzas: Far from the Lord, I walked,
On the path of horror,
Why didn't Jesus ask?
Nor did I want His love.
In my judgment I didn't think,
Not even in my perdition,
Not even my soul wanted
Eternal Salvation.
Already tired of sin,
I went to the feet of the Savior,
And there, the burden fell
Of sadness and pain.
How wonderful.
Belong to my Jesus!
Have grace, rest,
And stand at the foot of the cross!
chorus: Oh! Why does Jesus love me?
I can't explain it to you!
But he also calls you,
Because he wants to save you!

hymns.title: To the Calvary of Horror
stanzas: How there was darkness in my heart,
When Jesus Christ saved me;
By divine light, with His hand,
All my darkness dispelled!
When a lost man came to the Lord Jesus,
You will find the enjoyment divine!,
And the light will dawn in your soul,
Light that comes from heaven, eternal light!
God's love is wonderful,
Who sent His Son to save
Every lost sinner or defendant,
May His grace accept!
chorus: Jesus ascended to Calvary of horror,
Carrying the cross, carrying the cross;
Jesus ascended to Calvary of horror,
Carrying my cross!

hymns.title: A Redeemed Sinner
stanzas: He was a sinner, he walked without Jesus,
There was no hope, no divine light;
Today I am redeemed, Christ saved me,
Co’o His blood washed me!
The Comforter has already come to live in me,
The holy Word came to illuminate;
I want to be guided by such a clear light,
That leads me to Christ.
Come, beloved Jesus, come without delay,
I'm looking forward to entering heaven;
Come without delay, let the light shine,
"Come now, Lord Jesus"
Do you want, sinner, to enjoy salvation?
Come to Christ today to receive forgiveness,
Christ accepts you, poor sinner,
In His arms of love!
chorus: What love Jesus gave me,
Holy joy and heavenly light;
Christ will soon descend from heaven,
And with you, then, you will take me.

hymns.title: Oh, come and give me away
stanzas: O sinner, weary and dejected,
who wander in this world, without consolation!
If you want to be clothed for free,
Accept Christ and His salvation.
O sinner, if you are discouraged,
Because evil dominates your entire being,
O believe in Christ, the crucified,
And against vice you will have power.
O sinner, why don't you surrender
To Jesus Christ, the kind Savior?
That, when death comes, gratefully carries you
To Paradise, to the country of love!
If you feel commotion in your soul,
And you want to receive salvation today,
Accept Christ, with faith and calmly,
Come and give yourself, with all your heart.
chorus: Oh, come give me away
To the great Savior,
Who came to save you,
And he waits for you, full of love.

hymns.title: The Saints Praise the Lord
stanzas: We are ready to praise Jesus, the Savior,
Glory to Jesus and hallelujah!
And we will sing to our Redeemer,
Glory to Jesus and hallelujah!
We are now certain of our redemption,
Glory to Jesus and hallelujah!
And, singing, we go to happy Zion;
Glory to Jesus and hallelujah!
We have firm promises that God wanted to give us,
Glory to Jesus and hallelujah!
Through Jesus, here, we can always triumph,
Glory to Jesus and hallelujah!
chorus: Have the saints of the Lord
The right to sing
May Jesus, with great love,
He came to earth to save;
Our soul rescued,
With His blood He washed us;
Glory to Jesus and hallelujah!

hymns.title: Glory, Hallelujah, Glory
stanzas: I enjoy giving praise,
Glory, hallelujah, glory!
To Jesus, my Savior,
Glory, hallelujah, glory!
Only Jesus can save,
Glory, hallelujah, glory!
And deliver from all evil,
Glory, hallelujah, glory!
As long as the world walks,
Glory, hallelujah, glory!
I will praise Jesus,
Glory, hallelujah, glory!
When I arrive in heaven,
Glory, hallelujah, glory!
Forever I will sing,
Glory, hallelujah, glory!
chorus: Glory to God, Jesus saved me!
Glory to God, Jesus delivered me!
Glory to God, I am saved!
Glory, hallelujah, glory!

hymns.title: Beloved Brothers
stanzas: Beloved brothers - And rescued,
Move forward - And triumphant,
We will fight - And we will win,
In the holy name of Jesus!
Beloved brothers - Sanctified,
Live together - For you are redeemed,
No longer fearing - The doing of good,
In the holy name of Jesus!
Beloved brothers - Purified,
Be brave - And very prudent,
You are washed - And freed,
In the holy name of Jesus!
chorus: In the holy name - joyful singing:
I have been washed - Sanctified;
I lived lost - But I am redeemed.
In the holy name of Jesus!

hymns.title: Priests of the Lord
stanzas: To the Lord who has made us
True priests,
Let us give Him praise and glory without ceasing;
For His blood is perfect,
Regenerates completely,
Every soul that wants to be saved.
He is the alpha and the Omega.
The first and the last,
And the King of kings, the Lord of all;
He is the one who comes to us
Your grace, Your support,
By the divine Comforter.
With Jesus, our Husband.
There in heaven, we will enter.
All together, yes, in His Kingdom, of love;
We will see Him glorious,
And with Him we will sing
New hymns, full of fervor.
chorus: All, having the same mind,
Jubilant and happy,
Let us give glory, great honor to the Redeemer:
Upon the cross he was pierced;
With His blood shed,
The good Savior rescued us.

hymns.title: I'm safe
stanzas: I am safe, Jesus bought me
From sin and perdition;
With His 'spirit has already sealed me
It gave me peace in my heart.
I will sing with joy,
Joyful sound from heaven.
I will praise with harmony
To Jesus. my beloved.
The glorious message
Of eternal salvation,
Strong, yes, and powerful,
It is worthy of acceptance.
When the end of the deal comes,
You receive me, Savior;
Grant me eternal life,
In Your kingdom of love.
chorus: Glory, glory, hallelujah,
You have already found salvation;
Glory, glory, hallelujah,
Christ gave me redemption.

hymns.title: Glorious Peace
stanzas: Believing in Christ Jesus I came to obtain
Glorious peace, perfect peace:
Even though pains lash my being,
I have sweet peace!
Unfathomable peace, like a great sea,
Glorious peace, perfect peace;
I can rest in the arms of God,
I have sweet peace!
Ineffable peace of God, who does good,
Glorious peace, perfect peace;
That gives encouragement to the soul too,
I have sweet peace!
And, in conflicts with the tempter,
Glorious peace. perfect peace,
Christ Jesus will make me victorious,
I have sweet peace!
chorus: Peace, peace, glorious peace;
Peace, peace, perfect peace;
Since Christ saved my soul,
I have sweet peace!

hymns.title: Beautiful Redeemer
stanzas: Fair and beautiful Redeemer,
That you dwell in dawn;
In my soul I long
To be as You are, Lord
My eyes, oh remove,
From this world of horror,
For my soul in You will redeem
Your grace and Your favor.
The night is already advancing;
Beautiful star will be born,
We have hope
An eternal and great pleasure.
Your hand, oh, sustain me,
Humiliated at Your feet,
With the soul and with the mind,
By true faith.
chorus: I have to go one day, redeemed,
In heaven I see the Redeemer!
After I have fulfilled
His will, for His love.

hymns.title: In Christ We Enjoy Peace
stanzas: Where can we enjoy peace and love?
In Christ, only in Christ;
Where do we have power and vigor?
In Christ, only in Christ.
Where do we go to get jellyfish?
In Christ, only in Christ:
It's inexplicable but it's pleasant
Being in the love of Christ.
Where shall we rest?
In Christ, only in Christ;
Can we also renew our strength?
In Christ, only in Christ.
Where do we find immense power?
In Christ, only in Christ;
And a people full of holy pleasure?
In Christ, only in Christ.
chorus: In Christ, in Christ,
I feel endless joy within me;
It's inexplicable but it's pleasant
Being in the love of Christ.

hymns.title: Come, Celeste Redeemer
stanzas: Come, Lord, from the source of good,
Come, heavenly Redeemer.
Help me sing to you
Worthy hymns of praise;
You, Jesus, died for me,
I just want you to live;
I want at all times
Your blessing receive.
He was a poor stray
When Christ sought me;
To save me from hell
His blood was shed;
In His painful death,
Peace, forgiveness and life I found.
And with Him forever
I will enjoy His glory.
Of your grace, O my beloved.
I am a continuous debtor;
More and more you draw me
By Your divine love;
I am ungrateful, and I know it well.
I ask, my Lord, for forgiveness;
Take me away from vile sin,
You rule my heart.

hymns.title: Jesus in Gethsemane
stanzas: Jesus in Gethsemane was bound,
And he was dragged away by the wicked
The court, where he was greatly insulted,
And struck, for my sin;
And the mob's sentence was the cry:
"May Christ be crucified."
Vituperated and scourged
Jesus suffered my sin.
Vituperated and scourged
Jesus suffered my sin.
So on the cross was Christ hanging
And he was pierced with a spear;
There was Jesus bloodied,
For my sins tormented!
“My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?”
Christ cried out crucified;
“Forgive the people so deceived,
Who committed such a sin.”
“Forgive the people so deceived,
Who committed such a sin."
After Jesus Christ was taken from the cross,
And he was carried to the tomb;
By saints, His body was embalmed,
And he was buried among rich people;
Christ Jesus being already buried;
His tomb was well guarded;
After three days, beloved Jesus,
From death he was resurrected.
After three days beloved Jesus,
From death he was resurrected.

hymns.title: Resurrected!
stanzas: From the grave, to heaven, Jesus returned,
After sin annihilated;
With great power he was resurrected,
And freedom to the prisoners he proclaimed;
Trembling, the earth greeted Him,
For he rose from death.
The tears of the disciples turned to laughter,
For alive, Christ presented himself;
- “Depart for Galilee,” he ordered,
And the holy promise revealed:
“Power from on high, I give you
For I will ask my Father."
Jesus His divine hand raised,
Blessing beings he saved,
And, triumphant, he returned to heaven.
And a cloud immediately hid Him;
But the promise left them:
“Behold, I am with you forever”
Sitting at the right hand of God the Father, Jesus is,
For His Wife pleading now;
The world does not consider this here,
Because you don't see the light that shines there;
Very soon, Christ will return,
But only His own will be taken to heaven.
chorus: Resurrected! Resurrected!
And Jesus returned to heaven;
But he will return, also from there,
And in this world, then will reign.

hymns.title: My Jesus! My Jesus!
stanzas: Of my tender Savior,
I will sing of immense love,
Giving glory and praise to Jesus,
For he called me out of darkness,
He freed me from chains,
And my Jesus saved me from death!
Oh! what a sad condition
That of the wicked heart;
Saved me from perdition; my Jesus;
From sin, forgiveness;
From ruin, salvation;
For sorrow, reward, my Jesus!
Wandering around the world.
Lonely without stopping,
Without the sweet peace of enjoying Jesus;
All tears to suffer,
There are pasts, and pleasure
I am already beginning to receive from Jesus.
Oh! what redeeming blood,
I found it in Salvador,
Purifying blood, of Jesus!
Give praise in action
Of blessed salvation!
Hymns give out of gratitude to Jesus!
chorus: My Jesus! My Jesus!
How precious is the name of Jesus!
With His blood He cleansed me;
I have had enough of His joy;
Oh! what grace you sent me, my Jesus.

hymns.title: Invocation and Praise
stanzas: Come Thou, O King of kings.
Guide your faithful to praise you.
Great and glorious Being, Father of all power,
Come upon us to rule, oh! Peerless God!
Come You, Word of God,
Bring our prayers to heaven.
Come, yes, bless your people and prosper
Message that talks about salvation.
He comes. You. Comforter,
Inspires and gives fervor to prayers;
Spirit of peace, drive away Satan,
And full grace brings to hearts.
To the great triune God
Praise His angels and so do we,
To God our Lord: Father, Son and Driver
Let us praise with fervor, forever. Amen.

hymns.title: From Value to Value
stanzas: By the faith once given to me,
To follow the Lamb of God,
By the grace of God sent,
I will walk, with courage, to the heavens.
From God, I want to wear the armor,
To fight with courage and valor.
Because here the battle is tough,
Against the hosts of the vile tempter.
In Jesus I will do a thousand feats
In the fight of faith and love;
In Him I have vigor and dexterity,
To fight and to be victorious!
I will say, at the end of this lesson:
I fought the fight of love
And tails I will have justice.
That the Lord will give me in heaven.
chorus: I want to move from value to value
And follow Jesus, my Lord;
I have to receive it in heaven one day
The crown, which God will give me.

hymns.title: Closer My God to You!
stanzas: I want to be closer
My God, from You!
Even if it's the pain
May I unite with You,
I will always beg
I want to be closer
I want to be closer
My God, from You!
Walking sad, here
In solitude,
Peace and rest to me
Your arms give;
In the darkness I will dream,
I want to be closer,
I want to be closer,
My God, from You!
My soul will sing
To You, Lord!
And in Bethel he will rise
Love pattern,
I will always pray
I want to be closer,
I want to be closer,
My God, from You!
And, when Christ, finally,
Come call me,
In the skies with seraphim,
I will live.
Then I will rejoice
Close to You, my King.
Close to You, my King,
My God, from You!

hymns.title: The Joy of Heaven
stanzas: I know, many cannot understand
Because my life is happy;
Enter Canaan with holy pleasure,
It's the joy of heaven for me.
It is the joy of heaven for me;
Yes, I enjoy heaven for me;
Enter Canaan with holy pleasure,
It's the joy of heaven for me.
Listen to the beautiful celestial chords,
In the Gospel that I received;
Trust Jesus and follow Him here,
It's the joy of heaven for me.
It is the joy of heaven for me;
Yes, I enjoy heaven for me;
Trust Jesus and follow Him here,
It's the joy of heaven for me.
Possess my being transformed into light
Having the ‘spirit of Jesus,
Deny myself and take up my cross,
It's the joy of heaven for me.
It is the joy of heaven for me;
Yes, I enjoy heaven for me;
Deny myself and take up my cross,
It's the joy of heaven for me.
Eternal life, in Christ, enjoy,
What is “up there” to seek,
Let my Jesus reign in my soul,
It's the joy of heaven for me.
It is the joy of heaven for me;
Yes, I enjoy heaven for me;
Let my Jesus reign in my soul,
It's the joy of heaven for me.

hymns.title: Glory to the Savior
stanzas: Arriving at the cross of my good Lord,
Prostrate at the feet of the Redeemer,
He heard my every cry
Glory to the Savior.
How wonderful! Jesus loved me,
Everything free forgave me;
He broke my bonds and freed me;
Glory to the Savior!
Next to the cross, there is still room,
Come, O afflicted one, without delay,
Christ is ready to save you,
Come to the Savior!
chorus: Glory to the Savior!
Glory to the Savior
Now I know He saved me
Glory to the Savior!

hymns.title: Christ! My Christ!
stanzas: Oh! How much Jesus did for me!
Saved me from sin!
Until death (sad end),
The beloved loved me.
With God the Father is now
Jesus, my Advocate;
Address will grant me
In glory, with the beloved.
Defends as protector,
Hold your tired foot;
And about me, with tender love.
Watch over the beloved.
My humble request
Listen with pleasure;
Quiet and weak heart,
Rest in You, Beloved.
chorus: Christ! my Christ!
Your name is sweet, beloved!
I want to see you, face to face
my beloved Christ.

hymns.title: My Jesus
stanzas: My Jesus, for me, died
On the cross, in horrible pain;
There in my place he suffered,
Very tremendous anguish!
Who in the world can I find?
What will my Jesus compare to?
Jesus. Jesus, I will only love!
My Jesus is in heaven,
powerful intercessor,
For me, always asking God.
Grace, fervent love.
No one ever leads to the Father
The sinner but Jesus;
Jesus, Jesus, to God, introduce me!
My Jesus is risen,
In glorious body,
Also, for me, God paid
A fabulous price!
Which of the mortals will I meet
That I will equal my Jesus?
Jesus, Jesus, I can't compare!
Jesus from heaven will return,
In majesty and glory,
Then Your angels will sing
The anthem of victory,
Jesus will finally overcome
The Antichrist, and reign.
Jesus, Jesus, come and take me away!

hymns.title: By Blood
stanzas: The light shines through the world,
Since Jesus died.
Hanging there on the cross of Calvary!
The sins carried
And freed us from guilt,
With the blood that flowed, on Calvary!
Before, I was very afraid,
But now I have love,
For I understand the value of Calvary;
I lived in perdition
But I found salvation
For the great redemption: Calvary!
Are you a great sinner?
Here is Your Savior!
Theme of the good preacher: Calvary.
The divine Lamb
You suffered your evil on the cross,
And he offers such grace, on Calvary.
chorus: By blood, by blood,
We are redeemed, yes
By crimson blood;
By blood, by blood.
By the blood of Jesus, on Calvary!

hymns.title: The Dejected Soul
stanzas: If you, my soul, pray to God,
And you don't receive, trusting remains
In His promises, which are very rich,
And infallible to your credit.
He intercedes for you, my soul;
Wait on Him, with faith and calm;
Jesus saves you from all your evils,
And bless you, from the high heavens.
You will soon have the pains over,
On the joyful day of His coming;
If Christ delays, wait still
A little more, and you will see Him.
chorus: Why do you fall down, O my soul?
And are you moved, losing your calm?
Don't be afraid, wait in God,
Because very soon, Jesus will come.

hymns.title: Jesus Will Guide Me
stanzas: There are those who watch over the footsteps
That I give in shadow or light,
Along the steep paths,
Jesus will watch over me;
Through the valleys, through the mountains,
Lead me into Your hand;
I can already see the horizons
Of a perennial mansion.
There is a contact that explains it to me
The presence of the Lord,
That the stains purifies
And free me from fear;
Christ with the wounded hand,
Protection can give me,
When I see this life
The restless and strong sea.
There is a loving heart,
Of infinite compassion,
That grants constant peace
To the contrite heart;
There is favor and freedom
In Jesus, the Savior,
Lots of grace and truth
And consoling power.
chorus: There are those who watch over the footsteps,
My path will be drawn;
For the skeptical addresses,
Yes, Jesus will guide me

hymns.title: Benigno Salvador
stanzas: Benign Savior! With Your approval,
Consecrate this happy union in sweet love,
And he descends upon the bride and groom
The grace that is theirs.
Make them walk in peace together in the Lord,
And life here passes in tender and holy love
Connected in God's love;
Walk together to the heavens.
O deign to rule your house as King;
Your hearts keep docile,
to Your law; Deliver them from all temptation,
Comfort them in tribulation.
If the Savior fulfills our petition,
We can discover in this blessed union
The shadow of heavenly love
Of the saved and their Savior.

hymns.title: A Glorious Flower
stanzas: I have already found a glorious flower,
And whoever desires the same will have it;
The precious rose of Sharon
Among a thousand more beauty you will have;
In the valley of shadow and death,
In the heights of glory and light,
This rose will be my luck,
Precious to me is Jesus!
The rose has been found by many
And tasted the excellent odor
And the power of this glorious flower
Who gives life to the vile sinner.
Saul was very zealous for the law,
He persecuted the people of God,
But transformed into a Paulo.
For he found the rose of heaven.
Go seek precious Jesus,
Go quickly, the night is coming,
And if you lose glorious love,
The afterlife will be sad for you;
This flower is offered today
To whom humbly seek;
It will soon be taken from the earth,
To shine elsewhere.
chorus: Precious to me is Jesus!
Precious to me is Jesus!
I confess in life and in death
That everything for me is Jesus!

hymns.title: The Home of Glory
stanzas: Jesus went to heaven to prepare a place for us.
In glory.
And soon, very soon He will return,
In glory.
Look up and tell us what's there.
In glory.
Of precious stones the home shines there,
In glory.
I haven't seen it yet, but the angels are there,
In glory.
And streets covered in gold will be,
In glory.
One day, happy to heaven I will follow,
For glory,
With Christ reigning, I will return later,
In glory.
Friends I hope to meet in heaven,
In glory.
And together we will always stay,
In glory.
chorus: I know, I know, I have a home in glory!
Oh! I know, I know, a home in heaven!

hymns.title: Jesus the Good Friend
stanzas: I found a good friend,
Jesus, the Savior,
The chosen one of thousands for me;
Of the valleys is the lily; is the strong Mediator,
Who purifies me and keeps me for Himself,
Beloved comforter, my protector from evil,
My request takes to You.
It took all my pain away,
I handed over the sorrows to him;
My strength is, in temptation.
I left everything for Him; I burned the idols;
He keeps my heart holy,
That the world abandons me; pursue the tempter;
Jesus keeps me until the end of life.
Never forsake,
Nor will he abandon me,
If faithful and obedient I live;
A wall is of fire, which will protect me,
The time to die must come to me,
To heaven then flying, Your glory I will see
Where pain and death never come.
chorus: Of the valleys is the lily, the morning star,
The chosen one of thousands for me.
Beloved comforter, my protector from evil,
My request takes to You,
Of the valleys is the lily, the morning star,
The chosen one of thousands for me.

hymns.title: The Lord's Supper
stanzas: Lord, gathered here
In order to remember Your death;
Breaking this bread we remember You,
Until you come and get us.
The cup that we will drink,
It is a symbol of Your blood,
Which we must never forget;
Through him we have heaven.
Always make us worthy, Lord,
Of Your divine communion;
Of Your body and purifying blood
That gives us true salvation.

hymns.title: The Kind Friend
stanzas: How kind a friend is Christ!
He carried our pain with us,
And orders us to take
Care for the Lord.
Missing the aching heart
Joy, peace, consolation?
That's because we don't take
All to God in prayer.
You are weak and burdened
Of care and fear?
To Jesus, eternal refuge,
Go with faith to expose your evil!
Do your friends despise you?
Tell Him this in prayer,
And with His love so tender,
Peace you will have in your heart.
Christ is a true friend,
Of this proof showed us,
When to take it with you
The culprit incarnated.
Spilled His pure blood
Our stain to wash;
Enjoyment in life and in the future
NEI’ we can achieve.

hymns.title: The Decision
stanzas: Oh! Joyful day! I hugged
Jesus, and in Him salvation!
The joy of this heart
I will publish more and more.
Complete the great transaction,
Jesus is mine, I am the Lord's!
The voice of His love called me;
I gave in to the immense attraction.
Rest, oh soul! The Savior
And your sustenance, the bread of heaven;
And whoever possesses the eternal God,
Resist every tempter.
My sacred vow, excellent God,
From day to day I will affirm!
And beyond death I will exult,
Your son and subject of heaven.
chorus: Happy day! Happy day!
When in Jesus I was satisfied!
Jesus teaches me to watch.
And trusting in Him, pray,
Happy day! Happy day!
When in Jesus I was satisfied!

hymns.title: Place of Delights
stanzas: Next to the prepared throne of God
There is, Christian, a place for you;
There are perfumes, there is exalted enjoyment.
There are profuse delights there;
Yes, there; yes, there,
Surrounded by His faithful angels,
In a sphere of glory and light,
Next to God, Jesus awaits us.
The charms of the earth cannot
Give an idea of the enjoyment there;
If pleasures come on earth,
These are pleasures that end here;
But there, barely there
Eternal fortunes compete
With the perpetual existence of light,
Making us happy with Jesus.
Let us keep in our memory,
The riches of the beautiful country,
And let us keep hope with us,
Of a better, happier life;
So from there, so from there
A true voice never tires
To offer us from the kingdom of light,
The protective love of Jesus.
If we want to enjoy the adventure
That in the beautiful country there will be,
It is only asking from the pure soul,
That Jesus will give us for free.
So from there, so from there
All full of love, tenderness,
Of that love that you showed us on the cross,
Listen to us, Jesus listens to us.

hymns.title: Leave the Illusions
stanzas: I left the world of illusion,
The path of sin and pain,
To go to my glorious home;
There is joy, peace and love there.
Some try to stop me,
On the glorious path to walk,
But I always want to move forward,
You can even enter your home.
Friend that you are in the world,
You don't want to accompany me,
To the land of eternal love?
Jesus wants to free you.
chorus: There is no home in the world,
I cannot rest here;
But I always want to move forward:
I will soon enter heaven.

hymns.title: The Earth Pilgrim
stanzas: I am a pilgrim on earth
And I'm far from my home,
Mlnh'longing soul waits
May Christ come and get her;
Here there is only disbelief,
The fights have no end,
But of Jesus, the presence,
Glory will be for me!
In Christ having already believed,
Only by faith will I live,
For God has promised me,
That in heaven I will rest!
I have permanent
The good Comforter,
Guiding me gently
To the living source of love.
Although sometimes the believer
The pains suffer from the cross,
Enjoyment will be permanent,
When you see Jesus in heaven
Of glory crowned
On the divine throne!,
By angels always praised,
In a heavenly choir.
chorus: In the sky of light I will rest,
I will live with my Jesus.

hymns.title: Grace, Grace
stanzas: God's grace revealed
In Christ Jesus, my Lord,
To the lost world is given
By God of infinite favor.
God's grace is sweeter,
Than earthly goods from here;
In joy my crying became
Running His grace to me.
Higher than heavenly clouds,
Deeper than the deep sea,
You made the fountain of life,
Which we can get enough of.
God's grace today proves
You who live in perdition,
For He saves you, renews you,
It also cleanses your heart.
chorus: Grace, grace,
The grace of God is enough for me: Jesus;
Grace, grace,
I found grace in Jesus.

hymns.title: The Clarim Alerts Us
stanzas: The bugle already warns us,
Our heart awakens,
For the coming of Jesus is very certain;
Surrounded by a thousand angels,
For the prepared believer,
Christ returns crowned. Hallelujah!
There at the wedding of the Lamb,
We will sit happily;
Oh! What true joy with Jesus!
For in heaven there is no more crying,
Behold, everything will be a song;
Christ comes to seek the saints.Hallelujah!
Yes, we will sit at the table,
And with Christ we will dine;
How happy we will be with Jesus!
Forever we will enjoy,
And with Christ we will reign,
We will enjoy His glory. Hallelujah!
chorus: O brother, freed by God,
You are covered in blood;
You have your forgiveness quite certain, you are safe;
Voice of joy we will hear
And in heaven we will sing,
Christ we will soon see. Hallelujah!

hymns.title: Divine Jerusalem
stanzas: divine Jerusalem
Vision of blissful peace,
Of Christ, holy wife,
Radiant with splendor;
You have crystal clear sources,
Your altars are alive
And the angels, by the thousands,
They gird you around.
Mansion of the blessed King,
There are twelve of your doors
That are always transposed
For immortal beings;
Your books have writings
The names of the redeemed;
In you, they will be heard
The heavenly hymns.
Your holy residents,
A glorious song
Speak to the holy God
Who has already forgiven them;
Sing a thousand praises
To Christ, like a lamb,
How meek, on a tree
For them he sacrificed himself!
Let us love the same Christ,
Let us fear the same God,
We who walk by faith,
Carrying His cross;
And we will soon enjoy,
Your thresholds passed,
A thousand prepared pleasures,
In glory, with Jesus!

hymns.title: Come to Christ
stanzas: Today you want to give yourself to Jesus Christ,
O tired and sad sinner?
To the one, who, on Golgotha. was seen
Suffering our guilt, our pain?
Today you want to obtain freedom,
Which is found in the Lord Jesus
Receive holiness in your heart,
For the blood shed there on the cross?
Today you want to enjoy divine peace,
What in the world can't be found?
Come to Christ, who saves you, who teaches you,
Where can you enjoy this peace of heaven!
Today you want to renounce earthly good
Believing in Christ, the great Savior?
Do you want to come after the gentle Nazarene,
See Him one day there in the shining sky?
chorus: Come to Christ, come to Christ,
Who calls you with heavenly love;
Come to Christ, come to Christ,
For Jesus is the divine rock.

hymns.title: The Voice of the Good Shepherd
stanzas: Listen to the voice of the good Shepherd
In splendid solitude,
Call the lamb that in fear
Wander in the dense darkness.
Whoever helps wants Jesus,
Sinners seek,
Go spread Your light,
The Gospel proclaim.
The world is a sad desert,
Surrounded by a thousand dangers;
Come, call Christ, come with faith,
Come into the fold.
Listen today, the good Shepherd,
Come to the fold to shelter you,
Run away from the deceiving wolf,
Because he wants to devour you.
chorus: Today come to Jesus,
To the kind Savior,
Receive His light.
Come to Christ, the good Shepherd.

hymns.title: Speak, speak, Lord
stanzas: Speak, speak, Lord, at this time,
How anxious I want to hear you;
Your speech gives value and restores,
And it makes me wiser in the future.
Speak, speak, Lord, who I keep
Your words of life and vigor;
I am ready to follow You with zeal,
Through Your paths of love.
Speak, speak, Lord, I hear
Your words with all fervor,
For they lead to eternal rest,
These are very loving pieces of advice.
chorus: Oh! Blessed be Your name forever,
That You speak to anyone who listens,
Of health and supernal rest,
Of eternal joy and peace.

hymns.title: Come to God
stanzas: Come, while God calls you
And you feel His love,
For power pours from heaven
To save the sinner!
If you have the burden of life
And your soul is sad,
Believe in God, don't be late,
May Jesus save you!
In this world you walk,
Without tranquility and peace;
- Return to God, but trusting,
And happy then you will be.
Come to Christ, who awaits you,
Don't delay, sinner!
In His arms God wanted
Welcome you with love!
chorus: Come to God, to Jesus,
give your heart;
And you will have His light...
The perfect salvation!

hymns.title: Warriors Prepare
stanzas: Warriors prepare for the big fight
It is Jesus, the Captain, who will take them forward.
The militia of the redeemed marches unpolluted;
Certain victory will be achieved!
Behold the battalions of Christ proceeding forward,
Don't you see how valuable they are in fighting evil?
Can you stay asleep, even if you are wavering,
When do others attack Belial?
Hurry up, don't hesitate, today God calls you
To come and fight alongside the Lord;
Enter the battle where the fire ignites the most,
And fight against the vile tempter!
The battle is tremendous, it becomes close,
But there are few soldiers to fight;
Oh come free the poor oppressed souls
Of those who are furious and want to swallow them!
chorus: I want to be with Christ,
Where the fight rages,
In the unexpected move
In front you will find me.
Until I can see Him in glory,
Rejoicing in victory,
Where God will crown me!

hymns.title: I'm Walking Over the Earth
stanzas: On the earth I walk,
Well merry to heaven,
Satisfied and singing
To the kind God;
With fierce enemies
I'm always fighting,
But I keep peace with myself,
For I am loved.
My Shepherd is the heavenly Father,
Who guides me to Zion
Through the valleys and very near,
With a safe hand;
In the dangers of the journey,
In anguish and pain,
Your voice tells me: Courage,
I am your Savior.
With Jesus I work,
I persevere in prayer;
Your knowledge with faith seeking
To make me sane.
What an incomparable pleasure
Be guided by Jesus.
Yes, by Christ so lovable,
In the everlasting light.
Upon arriving in this homeland
All crying will cease.
Now the divine sun rises,
In the happy mansion.
Evils, struggles and agonies,
They ended up here;
Christ comes, oh! What a joy
Let's have it there!

hymns.title: We want to go there
stanzas: Our Redeemer went to prepare
A place of rest and splendor;
Soon he will call home to rest,
We, the saved, from the deceiving world.
There are no treasures in this land,
May they hold us here;
We long to go to heaven where Christ already is,
To the place where we will rest.
In this home with Jesus the Lord,
We will always reign.
Let's go there and sing new hymns of praise
To the Lamb who came to save us.
chorus: We wish to go there,
We wish to go there;
What a joy it will be,
When we meet there.

hymns.title: We'll see each other
stanzas: In this world the true Church,
Pilgrim will walk,
Hoping that you are
In your true home.
Nothing here is permanent,
Everything has to end,
But we look forward,
To our eternal home.
The redeemed bury here
Your loved ones when you die,
But one day, yes, they hope
That they will see them in heaven.
With Jesus, the King, in the air,
Soon we will be,
And with angels, by the thousands,
His glory behold.
chorus: We will see each other, we will see each other,
We will see each other in the divine land;
We will see each other, we will see each other,
We will see ourselves next to the unique river.

hymns.title: Praise God
stanzas: Praise God, with joy, singing,
And announce His love to the world!
Of Christ. the glories, celebrating together;
From the Savior, public fame.
I praised God. Omnipotent Lord,
To whom do we owe our salvation,
Who lives in the heavens, however, is present here.
Safe, guide His own by His hand!
Praise God and rejoice, worship Him;
A thousand thanks we gave for His great love;
With the heavenly multitude praise Him,
God, everlasting and our Redeemer.
chorus: The wonders we will sing
Of Jesus, the Redeemer;
Strength, life, goods we will give
To talk about His love!

hymns.title: Hear His Voice
stanzas: Christ with a loving voice
Call yourself to His light,
Make your soul happy
If you carry the cross.
Why don't you go back,
What bad path are you on?
At the end of which bitterness,
And you will suffer eternal pain.
Very soon you will find yourself
In the face of death, how atrocious
It will, without mercy, take you
Where you don't hear His voice!
Hear His loving voice
How it persists. to call;
With His mighty hand
Christ wants to set you free.
chorus: Hear His voice calling!
Christ wants to free you;
Speak in a loving voice:
“I want to give you peace today.”

hymns.title: Give Your Burden to Jesus
stanzas: Only in Jesus, do you want to rest?
Give your burden to Jesus.
Can't you find peace and help?
Give your burden to Jesus.
Redeeming peace your soul will have,
Give your burden to Jesus.
And he will free you from worries.
Give your burden to Jesus.
You don't want to run away from big fights,
Give your burden to Jesus.
If you cannot enjoy holy joy,
Give your burden to Jesus.
Evils assail you by the thousand, sinner?
Give your burden to Jesus.
Are you tired of sorrows and pain?
Give your burden to Jesus.
Christ will come to dispel your fear,
Give your burden to Jesus.
For He always gives strength to His saints,
Give your burden to Jesus.
chorus: Give your burden to Jesus,
Darkness will turn into light.
In Christ you will have a shelter in danger,
Oh, give your burden to Jesus.

hymns.title: The Creator's Love
stanzas: The rays of God's love,
They shone in my soul,
And the end I saw of my days,
Also One who saves me;
I already have light from heaven.
From darkness I was freed,
Now Christ leads me
In the desert lands!
To my Jesus I will give praise,
Because today I understand,
May the love of the great Redeemer,
Everything is providing for me;
Already before this creation
Jesus prepared me
The most perfect salvation;
Oh! As for me, he loved it!
The precious gift of Jesus,
Oh! God, you revealed it to me!
And Your love, heavenly light,
You poured into me!
Who will measure the love of God,
So holy, unfathomable,
Which fills the highest heavens;
Inexhaustible love!
chorus: Your love, O Creator,
He revealed himself there on the cross.
When it expired in my place
Who saved me: - my Jesus.

hymns.title: Go Segar
stanzas: For the fields to be harvested,
Here is the wheat blooming,
Go reap, go reap;
Every day I worked
And only talk about Jesus;
Go reap, go preach!
To the valley, mountain or sea,
The Lord wants to send you
To proclaim, announce;
The lost seek,
Because Jesus wants to save them;
Go speak, and proclaim!
We will speak fervently,
From the power of the Savior,
To the sinner, to the suffering;
The end will soon come,
The bugle will sound from heaven,
Then you will have the reward.
chorus: Go reap, go reap!
Yes, work, and proclaim!
Behold the love of the Savior
Urges you to His labor
