Without delay, go and reap.

hymns.title: Operate on Me
stanzas: Here I am at Your feet, Lord, work in me!
I hope for more vigor, work on me!
I will enjoy it, if Your law is fulfilled:
Give me Your love: work in me!
Thirsty, with ardor, work on me!
I ask you for more love, work on me!
You can only give me unparalleled perfection,
The good Comforter: works in me!
O my Lord Jesus, work in me!
By Your holy light, work in me!
Reveal to me the value of the Lord's death,
For me, on the hard cross; work on me!
Don't be late anymore. Lord, work in me!
Hear my cry, work on me!
In the blood of Jesus, shed there on the cross,
Please keep me, work on me!

hymns.title: Come to Jesus, O Lost One
stanzas: Come to Jesus; oh lost one,
Come to Jesus as you are;
The blood shed on the cross.
It will give you grace and peace.
Why are you still delaying,
Give your life to Jesus?
This is when everything here ends,
What will your light be?
The world wants to deceive you,
For your soul to lose,
Sad will be your part;
Besides, you wait for suffering.
The hours pass quickly,
You will never have them
When your life here ceases,
Where will your soul be?
Doors open to freedmen
In the sky of light they are always;
Behold, the assertive angels
They will be watching your entrance!
chorus: Come to Jesus, without delay;
O believe in the Son of God!
He saves you now,
It wants to guide you to heaven.

hymns.title: In My Soul Peace Reigns
stanzas: In darkness, without Jesus, I saw myself,
With a thousand sorrows and great pain;
But Jesus called, "Come, yes, come to Me,
I want to be your Savior."
By the great waves of perdition,
I was surrounded on the high seas,
Without having a pilot in the hurricane,
That you could guide me.
And if you find yourself struggling,
Without effective help,
Cry out to the Savior, cry out without delay,
His grace is very true.
chorus: In my soul peace reigns;
Since I came to Jesus;
I always have peace
And I enjoy it very truly.
For I saw from God, the light!

hymns.title: It's the Time to Harvest
stanzas: It's time to reap and you without wavering,
You declared without fear: “I can’t work?”
Come, while Christ, the Master, is calling you:
"Young man, young man, come to work!"
The drawers you collect: jewels of splendor
They will shine on your crown, and give brilliance;
Look for these jewels now; God is a rewarder;
Young. young man, get to work!
The morning is already passing, it will never return;
From harvest time will soon end;
And before your Lord you will find yourself empty;
Young, young, obey now!
chorus: Come and see the white fields are already there
Waiting for arms that will catch them;
Young man, wake up, be ready and alert!
Please respond immediately: “Here I am, Lord”
Look how ripe the harvest is;
What a glorious harvest it will be!
Young man, wake up. Be ready and alert!
There are few days left for the reaper!

hymns.title: Be Brave
stanzas: In the battle against evil, be brave!
Continue on your triumphal march, be brave!
Look at the target that is Jesus,
That leads you to victory;
Oh, don't leave your cross,
Be brave!
If the evil one confronts you, be brave!
You will fight without retreating, be brave!
Whether here, or wherever,
Shielded in the Lord.
You will show your value;
Be brave!
Co'altruism, with power, be brave!
Franco, without fearing evil, be brave!
To the fallen around.
Show them your love;
And you will be a winner;
Be brave!
The Gospel to proclaim, be brave!
In Brazil, on land or sea, be brave!
Your life will be ennobled!
Always live with Jesus,
And you also win;
Be brave!
chorus: Be brave! Fighting for Jesus,
Be brave! Never rejecting the cross!
Always firm in love,
With indomitable value,
Full of the Comforter,
Be brave!

hymns.title: Christ, Your Holy Love
stanzas: Christ, Your Holy Love You gave to me
Nothing for You, Lord, I will deny here;
I prostrate myself in gratitude,
I comply promptly,
Guide me Your hand, oh! I surrender to You.
Before the throne I stand, ask You, for me,
To our Father I go, only Jesus, for You;
I will carry the cross,
Proclaim your name,
A hymn to God to sing, yes, Jesus, for You.
A heart of love, I want, O my Jesus,
To Your equal, Lord, spreading the light;
I will serve You,
Time will redeem,
I want to lead souls to You.
Everything I have or am is because of Your favor;
I will always be happy, together there, Lord;
Your face, yes, I will see,
With you I will be,
And I will always live, I would go to heaven for You!

hymns.title: God Loved in Such a Way
stanzas: God so loved
This suffering world.
That to all humanity,
God His Son for Savior.
Prisoner of sin,
Vacancies without hope to have;
But Jesus was sent,
For freedom to bring you.
You who live astray
Without enjoying the peace of God,
Hear the voice of the beloved Father,
That waits for you to hug you.
chorus: And now it never perishes again
He who believes, has more eternal life;
Who in Christ abides.
He will be crowned beyond.
Sin on the cross was conquered,
You can, by faith, win too;
Of righteousness, O be clothed,
And you will receive a crown and beyond.

hymns.title: This World Does Not Understand
stanzas: This world doesn't understand.
How joyful is my life,
But to Christ he who attends,
You can have joy from heaven.
Which makes me very happy,
Oh, it comes from the love of God!
But my enjoyment will be greater,
When I go to live in the heavens.
I feel my being transformed,
By the grace of the Lord;
Getting closer every day.
I'm in love with my country.
chorus: Even when in distress,
I enjoy the peace of God;
Christ to my heart,
Joy brings from the heavens,
If with Christ I live here,
So glorious it is,
Greater glory I will have,
If I always keep the faith.

hymns.title: Jesus, O Gentle Savior
stanzas: Jesus, gentle Savior,
From heaven to earth you are coming,
And in Your arms with sweetness,
Oh! lead me;
So I will follow
In Your perfect light,
That always delights me;
Your Word, oh, Lord!
What a great joy it was for me,
Oh, when you found me!
From the heart, it finally opened
The door and then you entered;
So You took me,
By Your perfect light,
That always delights me;
Your Word, what love, yes!
You delivered me, Savior,
Of miserable luck,
You will keep me for Your love,
Faithful until death;
I want you to encourage me
By Your perfect light,
That always delights me;
Your Word, my Lord!
O Savior, and good Jesus,
My feet are deep in the rock;
For Your hand leads me,
The waters are very deep,
From the throne,
Your perfect light,
That always delights me;
Your Word, O Jesus!

hymns.title: We fly on this ship
stanzas: We sail, the sea wins,
In this ship that leads us,
We do not fear a shipwreck,
For at the helm goes Jesus.
To our happy abode,
It's time to leave;
The call is made today;
“Who wants to follow Christ?”
At the end of the crossing,
In the sky we will anchor;
With speed, with joy,
We'll have to jump.
Before us, we see the city,
Whose port will open.
And Jesus full of kindness
He will smile to those who arrive.
chorus: Come friend, because we love you,
Without delay, we'll be there;
We don't look at the storm
And we headed for the sky.
We don't look at the storm
And we headed for the sky.

hymns.title: It wasn't with gold
stanzas: We, the saved of the Lord,
Let us walk with value;
He guards the heart,
Christ is our salvation.
Through the death of Jesus,
We receive life and light;
From the abyss of horror,
We no longer have any fear.
We will follow the Lord,
For it guides us to the Creator;
Grant us real peace,
Give us eternal rest!
You who have no salvation,
Open your heart now.
Let Christ save you,
And for heaven to prepare you.
chorus: It was not with gold that Jesus bought us,
But with His blood shed there on the cross;
We who are saved go without fear,
Always by His blood evil wins.

hymns.title: The Blessed
stanzas: Blessed are
Those with a clean heart,
Who do not seek riches for themselves;
Tranquility and peace,
Who enjoy, oh, never,
They may be discriminated against by me!
Great saying and very much, please
Grant me my Lord,
For the blood he shed for me on the cross;
It will also become my being,
Full of true pleasure,
If you live and walk in His Light!
Obey the Lord,
Himself fill me,
For me this is true heaven;
And for His immense love,
For the poor sinner,
I want to praise Him here, and beyond the veil!
How perfect is my peace!
I long for nothing more,
I always want to do what you want here;
I have the beloved Savior,
And I possess His love;
I will enjoy eternal pleasure!
chorus: Oh, let us sing hallelujah!
Jubilant, with power!
Very happy, with fervor,
We gave Jesus praise,
And we will receive more joy from Him!

hymns.title: The Lord's Supper
stanzas: O Jesus Christ, here we are
United all in one place,
For Your death we remember,
That You wanted to prove to us.
We rejoice, it is Jesus beloved,
Filling us with the Comforter;
O great grace You have given us,
For we are saved by Your love.
May we be blessed;
Also the bread and wine here,
By Your power be consecrated
So that we can feed on You.
And when we all come together,
One day, there in Your home, in the heavens,
We hallelujah, yes, we will sing,
Eternal hymn to our God.

hymns.title: The Joy of Saints
stanzas: The joy of the saints is the love of Jesus.
Great is this love that peace produces for us!
The source of life, which gives us vigor,
It is the blood of Christ shed in pain!
Look, "behold the Man" who suffers there,
Covered in blood, wounded by you.
Print on the face such enormous pain
Of thorns crown possesses my Lord!
With nails, his feet and hands are pierced;
Nailed to the wood, in great distress;
Open your side with the cruel spear
Water and blood come out of Emanuel!
By Christ Fulfilled was the work of love,
He died like a Lamb, for you sinner;
Trusting now in the work of the Cross,
We have life through Christ Jesus.
chorus: Oh! See the grace of Jesus there on the cross,
Powerful love, what joy it produces!

hymns.title: I already know, I already know
stanzas: Bought with the blood of Christ,
Joyful to heaven, yes I go;
Freed from the cursed addiction,
I already know that I am God's son.
I am free from the harsh law,
For Christ wanted to redeem me,
Filling my soul, truly,
From the enjoyment, which comes from the future.
In Christ Jesus I always hope,
And I can never leave Him;
I don't want to shut up Your favors,
I will always talk about Christ!
I know that, one day, beauty
I will contemplate the great King;
Now give me strength,
And he always wants to comfort me!
I know the crown awaits me,
Which He will give to His servants,
Jesus, the divine person,
In heaven where He is!
chorus: I already know, I already know,
Bought with blood I am;
I already know, I already know,
With Christ to heaven, yes I go.

hymns.title: Already Washed Us
stanzas: On the cross the good Lamb,
Hard death has already proven,
For us all on the tree,
For God the Father bought us;
With His blood has washed
Our immortal soul,
And also rescued us
From the power of evil.
For the blood spilled
Free entry if given to us
In the hallowed place
Where the heavenly Father is;
This blood tells us
Infinity, immense love
Of Jesus, for it purifies
Every sinner!
We were predestined
To believe in Jesus,
With Spirit sealed,
To enjoy in the light;
If you believe today,
By God, you will be made,
For gifts you offer Him,
Priests, kings.
chorus: It has already washed us, It has already washed us,
With His precious blood, Jesus, Savior.
Set us free, set us free,
With His precious blood of the vile tempter.

hymns.title: The Joy of Being Prepared
stanzas: We are ready to meet the Bridegroom,
Behold, it will come from heaven.
With our lights we will wait,
Jesus won't be late!
We will have a crown in heaven,
If Christ lives in us;
Soon He comes breaking the veil,
Evil comes to undo!
There in Zion we will find
With our Redeemer;
In eternal glory we will enjoy
Of divine love!
chorus: Oh! what joy is prepared,
For the servants of the Lord Jesus;
Christ will soon return from heaven
In glorious light!

hymns.title: O Discouraged Sinner
stanzas: O discouraged sinner
Come to Jesus, your Savior;
Why live in trouble?
Come to Jesus, your Savior;
Here is Christ calling you,
Because he wants to give you His great love,
Come into His arms, throwing you
Come to Jesus, your Savior.
Oh, do not reject freedom,
Come to Jesus, your Savior;
Receive holiness today;
Come to Jesus, your Savior;
Everything here in the world passes;
Thou shalt die, O sinner,
Come accept true grace,
Come to Jesus, your Savior.
If you want peace, also joy,
Come to Jesus, your Savior.
For in Him you will have rest,
Come to Jesus, your Savior;
You will have nothing but sadness,
Here in this world of horror,
But in Jesus there is strength,
Come to Jesus, your Savior.
Today is the pleasant day,
Come to Jesus, your Savior.
O Your love is irresistible,
Come to Jesus, your Savior.
Your hours pass by,
O despise not, sinner;
The voice of God inviting you.
Come to Jesus, your Savior.

hymns.title: We implore the Comforter
stanzas: Come to the Lord, and complete
Your work in me:
Make my soul dear,
Filling me with You.
I've been waiting for you for so long.
O dear Savior,
But today I want
The good Comforter.
You've been taking me out
From the seductive world;
Oh come seal me now
Glorious Redeemer.
To You belongs the glory,
Benign Savior;
You always give me victory,
For Your immense love.
chorus: Oh send now,
The good Comforter;
My soul begs you,
My beloved Lord!

hymns.title: Oh Joyful Day
stanzas: Christ can come today,
Oh joyful day! I will go friends to see;
Evil will come to an end.
If Christ comes down from heaven!
If you go to my home today,
Oh joyful day! I seem to hear
The saved singing: “Come!’
If only the sky would go!
Why be anxious?
Oh joyful dayI There is light on the shore beyond;
There will never be a storm;
From heaven soon Christ comes!
I am faithful to Jesus,
Oh joyful day! I am free to say:
“Christ is everything to me”;
From heaven will come with power!
chorus: Oh joyful day, of the coming of Jesus!
Jesus comes to take me to heaven;
He comes soon to His own;
Oh joyful day! From the coming of Jesus!

hymns.title: Let's March Without Fear
stanzas: To Zion we march without any fear,
By faith we call ourselves children of the Lord;
We quickly walk, without looking back,
With Jesus we go, we cannot go wrong.
To Zion we march without losing heart,
The truth, let us all proclaim;
Soon we walk, carrying the cross,
For we desire to see Jesus in heaven.
To Zion we march in heavenly light,
Directed we go to the Lord Jesus;
As soon as we walk, the veil is torn;
From here we are, by faith, seeing heaven.
chorus: Let us march without fear, full of valor,
Let us march in the footsteps of the good Redeemer;
Quickly, without delay, until you enter heaven;
Through Jesus we can always triumph.

hymns.title: I firmly trust
stanzas: I firmly trust,
That in heaven I will rest
With Jesus joyfully, hallelujah!
What heavenly pleasure you feel
My soul in thinking,
I will enjoy the glory in heaven!
In heaven I will see the Lamb,
That for me wanted to expire,
Hanging on the tree, hallelujah!
That also made me heir
Than will never wither,
I will enjoy the glory in heaven!
Of Jesus, the holy face,
In the sky I will contemplate,
Where there is no pain or crying, hallelujah!
But rather a sublime song
That will forever sound
In glory, in heaven I will enjoy!
When I go to heaven
And glory reach
For having Christ by my side, hallelujah!
On His throne seated,
I will worship Jesus;
Eternal glory I will enjoy in heaven!
chorus: What eternal glory I will enjoy in heaven!
With Jesus, who saved me from sin;
Holy peace and joy in heaven I will enjoy;
Eternal glory Christ bought me!

hymns.title: When Opening the Service
stanzas: We opened this cult
In Your name, O Jesus Christ!
For children and adults,
Divine light comes to realize this;
We will enjoy Your face,
O resurrected Lamb
With sweetness, yes, in the bonds,
To listen to what is given to us.
O send us Your Word
By Your Holy Spirit,
That in the chest a fire burns,
That also wipes away tears;
Our Father, we beseech You
New life for Your Church;
Oh, don't be late, because we want
What purity in us You see.
Bless, O Holy God,
Your servants throughout the world;
Bless our corner
And gives life to the dying;
Bless the lambs,
The family of Your loved ones,
Like a bird in its nest.
His children are well sheltered.

hymns.title: Praise Jesus
stanzas: Praise Jesus, loving one;
On the cross he took away his sins,
That fills us with Holy joy;
With blood heaven won us.
Praise the mighty Jesus,
Who came to free me from prison
A captive, fearful people,
That there was no consolation.
Praise Jesus, your guide
In the world of tribulation;
And have no fear, whoever trusts
In God, but real protection.
Praise Jesus, give Him glory,
For King and Lord He is;
On the cross he won our victory;
Conquer with Jesus by faith.
chorus: To my Lord,
That I have in my heart,
I give praise,
For He gave me salvation.

hymns.title: Peace of God in Jesus I found
stanzas: Peace and joy Jesus has already given me,
This is why he lowered the world;
To save me, His blood shed,
When he expired for me on the cross.
Peace and joy I enjoy at last,
Through Jesus Christ, my Redeemer;
A holy love, oh, I have in me,
What I got from the Comforter!
Peace and joy have my heart,
Celestial life, full of love;
Christ gave me real salvation,
Also the gift of the Comforter.
chorus: Peace of God in Jesus I found,
For I have joy in my heart;
Honor and glory I will tax
To what brought me salvation.

hymns.title: Rest in Jesus
stanzas: Have you found rest in Jesus Christ?
Do you stand by the grace He gave?
Do you have peace with your blessed Savior?
Fullness of the Spirit of God?
You will be very safe and courageous,
When temptation comes to you?
You have the grace to be Victorious
In the terrible trials of life here.
Only in Christ will you find rest,
That no one here will ever take away;
With Jesus you will learn to be meek,
And His glory in you the world will look upon.
chorus: Have you found rest in Jesus Christ?
Do you stand by the grace He gave?
You will find complete peace and consolation in prayer:
God then granted victory to the saints.

hymns.title: God Keep Us in His Love
stanzas: May God keep us well in His love;
Wherever we find ourselves,
We will praise His name;
God keep us well in His love!
God keep us in sanctification
In the hardships of the journey,
Which is very soon finished!
God keep us in Sanctification!
May God keep us and grant us peace,
What we need so much;
Oh, while we live here,
God keep us and grant us peace.
chorus: When Jesus returns we will be
Free from any separation;
U’a crown, so let’s, yes, form,
There in heaven, in the eternal mansion.

hymns.title: Hosanna and Glory
stanzas: Already close to Bethphage, the Master ordered:
“Oh, go to the village, which I see,
Bring Me a donkey that no one has ridden
Tell those who ask: "Jesus asked."
They brought the colt, on which Jesus sat,
The people decorated the path with branches;
To the one who is a daughter of Zion, immediately say to her:
Do not fear but rejoice, here comes the King.
On the Mount of Olives, a cry was heard:
“Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord”;
Jesus says to those who tell him to silence the crowd:
“If these remain silent, the stones will cry out.”
chorus: Hosanna and glory gave to the Lord Jesus,
The King who comes bringing love, power and light;
He has also been granting effective forgiveness;
That's why they praise Him with all their hearts.

hymns.title: O come, Lord, and dwell
stanzas: O come, Lord, and dwell in my heart;
Give me the blessed grace of Your compassion.
I will enjoy a day of peace and joy,
When Jesus gloriously baptizes my soul.
Of Your pure and holy love I will always speak;
Even with pain and with tears I will praise Christ.
O God, I ask you now, hear me Lord
Baptize me at this time, in Your Comforter!
chorus: Oh my God come give me
The gift of the Comforter;
Come seal me today,
Filling me with Your love!

hymns.title: Bride of Jesus, Get Ready
stanzas: My soul is united to Christ,
For in Him I have my summer sustenance;
It fills me with the joy of heaven, and with calm;
Also teach me your commandments.
In the holy Church, with blood redeemed,
His glory is already manifest in me,
Which by His grace was granted to me,
In which shelter, I will have victory.
So I wish Christ united,
Follow the path to the beautiful city,
For in Him, from evils, I am well protected,
Also surrounded by Vera kindness.
chorus: O Bride of Jesus, get ready to go
For the eternal and holy reign;
What divine love you will then enjoy
With Jesus Christ, your beloved!

hymns.title: Don't Miss Worship
stanzas: To the other cult; don't miss,
Oh come everyone to praise
The holy name of the Lord,
That gives us life and fervor.
We part in love,
Bringing the peace of the Savior,
But come soon, do not miss,
Sinners yes, bring.
If we can't get together
We will see saints in the future,
In the worship of the Lord Jesus
That there will be light in Heaven.

hymns.title: Holy, Holy are You Lord
stanzas: Holy, holy are You, Lord,
In Your praise I will sing
With hope, O God of love;
You want to console me;
I ask you, O my Jesus,
Only You are my Savior,
May you make me walk in the light;
Holy are you, my Redeemer!
Holy, holy, I will sing,
to my Jesus, who saved me,
And only in Him will I trust,
For my soul rescued;
Give me the bread from Heaven to eat.
The heavenly manna,
For Your people to strengthen,
With Your vital power.
In Jesus alone I will seek,
His divine strength,
What forward will take me,
To the eternal kingdom;
Oh! how sweet is Your bread,
That gives us real vigor
In the desert; consolation,
That fills us with fervor.
chorus: To my Jesus I will sing
Entering happy Zion;
Oh! Holy, holy, I will proclaim
In my eternal mansion,
With the angels and seraphim,
Holy! I will always sing
With Archangels and Cherubim;
I will worship Jesus.

hymns.title: Forward, O Believers
stanzas: Forward, O believers, undoing evil,
We will fight the enemy with light;
The battle therefore, all, not fearing,
We will receive victory through Jesus.
Forward, O believers, march without delay,
We will never move away from the good Jesus,
Because in Him we have hope
And victory we will achieve.
Forward, O believers, courageous faithful,
Victory through Jesus is granted to us;
In combat, oh be valiant,
To achieve the reward of life.
Forward, O believers, of one mind;
"The vile sin we will always fight."
For Jesus is coming, not a moment late,
Believing in Jesus, we already have victory.
chorus: With the grace of Jesus we will stand firm,
With the grace of Jesus, we will fight,
With the grace of Jesus we will overcome ourselves,
With the grace of Jesus we have victory.

hymns.title: Closer to Jesus
stanzas: Deeper in the love of Christ
I wish I was!
More humble in my being, I want
Always here to walk.
Deeper your will,
I want to know;
My life, in its entirety,
Show your being.
Deeper, with pain, it doesn't matter,
Because I want to be,
In Your divine love established,
To bear fruit.
Deeper, day by day,
I want to be,
The target, the Master, has to make me here,
Soon reach.
chorus: Closer to Jesus,
I want to live here;
Most holy, my Jesus,
I wish to always be.

hymns.title: My Redeemer
stanzas: On the cross dying my redeemer;
He took all my evils;
If you receive Him, you have His love,
For your sins, Jesus forgave.
God wants to save the vile evildoer,
as he promises, he will always do
Trust in Him, O sinner,
And by faith you will have new life.
Your light will soon end,
And you will enter into judgment;
Don't hold back, come to Jesus,
That your sins want to erase.
How wonderful, what great love!
If you believe today, you will be saved!
Christ calls you, come sinner,
And you will enjoy eternal joy in Heaven.
chorus: When God, the Blood comes,
That Jesus already said,
It will pass without hurting you,
In Egypt this happened.

hymns.title: Abandon This World of Horror
stanzas: Leave this sea,
Where you can sink;
Leave this world of horror,
The tide will take you,
Your boat will break,
O accept Jesus, the Savior!
Here are headlights shining
And dangers to mark;
Leave this world of horror,
At the bar beyond,
Your boat holds,
O Accept Jesus, the Savior!
Behold, voices without ceasing,
They do not get tired of crying;
Leave this world of horror,
Oh friend, listen now,
This voice will save you.
O accept Jesus, the Savior!
You don't listen to Jesus,
What calls you to light?
Leave this world of horror,
If you persist in wandering,
You won't be able to save yourself.
O Accept Jesus, the Savior!
chorus: Abandon it once,
This turbulent sea.
Today without delay;
of eternal punishment,
And I miss death so much,
Sinner flee quickly,

hymns.title: Unparalleled Forgiveness
stanzas: Loving Savior,
Unparalleled is your forgiveness;
Only You are my redeemer
And perfect salvation.
My contrite heart
Confess your sin to you,
Ask the royal Father for forgiveness,
For Your unparalleled love.
I contemplate you, without ceasing,
On your throne from here;
Oh how grateful it is to meditate,
That You intercede for me.
The source is compassion,
I will always give You praise!
It's good for my heart,
Exalt You, my Lord!

hymns.title: Firmed on the Eternal Rock
stanzas: A gentle Savior is Christ Jesus,
For he saved my soul;
He also took upon himself my sins,
On the cross when he rescued me.
The blessings of Heaven enjoying I am,
In Christ, the Son of God;
Joyfully I live and walk in the light,
I continue on the path to Heaven.
The burdens I had, Jesus took them,
Now I am free;
The grace that Christ gave me is enough for me,
So to heaven I go.
When the work is finished, I will see Him,
with angels and saints in Heaven;
And hymns of glory I will sing,
He who died for me.
chorus: I am established on the eternal rock,
And I have salvation;
Jesus Christ hides me in His mantle,
Watching over me with His hand.
Watching me with your hand.

hymns.title: I believe in the Bible
stanzas: I believe in the Bible, the Book of the Lord,
For Jesus Christ shows sweet love;
all my sins are erased,
Peace and joy I have in my heart.
I believe in the Bible, teach me to sing
Songs of victory and unparalleled love;
Beautiful melodies, I will sing,
Because I am redeemed by the Blood!
Only the holy Bible gives holiness,
This gift of Christ, already promised;
All who seek full salvation,
These blessings, only in Christ, will you find.
Today we read the Bible to every sinner,
So that you may find Christ, the Savior;
Being your life, free from sin,
The divine Book, he will honor!
chorus: I believe in the Bible, the book of my God;
For me, the Bible is manna from heaven!
Show me the way to the heavenly home;
I think in the Bible, divine grace!

hymns.title: Forward with Our Captain
stanzas: Brothers forward, forward with our Captain,
We will be triumphant, you will not fight in vain!
Victory we hope, victory God will give,
If we fight firmly, yes, against Goliá.
Delightful places, luck has touched us;
From such painful yokes Jesus freed us;
An inheritance has been given to us, an inheritance of value;
In Heaven it is preserved by God, my Savior.
With our Commander, onward, fight;
Joyful, exultant, for Christ advance,
We already have the Sword, we don't have to fear,
The Holy Bible to overcome all evil
chorus: Forward, forward, the darkness dispels
with the supreme Captain, forward! Victory achieve!

hymns.title: Sad, Dejected Soul
stanzas: Sad, dejected soul,
That you are afraid of dying;
By the skin of his teeth, life comes,
It may perish today;
See the seas and the pain,
A beacon beaming light,
That fills you with praises:
It's Jesus, yes, it's Jesus!
You who are wavering
And that the world seduced,
Come and follow, confident,
Who on the cross has already redeemed you,
For grace is never ending
Of those who expired on the cross;
Look, with love, still,
For Jesus, yes, for Jesus!
There on the cross Jesus dying,
Your sins atoned;
Holy Spirit granting,
His Church adorned,
All evil and suffering,
Already nailed to the cross,
Oh, sublime deliverance,
Of Jesus, yes, of Jesus!
At Your feet, kind Jesus,
I find peace, consolation!
You fill me with holy joy
And with immense gratitude;
I want constantly
Receive the pure light,
That shines strongly
Of Jesus, yes, of Jesus!

hymns.title: Lord, You are with me
stanzas: Lord, you are with me at all times,
Making me happy in suffering,
Give me Your sustenance every day
And grace to fulfill Your commandment.
With you, O Lord, I walk,
The holy Gospel proclaiming:
The face of the Lord Jesus seeking,
And always guarding me from sin.
By God we are sanctified
In You, Jesus, who has rescued us
From the world and from all vile sin,
Also our being vivified.
chorus: Yes, you are with me at all times,
You are my manna, my food;
Jesus, you are with me at all times,
O give me Your life; Your Sustenance.

hymns.title: At the End of the Service
stanzas: The service having already ended,
We beseech you, O Savior,
If in anything was disturbed,
May You forgive us, for Your love.
Record You will the sound doctrine,
By Your Consoling Spirit,
That sustains us, that teaches us,
And that fills us with Your love.
If we never return here,
Surely we have to see in the light
The saints together and contemplate
In heaven, one day, the good Jesus!

hymns.title: O Heavenly Father
stanzas: O heavenly Father in the holy name
From Your beloved Son Jesus,
Thank you, seal our corner,
How reverent Thy flock produces;
O God, preside over Your united people,
With Your grace and Your power,
In the Holy Spirit already received,
We wish to live here.
Divine rock, our steadfastness,
Give us grace, give us power;
You are the strength of Your servants,
Where, sheltered, they are not afraid;
Rains of blessings always pour
In abundance from the high heavens;
Our soul, like a roaring deer
In great drought for You, good God!
Holy flock, sealed by God,
Of one mind, of one heart,
And may it be so,
See, we hope, with readiness;
O defend us with Your arm,
From the enemy, from the tempter;
Always direct our steps,
The living springs that give vigor!
Send, Lord, Your message
By divine and sacred anointing,
What manna did he bring on his journey?
For Your people, consolation;
Your Word, water of life,
From our cup, make it overflow,
Full of grace, well directed,
So that the thirsty can be satisfied.

hymns.title: It is sweet to believe in Christ
stanzas: Oh! how sweet it is to believe in Christ.
And give yourself to Jesus,
Wait on His promises
And walk in His light!
It is very sweet to believe in Christ,
And fulfill His will,
Not disbelieving His Word,
Which is light for our being.
It is very grateful to believe in Christ;
When you look for the heart
The infinite treasures
Of love, peace and forgiveness.
I always want to trust you,
My precious Savior;
In peace and in struggle,
Protect me with Your love.
chorus: Jesus Christ, Jesus Christ,
Your love gave me to me!
Jesus Christ, Jesus Christ,
I always want to believe in You.

hymns.title: We Were Rescued
stanzas: We rescued went,
For those who wanted to save us;
In Christ we are free,
To never sin again!
In Christ we are free,
To never sin again!
We have already been elected,
Heaven, to enjoy;
Also accepted by God
To never sin again!
Also accepted by God
To never sin again!
Immortality
We will have fun,
Because we have freedom
To never sin again!
Because we have freedom
To never sin again!
In the midst of the redeemed
I will praise Christ,
For receiving Him
To never sin again!
For receiving Him
To never sin again!
chorus: Rescued we were,
Rescued we were,
Rescued we were,
To never sin again!

hymns.title: Jesus My Strength
stanzas: It gets closer and causes terror,
The predicted flood of sin and pain;
But I know how powerful the hand of the Lord is,
So, calm down, I have no fear.
Closer to Christ I wish to remain;
I always want to walk happier and happier,
In His footsteps, following to never make mistakes,
Until one day I go to rest.
chorus: Jesus is my strength, my beloved Lord,
If He is the guard, I have no fear;
I desire to be filled with Your great love,
Living in the grace of my Savior.

hymns.title: Trusting in God
stanzas: Be you, in God confident;
Pray a lot to Jesus,
And joyful, triumphant,
Always carry your cross.
In the Lord he has hope;
For His hand guides you;
Come to Him without delay,
And you will have consolation.
If you are persecuted here,
You have the glory of the future;
If you are weakened,
New forces will come;
Even if the sun dims,
Let there be a strong hurricane,
Be faithful, don't be upset,
Believe in God, with your heart.
chorus: Glory, glory. Hallelujah, hallelujah to Jesus!
Hallelujah! Glory to Jesus!
Glory, glory. Hallelujah, hallelujah to Jesus!
Hallelujah to the Redeemer! Amen.

hymns.title: I will praise My Beloved
stanzas: I will praise my beloved;
Exalted above all;
By His blood I was purchased;
I am all His.
In His name there is melody;
How soft in harmony!
Fills souls with joy
That sound - Jesus!
Worthy is trustworthy,
Very faithful and without change;
In Him is my hope;
I'm pretty sure!
I will follow your path,
Your strength girding me,
As my career continues,
You can enter heaven.
There I will see my glorious King,
Crowned, majestic,
More than everyone loving,
My Lord Jesus.

hymns.title: Praising Our Savior
stanzas: I feel pleasure praising
To our Creator,
And I enjoy celebrating
The deeds of the Lord;
Knowing that I am washed
In the blood of Jesus.
Also that I am guided,
By divine light!
In Christ I have joy,
And peace, heavenly light;
In the work, I rest,
Fulfilled there on the cross;
Freely coated,
I will lack nothing;
Christ has promised,
That everything will supply!
Happy I move forward,
On the path that leads
The glowing door
From the mansion of Jesus;
With God here I walk,
He will guide me,
And finally taking me,
Take me to heaven!
chorus: Happy I will go forward,
United with the Savior;
Singing triumphantly,
To our Creator!

hymns.title: At the Savior's Mansion
stanzas: There in the Savior's mansion,
There is never tribulation;
No regret, no pain,
That breaks my heart.
It's sad for me to be here,
Very far, yes, from the Savior,
For they already live with Him there,
Those saved by His love.
Perfect love I will find,
There in my Lord's mansion,
Complete peace, then I will have,
For the Savior will give me.
Being there. I will cum
Of all divine blessing;
Also, with Christ I will reign,
In His eternal glory.
chorus: There is no sadness and pain there,
No grief, no affliction;
When I'm living there
I will say: There is no tribulation.

hymns.title: When Jesus Appears
stanzas: When Jesus appears,
What a party it will be for us,
To the sky of light we will have,
To enjoy eternal pleasure,
When His Father presents us,
What joy there will be in heaven;
We will have a place on His throne,
On our forehead he will put a crown.
March with God, without stopping,
In holiness and without fear;
If you can do nothing else -
By believing in Christ - you have power,
If you believe today... God will give it to you;
If you have faith, you will receive,
Life of peace in heaven will enjoy
Everyone who believes in Jesus, our King.
We will go to heaven to supper
And Jesus Christ will serve us;
His flock that wanted to save,
In heaven, then, it will be reunited.
Like a strong sun, it will shine
Before Jesus, the eternal Lord!
Oh, what a pleasure, what a sublime love,
It will exist in the heavenly home!

hymns.title: Only to you will I turn
stanzas: Whether in darkness or in light,
Only to You will I turn,
Only there, my good Jesus,
And I will find help.
When fights, sorrows, pain,
In this world find,
I will seek You, Lord,
And you will come to console me!
When the great tempter
My soul fights,
By the grace of the Lord,
I will overcome all evil.
I will have fights,
In this deceiving world,
But help I will find,
In You, always, oh, Lord!
chorus: Only to You, my Lord,
Only to You will I turn;
Only in You, Savior,
A refuge I will find!

hymns.title: Jesus is the Light of the World
stanzas: The world lost in sin is found,
Jesus is the light of the world;
But in the thick darkness the glory shone,
Jesus is the light of the world!
In the darkness of the world we already have Bethel,
Jesus is the light of the world,
You will go by the light if you are faithful,
Jesus is the light of the world!
O blind and trapped in the valley of horror,
Jesus is the light of the world,
And commands to call you to see His brilliance,
Jesus is the light of the world!
There will be neither sun nor lights in the world
Jesus is the light of the world,
The light of His face will shine there,
Jesus is the light of the world!
chorus: Come into the light, don't want to miss it
Perfect peace, a new way of life:
I was blind, but I can now see,
Jesus is the light of the world!

hymns.title: Oh Wake Up, Wake Up!
stanzas: Oh wake up, wake up dormant,
You who lie in the sleep of death,
And that you have such sad luck.
O awaken for Christ, the Lord!
For the faithful Savior calls you,
His blood on the cross has already been shed,
Your sins there annihilated,
And you respond: "I don't want to, Lord?"
Don't you know that your own breath
Does it come from God, does it come every moment?
Do you want to wake up in torment
That can never end?
Christ wants to free you today,
Oh, wake up to the voice of the Savior,
Escape from the abyss of horror,
That your soul seeks to swallow.
Don't you care that you have it now,
Your soul in black dungeon?
Today believe in Jesus, seek Him and worship,
For in this way you will have salvation;
Believing in Christ in your heart,
Peace and joy through Him you will obtain;
And also in heaven you will dwell,
If you receive forgiveness now.

hymns.title: Into Canaan I will enter
stanzas: Into Canaan I will enter, into my blessed country,
And I will dwell in Zion; What peace will I have there?
With my Jesus! What a pleasure! For he will give me rest,
I will then sing, in the heavens, a hymn to my God!
I've been through a lot of trials and some very notable fights;
But I will not tire of walking until I see the King.
Jesus, who gives victory, will lead me in glory,
And I will enter into the splendor of the kingdom of the Lord.
Very soon Christ will return;
in the clouds, we will see Him;
And His people will take, and there will be a feast;
To heaven we will ascend, and there we will find
Our dear and good Jesus, truth, life and light.
chorus: Oh! Glory to Jesus, to Jesus, to Jesus!
Oh! Glory to Jesus, O my power and light!
The saints gathered, in the kingdom of the redeemed,
Finally, they will sing in the heavens,
a hymn to the good God!

hymns.title: Are you safe? Are you clean?
stanzas: You have found complete salvation in Christ,
For the blood shed on the cross?
Every stain washes from your heart,
This efficacious blood of Jesus.
You always live next to your Savior,
By the blood that flows from the cross?
You were always victorious over sin,
How was your blessed Jesus?
You will have white clothes when Jesus comes,
Have you been cleansed at the fountain of love?
Are you ready to go to the sky of light,
By the purifying blood?
Christ today gives purity and great power:
Stare at the cross of the Lord,
From it, a fountain comes out that fills you with pleasure,
That fills you with life and vigor.
chorus: You are safe, you are clean,
By the blood of Christ Jesus?
Your heart is whiter than light,
Have you been cleansed in effective blood?

hymns.title: Carry the Cross
stanzas: You are alone, and very tired,
Your cross, your cross?
Not knowing that you have by your side
The help of the Lord Jesus?
Don't forget that only, on Calvary,
It was Jesus, it was Jesus,
Where he defeated the opponent,
When for you he succumbed on the cross.
Only in Christ, the faithful friend,
You will find, you will find,
Hiding, in this good shelter,
The peace of God, then you will enjoy.
chorus: If I have loads that I just can't carry
I ask my good Savior for help!
If I'm tired I can no longer walk,
I cry out to my Jesus, who comes to give me His strength.

hymns.title: I want to go there, and you?
stanzas: Jesus told me about a beautiful place;
I want to go there, and you?
Where the saved will enjoy;
There I want to go; and you?
For Jesus went to prepare the mansions for us;
There I want to go; and you?
Where death cannot reach;
There I want to go; and you?
The doors are jewels, the sea is crystal;
There I want to go; and you?
Christ is the light of the heavenly country;
There I want to go; and you?
Those who enter there will never die;
There I want to go; and you?
Where does the tribulation end?
There I want to go; and you?
And when the ship of Zion sails,
There I want to go; and you?
By sailing to this mansion,
There I want to go; and you?
When will they crown Christ, too,
There I want to go; and you?
And when the choirs say, "Amen."
There I want to go; and you?
chorus: I want to go to heaven
I want to go to heaven,
I want to go to heaven; and you?
I want to go to heaven;
Don't you want to go?
In heaven I want to see Jesus!

hymns.title: O Jesus, I beseech You
stanzas: O Jesus, on Your path,
I beg you fervently,
I have more of you neighbor
To enjoy Your love.
O Lord, come and protect me
Under Your protection;
To heaven, come and guide me
By Your strong hand.
Give me Your heavenly joy,
And victory over evil;
Give me grace, Your rest,
Thy heavenly peace!
O Lord, come and comfort me,
In Your divine love!
Your life you want to give me,
My beloved Redeemer!

hymns.title: Come without delay
stanzas: Come to Christ without delay,
You don't want to refuse,
O friend, come quickly to Jesus!
Come from darkness to light,
Christ wants to console you,
Come to Him, O lost one, without delay!
Come to Christ without delay,
A treasure wants to give you;
He wants to grant you real forgiveness;
Christ sees your heart,
Your soul sobbing;
Come to Him, lost, without delay!
Come to Christ without delay,
He wants to satisfy you with His gifts,
With riches that will never be lost.
Come, stretch out your hand,
Christ wants to forgive you!
Come to Him, O lost one, without delay!
Come to Christ without delay,
Your tent will be established
On the rock that will keep you from evil;
The fear leaves now,
Come to Christ to save you;
He himself warns you: “Soon”!
chorus: Without delay, come without delay;
Without delay, come without delay.
O accept salvation,
In your poor heart,
Jesus Christ invites you: “Without delay”.

hymns.title: What Precious Blood
stanzas: What precious blood
Left Salvador!
Oh glorious blood,
That washes the sinner!
Brothers, let us remember
That the blood washed us
Joyful, jubilee
Your blood bought us!
In glory he sits,
Jesus, my Redeemer!
On the crowned throne,
My intercessor!
Why do you resist so
To the gentle Savior?
Accept Your invitation
For a love wedding.
chorus: Yes, the blood that Jesus
On the cross it poured;
Yes, the blood of Jesus,
My heart washed!

hymns.title: The Shepherd and the Sheep
stanzas: The Shepherd loves the sheep,
With a fatherly love,
The Shepherd loves his flock,
With a love like no other;
Love the Shepherd and others,
How lost they are,
And moved by the search,
Wherever they go.
The Shepherd loves his lambs,
With ineffable love,
To those who are sometimes lost,
Moans are heard in pain.
See the Pastor moved
Over the hills wander,
And the lambs on the shoulders,
See Him, leading to the place.
Love the ninety-nine,
That in the fold sheltered;
He loves the one who is lost.
In the field he strayed;
"O my lost sheep!"
The doleful Shepherd cries;
Who will come to your aid,
To save her, Lord?
Your pastures are delicate,
Very still your waters are;
Here we are. O good Master,
Give us true direction,
Make us zealous workers,
Fill us with holy love,
For the lost sheep
From Your fold, good Lord.
chorus: Through wandering deserts,
They see themselves suffering a thousand pains,
When he found them, on his shoulders
Take them happily to the fold.

hymns.title: Blessed Christ, Here I Am
stanzas: As I am, I will decide,
That I cannot go to another;
Because you invite me to come,
Blessed Christ, here I am.
As I am, without delay,
From evil, wanting to free me;
Only You can forgive me:
Blessed Christ, here I am.
As I am, in distress,
Exposed to death, and perdition,
Seeking life and forgiveness,
Blessed Christ, here I am.
As I am, Your great love
Overcome me, and I seek Your favor,
I want to serve you with value,
Blessed Christ, here I am.

hymns.title: You Are My Joy
stanzas: Lord, by faith I stand
In grace, in Your commandments,
That operate every moment,
In my heart, salvation!
The grace of God received,
It filled me with joy, with life,
And it is always granted to me
By our Lord, Redeemer!
Of blessings oh! comes flooding me,
My heart is inflaming,
Also my sins burning,
With all my being, with power.
chorus: You are my joy,
Lord, my fountain of love;
I will praise You forever in the heavens,
Very close to the throne of God!

hymns.title: It won't take long for Jesus to come!
stanzas: O Jesus, on this earth,
There is only sadness and pain;
The Wicked make war
To the saints of the Lord.
Of the world we are not,
But from the Lord Jesus;
Redeemed we all were
With blood, there on the cross!
In the dark world
We will not rest,
But to heaven, with joy,
We want to fly now!
We look up
Where will Jesus come from;
Because this encourages us
To live in the light.
chorus: Christ returns
In dazzling light;
The sea is already revolting,
It won’t be long before Jesus comes!

hymns.title: Oh, It Was the Blood
stanzas: Oh, it was the blood of the Lord
That saved me, yes, saved me;
Yes, this blood has power,
He washed me from every stain.
Oh! wonder of love
He showed me, yes, he showed me;
Jesus suffered such great pain.
And your life rescued.
There is no power in me
I'm very weak, I deserve pity.
But through Jesus I will overcome,
Even if I'm dust.
My Father gave me the Comforter,
To guide me, enlighten me,
I will never fear the tempter,
Jesus will always keep me.
chorus: Jesus has power and salvation for everyone,
My friend, come to Him, accepting remission;
Glory to the Savior! Glory to my Jesus!
Your blood saved me!

hymns.title: The Word of the Cross
stanzas: From the cross, the word is faithful,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Calling the one who is unfaithful,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Any storm can come,
The very firm message is:
That Jesus came to redeem us,
By death on the cross.
Dying for us there on the cross,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Victory won us Jesus,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
There the Lamb of God
The grace of heaven has come to dawn!
He who came from the heavens saved us,
By death, on the cross.
I'm not ashamed of the cross,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
For he gave me life, he gave me light,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
The path to heaven has opened,
For every vile sinner,
When Christ redeemed us,
By death on the cross.
chorus: Hallelujah! Hallelujah! The word of the cross is power.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! For those who believe in Christ.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! The word of the cross is power.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! For those who believe in Christ.

hymns.title: Under Your Blood
stanzas: Sprinkle my heart today,
With Your blood, to the Redeemer!
Free me from vile temptation,
With Your blood, Lord!
From all doubts, from fear,
In Your blood, come and wash me,
From the evils of the great tempter,
You want to free me!
Refuge finds the sinner,
In Your blood, O my Jesus;
Always sprinkle me, O Lord,
In the blood, from the cross!
O comes filling me with Your vigor,
By the flow of Your blood;
Making me more than a winner,
By the power of God.
Grant me perfect peace,
By Your cross and Your blood;
With rich gifts, O satisfy me,
And make me see the sky.
chorus: Under Your blood, Lord,
Keep me from corruption!
Under the atoning blood,
I have protection!

hymns.title: Your Spirit Comes to Pour
stanzas: O Lord, we wait
May you listen to prayer;
We, Your servants, have already cried out,
With a humble heart.
Let the fire of the Spirit,
Yes, in our hearts it burns,
So that everything that is finite,
You can never hold back.
O Lord, purify me,
Take away the evil that is in me,
My soul sanctifies,
And keep me until the end.
Give us more of Your grace,
And fill us with Your power,
From Your temple, O God, let it be
Your voice is heard.
Give us gifts of Your Spirit;
Perform miracles, O Lord,
So that everything you have said,
Be fulfilled, my Redeemer.
chorus: Your Spirit, come, pour out,
About every heart!
And in the believer, who cries out to You,
Come, confirm the petition.

hymns.title: The Message of the Cross
stanzas: Rude cross rose,
The day fled from her,
As an emblem of shame and pain;
But I contemplate this cross.
Because in her Jesus
He gave his life for me, a sinner.
From the glory of the heavens,
The Lamb of God,
He descended to the humiliating Calvary;
This cross is for me
Endless attractions,
Because in it Jesus saved me.
On this cross he suffered
And for me he already died,
My Jesus, to give me forgiveness
And I rejoice in the cross,
From her comes grace and light,
For my sanctification.
I here with Jesus,
The shame of the cross
I always want to take and suffer;
Christ comes to get me,
And with Him, at home,
I will have a share of the glory.
chorus: Yes, I love the message of the cross
Until I die I will proclaim it;
I will also carry my cross
You have to change a crown.

hymns.title: What is the Price of Forgiveness
stanzas: What is the price of forgiveness?
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.
What cleanses the heart?
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.
Performed effective rescue
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.
He gave us holiness and peace.
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.
You can always heal me,
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.
And free me from evil.
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.
There in heaven, I will sing:
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.
It gave me grace to enter.
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.
chorus: What is the real power
That cleanses all evil,
And gives divine peace?
Only the blood of Jesus Christ.

hymns.title: Jesus on Calvary
stanzas: Jesus on Calvary, suffered for me
The death of the curse;
My soul won, with His blood
The price of redemption.
From the top of the cross, Jesus exclaimed:
“It is finished”, the spirit surrendered;
The blood shed, atoned for me,
Uniting me with His people.
On the cross of Calvary, the ballot was
Cracked that He scratched.
The veil was torn, the door opened,
It remained open to God.
On the cross I died, with Christ Jesus;
My deceitful “ego” took the wood.
The night fled, and the light dawned!
By Christ I am saved.
On the cross of Calvary, I died to the world;
Here I remained a stranger;
I no longer live, I am united with Christ;
What an excellent life I found!
The Lamb of God has snowed my soul;
The Easter blood took away the guilt,
The destroyer of my soul has passed, S.N.
In Christ I am free.

hymns.title: I Go With Jesus
stanzas: Very sad in sin, I wandered without light,
But I already live happily, because I found Christ,
Every day, I sing to Jesus,
I follow with Christ, my Master, my King.
For years and years, without Christ, alone,
I have never, in the world, found myself happy;
But now with the birds I raise my voice,
And I sing happily, because I go as King.
O soul that you live in the ditch without light,
If you look up, you will see a lighthouse;
Oh, come up quickly, come to Jesus now;
From Christ, the light shines brighter than the sun.
chorus: I go with Jesus; Hallelujah!
I follow with Christ, the King;
I never wander, I want to follow
To Christ Jesus, my King.

hymns.title: New Song of Praise
stanzas: New song of praise,
Sing now, my heart;
Anthem of peace and love,
That brings me consolation.
I sing hymns of praise,
Because Christ saved me
From this deceiving world;
He established me on the rock
This new corner is
Each night that passes;
Shadows give way to faith,
If to God praise sing.
When the heart vibrates,
The chords from heaven,
And then the voice sounds,
In the garden of our God.
When my Jesus returns,
And take me with His own,
I will still sing,
This hymn there in the heavens.
chorus: Hear how sweet the praise,
To the divine Lamb!
Jesus, inspiring song,
Angelic harmony

hymns.title: In the Garden
stanzas: In the garden. Jesus Christ cried out,
When the wicked went to arrest Him;
And speaking to the Father he begged,
For the cup I was going to drink.
Like dew that gives life to flowers,
This is how prayer is for the believer;
My cares, sorrows and pains,
Christ knows them through my prayer.
Jesus had complete victory,
Because he always lived in prayer,
Many saints have come to glory,
Under the cloak of sweet prayer.
Renewed in strength we will be,
We will have a new anointing;
And with God, in the garden we will speak,
If we always live in prayer.
chorus: My soul longs to be with Jesus
In the garden, in constant prayer;
When night comes, and evil surrounds me,
I want to be in constant prayer.

hymns.title: Abundance of Christ
stanzas: Since Jesus gave me His light,
I can rejoice, sing;
He brought salvation to my heart
That I can't explain to you.
Since I contemplated Jesus on the cross,
My sins dissipated;
I have great peace and true forgiveness,
When at His feet I am.
From the cross comes a stream too,
That gives strength to the tired;
And from the wounds comes forgiveness, for those who
He is very thirsty and weak!
Thankful, then, I will give glory to Christ the King,
For the joy that is unparalleled;
In continuation, my heart,
You will be even more happy.
chorus: Christ gives abundantly,
Grace, of which there is no equal, there is none;
Hallelujah, glory to His name!
What joy I feel!

hymns.title: Forward, Servants of Jesus
stanzas: Forward, servants of Jesus, by our God;
In the darkness, let your light shine, the light from the heavens.
Get up, Joshua banner. with great value;
And the enemy then flees in great fear.
Go out with three hundred Gideon, to fight;
The Midianites will soon lose the war.
Goliath is very proud, he mocks God.
But David comes, and gives it to him, with the help of heaven.
Close ranks, O faithful ones, always advance;
In heaven, crowns and laurels, Jesus will give us.
chorus: Glory to God, for I will win,
Glory to God, for I will win,
Triumphant I continue, carrying the cross!
Glory to God, for I will win,
Glory to God, for I will win,
In the name of Jesus!

hymns.title: There is a New Song
stanzas: There is a new corner in my being,
It is the voice of my Jesus,
Who calls me: 'Come to me and obtain
The peace that I won on the cross.”
Trapped in sin I found myself,
No peace in my heart;
But in Christ I have already found
Sweet peace and protection.
I have Your divine grace,
Under the wings of love,
And riches that flow in flood,
There from the throne of the Lord.
He took me through deep waters,
I found many proofs;
But blessed Jesus guided me
By His blood I will overcome.
Christ, in a cloud will return,
It will descend from heaven in light;
By His power he will lead me,
To His home, the good Jesus.
chorus: Christ, Christ, Christ, name without equal;
You fill the contrite with heavenly pleasure.

hymns.title: Our Hope
stanzas: Jesus, yes, comes from heaven, in glory He comes!
Echoes the new throughout the world beyond;
Oh hope that His Church has!
Give glory to God, Jesus is coming soon!
Jesus, yes, come, the dead are waiting;
The great moment of resurrection
And from the grave they will soon rise!
Give glory to God, Jesus is coming soon!
Jesus, yes, comes from heaven surrounded by splendor,
Annihilating corruption and pain,
Breaking the bonds of the cunning usurper,
Give glory to God, Jesus is coming soon!
Jesus, yes, come, completely restore
The world that is ruining itself without stopping;
Yes, all things come quickly to transform
Give glory to God, Jesus is coming soon!
Jesus, yes, come, and eternal adoration
We will give our hearts to the King;
To the great author of our eternal salvation,
Give glory to God, Jesus is coming soon!
chorus: Our hope is Your coming
The King of kings comes to seek us;
We wait, Jesus, still,
Until the morning light dawns.
Our hope is Your coming
The King of kings comes to seek us;
We wait, Jesus, still,
Until the morning light dawns.

hymns.title: Come Supper
stanzas: Christ has already prepared us
A delicacy that he bought for us,
And now, he invites us to supper:
With heavenly manna
That God gives you freely,
Come, hungry, your soul will be satisfied.
Here are the disciples returning,
Without catching fish,
But Jesus tells them to leave again,
When returning to the beach, then,
They see fish and bread in the fire,
And Jesus, who invites them to supper, comes.
Whoever finds himself thirsty,
Come to Christ without delay,
For wine without mixture He gives;
And also of life, the bread,
That brings us consolation;
Behold, everything is ready.
Soon Christ will descend,
And the Bride receives
Your place next to the Lord Jesus;
Who endured hunger.
And the thirst has passed,
There in heaven you will dine in holy light.
chorus: “Come supper”, the Master calls – “come supper”.
Even today you can be satisfied;
Few loaves multiplied,
Water turned into wine,
Come, hungry, to Jesus, “come to supper”.

hymns.title: Do not murmur; Sing
stanzas: There is so much murmuring in the world,
Among those who claim to be Christians;
Instead of Praises there is weeping,
Weakness instead of power.
They murmur - so in the desert,
In Marah, Israel murmured;
Oh! They do not see that God is near;
Never denied His help.
You live, brother, murmuring,
Just like a slave to evil;
If God is testing your faith,
You have no reason to.
God punishes the one he loves,
From you. he didn't forget either;
Which loving father calls you,
And take care of what is yours.
And even if the waves roar.
In the raging and wild sea,
You can see the heavens open,
If your soul sings a hymn,
Do not fear snares or death,
Upward thou shalt look;
The rudder holds very tight,
Until the light shines from the sky.
If you can sing a hymn,
In times of great distress.
Then you will fly, if you want,
To the heavenly mansion;
On eagle's wings carried.
Very close to the crystal sea
And finally freed,
The earth, arrive, heavenly.
chorus: Instead of murmuring, sing
A hymn of praise to God;
Jesus wants to give you holy life,
Which bride will take you to the heavens.

hymns.title: We need Jesus
stanzas: When the sun shines anywhere,
You need Jesus;
When it gets dark, everything disappears.
You need Jesus!
To obtain forgiveness, full salvation,
You need Jesus;
To walk firmly, without making mistakes;
You need Jesus!
Even if there is peace, very true calm,
You need Jesus;
In persecution, in tribulation,
You need Jesus!
When death enters your own home,
You need Jesus;
Before the court, final decision,
You need Jesus!
chorus: I need Jesus,
You need Jesus;
Sinner, come to the light
Who shone on the cross;
You need Jesus!

hymns.title: The Adored Face of Jesus
stanzas: Despising all the pain I go to sing,
And Calvary, to the sinner, always points;
Arrows pierced me, I suffered great pain;
But Jesus, my light, made me victorious.
May the dark night be when serving Jesus,
But when you cry out, the light will shine with power;
May the bonds of Satan, all, surround me,
But Jesus, through the cross, makes me triumph!
When I'm gazing at the mountain beyond,
Where the struggle rules, there is Jesus too,
Who extends His hand over us from there;
I know that for me, Christ watches over here.
If among the waves I am without light, almost perishing,
My Pilot is Jesus, it can help me;
My boat sails well through the rough sea,
Yes, Jesus leads me, I can calm down!
chorus: I will see the adored face of Jesus,
With the beloved flock, I will be in heaven,
In the golden mansion, hymns I will sing
To Jesus, my light, who wanted to save me!

hymns.title: Champions of light
stanzas: We are soldiers of Jesus
And champions of good, of light;
In the armies of God,
We battle for the skies,
Singing, let's fight.
Vile sin and its power;
The battle is won;
God gives us victory.
Take the shield, yes, of faith,
Because the battle is tough,
But we have a promise
To never fight alone.
- The arrows of evil do not fear,
But fight until you win,
The champions look to the heavens,
Victory comes from God.
If someone tired finds himself,
No strength to fight,
The Lord wants to help you
Victory to achieve;
Evil winning, advance,
And sing hymns to Jesus,
And speak of salvation;
Lead souls to the Lord.
chorus: We will soon end the battle here,
And to always rest with Jesus there;
All who are faithful to the good Captain,
They will receive laurels as a reward.

hymns.title: The Word of God is a Treasure
stanzas: The Word of God is for me
A treasure without equal in value!
It speaks of God's love, of the love that has no end;
More precious than gold is this love!
Light that guides the path of peace,
And gives light to those who are in darkness;
Lamp that makes us see Satan's wiles,
And it shines even in the dark.
It is a lighthouse that has always shone.
And which shows the port of salvation;
Who has already entered the ark?
and the world forgot,
You will certainly arrive at the eternal mansion.
chorus: The Word of God is sweet, sweeter than honey,
He who takes it by faith must be faithful,
Because God gave us Immanuel,
Living rock flowing with milk and honey.

hymns.title: Praise to the Triune God
stanzas: To the Father, the Son, the Redeemer,
To the divine Comforter;
To the triune God, yes, adore,
Give eternal praise. Amen.

hymns.title: Only the Blood of Jesus
stanzas: Only the Blood of Jesus has the power to wash us,
And cleanse us from every stain;
Everything that is washed is in this atoning blood.
No longer fear death or pain!
Only the blood of Jesus protects us from corruption.
And deliver us from vile temptation;
This blood has value, as it is the price of love
With which the Lord rescued us.
Only the blood of Jesus has the power to preserve
The faithful one who wants to please God;
All gold is worthless to pay the big favor,
Of eternal and divine love!
chorus: Only blood can free,
And also wash ourselves;
By blood we will reach,
The home of Jesus.

hymns.title: At the end of the day
stanzas: The work of this day is over, O blessed Savior;
Here we are all gathered together to sing Your praise;
Come fill us with Your holy and sweet love!
Reading the Word, come, Lord, bless,
And in the hearts of believers Your teachings come to be engraved.
Your blessings continue to pour out!
Congregants we find ourselves constrained by love
That emanates from Your name, O beloved Savior;
Learning from Your book, O Lord! Amen.

hymns.title: Forward I Go
stanzas: Jesus is the Redeemer, who came to save us,
From the world of horror, from the waves of this sea;
He will give victory to everyone who believes,
Also real power, what joy it will bring you.
Jesus my Savior, will take me to Heaven,
And the destroyer's body will crush,
To the dear Redeemer, faithful here I will be,
I will only follow Him with fervor.
Trumpet will sound from our Creator;
The flock will rise up from the saints of the Lord;
In glory and power Jesus will return,
His servants will see Him, for He will soon return.
Behold, Jesus will come to take me,
Enjoying His unparalleled love in light;
Abraham, Isaac and Job there in heaven I will see,
Next to Jacob, I will eat with them.
chorus: Onward I go, onward I go,
To enter heaven, into the divine mansion;
I enjoy very deeply; Jesus in the heart,
Not looking at the world, I go forward.

hymns.title: Jesus, My Savior
stanzas: Jesus saved me from the world,
He's so sweet to me;
Love, I have for you, deep,
By His endless grace;
When I was in the desert,
Without joy, peace and without light,
He looked for me, of course,
You found me - Jesus!
Jesus of Sharon is the rose,
Soft lily is for me;
He is the precious rock,
Where there is endless joy;
It's the morning star,
In the dark and lightless night,
I'm happy to see you,
Because she is my Jesus!
In the manger being born,
In the world, there was only battle;
In my place suffering,
Blood for me shed,
He rose from the grave,
Ascending to the right hand of God;
Soon it will come from above,
Descending in clouds from the heavens.
chorus: Jesus, Jesus, You are my Savior,
Jesus, Jesus, I will only be Yours, Lord.
On the very true path,
Guide me Your hand,
And when my career ended,
I will receive reward.

hymns.title: The Coming of Christ
stanzas: The Lord ascended triumphantly to heaven:
Just like that, you will return;
“Behold, I come quickly,” says the Savior,
When the noise echoes.
With Christ I find myself, I will go with joy.
When He in the clouds descends,
A body like Yours, that day I will have;
What a glorious day it will be.
Blessing Christ, I will enter heaven;
I will enter the millennium;
Only with my Jesus, I will return here.
For all nations come to judge.
Come and reign over Your people, O Lord!
Your reign here brings joy,
Oh come, bring us protection, Savior!
Come, Jesus, with justice and peace!
Come, Christ, my King, Your Bride to seek;
I want to go up with you;
A perennial song I want to sing to you,
And eternal glory will be enjoyed.
chorus: With great caution I want to be
Waiting for my Lord,
And always be alert here to watch.
My Savior must come.

hymns.title: Praise to the Trinity
stanzas: Give praise to the Eternal Father,
To His Son too,
And to the heavenly Comforter,
Praise forever. amen!

hymns.title: The kind father
stanzas: I have a kind Father in heaven.
I have a kind Father in heaven,
To Him I will soon go,
And I will see my Father in heaven;
I will go, I will go, I will go to heaven;
I will go, I will go, I will go to heaven;
My Father calls me, I'm going to walk
For His face to behold.
I have a Savior there in heaven;
I have a Savior there in heaven;
To Him I will quickly go,
I will see its splendor in the sky,
I will see, I will see, I will see in the sky,
I will see, I will see, I will see in the sky.
Jesus will take me to heaven
And he will give me great joy.
I have a crown in heaven:
I have a crown in heaven;
The Savior had thorns,
But I will have splendor,
I will have, I will have, I will have in heaven;
I will have, I will have, I will have in heaven;
Jesus crown will give me,
That my forehead will gird.
We will meet there in heaven;
We will meet there in heaven;
United all to the Lord,
And always full of love;
I will walk, I will walk, I will walk to heaven,
I will walk, I will walk, I will walk to heaven,
I will have eternal peace there.
I will see the face of Jesus.

hymns.title: Oh! Blessed Love
stanzas: Oh! Blessed love, You possess me!
You fill infinity, oh! endless love!
I live today in Christ, I live in the Faithful;
By God, I am loved at Emanuel.
Peace and eternal glory, there is for me in heaven,
Everlasting life with our God.
Truly I feel life in the Lord,
And from heaven I sense joy and splendor!
Heart, enjoy this great love;
In peace or in fight, become the winner;
That this love is strong was seen there on the cross;
Stronger than death: The love of Jesus!
chorus: Oh! Blessed love: You possess me!
You fill infinity, oh! endless love!

hymns.title: In Search of Zion
stanzas: Leaving Egypt in search of Zion,
My Savior guided me with His strong hand;
He led me in victories by fire and sea;
Now, I sing to God, for unparalleled salvation.
Very close to Jesus and seeing the reward,
To Canaan I follow, there is my heart;
Jesus will take me to a great inheritance,
I must praise those who gave me hope.
I walked through the fields, where I found fruit;
In Hebron I also gathered live grapes,
Here better honey, wine and milk I found,
I will never return to slavery in Egypt.
I no longer feel the struggles of this life,
For I will always sing His grace, love and peace;
I'm marching to the eternal home,
And soon, in heaven - my homeland - I will be there.
chorus: Do not seek Me in slavery any longer,
I erected the tent, finally, in the land of Zion.
Do not seek Me in slavery any longer,
I erected the tent, finally, in the land of Zion.

hymns.title: Jesus Comes Triumphant
stanzas: How it shines from the east
The lightning in the west,
Jesus will return from this world from heaven;
Will take His Bride in joy
At His most blessed side,
To the eternal home of heavenly light.
Behold, the door is open
For the awakening soul,
Accepting Jesus, the Savior,
For His blood was shed
Vile sin has conquered,
Carrying our pain on the tree!
Jesus comes, comes triumphant,
With His flaming eyes,
For His face will shine like sunlight!
Very happy are those who cry out.
His coming, for they love Him,
And in heaven, the written names are on the list.
Jesus comes, like a rising sun,
This world illuminating,
The Church will rise to meet Him;
In His hand brings bright light,
Like a twinkling star,
And praise will be heard in the high heavens!
chorus: Soon, from heaven, Jesus will come to seek us;
With great power, Jesus will come.
And we must all be prepared to be,
With white robes, and shining like light.

hymns.title: To the Paternal Home
stanzas: I want to tell you the story of a man,
Which Jesus once reported.
Who had two sons in a happy mansion,
But the youngest left him.
The youngest said to his kind father:
"You want to give my inheritance";
And your farm, happily goes
In a distant country, enjoy.
The unwary young man squandered his wealth
With your comrades, in pleasure;
Behold, when the famine came, his father remembered
That I could always stop him.
The lost son, home at last, returned,
I am very sorry for what he did;
And the happy, loving father kissed him,
Well, your son saw it again!
chorus: Son disloyal to his paternal home,
Please come back today!
For the Father is waiting for you there;
Sinner, return to your home!

hymns.title: There's Still Room
stanzas: There is still room for you, oh sinner!
Listen to your Savior’s invitation.
Come in, come in, there’s still room for you.
Your life will soon end,
The shadows grow, where will you live?
Come in, come in, there’s still room for you.
There in heaven, Jesus prepared us
Festive wedding, and invited us,
Come in, come in, there’s still room for you.
The crowd that saves is already there,
Come, wait for her to join you.
Come in, come in, there’s still room for you.
Do you see the door opened by Jesus?
He calls you, come to His light;
Come in, come in, there’s still room for you.
The room fills up, comes without delay;
Whoever is careless loses his place;
Come in, come in, there’s still room for you.
There is joy, endless peace,
Glory awaits you; the fight will end.
Come in, come in, there’s still room for you.

hymns.title: Follow Christ
stanzas: Do you want to follow Christ,
And walk in His light?
For the world always seen,
For carrying your cross?
Do you want to take the step today,
To be a Christian?
Come, break the sad bond
Of sin and seduction.
The city on the mountain,
You can't hide,
And also, to such an extent
That gave life power.
Do you love Jesus Christ,
What for you did His life give?
Come, then, declare this -
You will have joy in heaven.
Oh, look closely at your intention,
It costs your life, yes!
Don't resist! With encouragement,
Come to Christ, the endless light.
Come, confess your sins
Next to the Savior's cross;
Ask for grace to follow Him,
With courage and love.
Consider the great joy
That waits in heaven, yes;
Here you fight, there I rest,
You will finally have a reward.

hymns.title: Only in Jesus
stanzas: Only in Jesus will you enjoy peace and joy,
You, sinner, who thirst for love;
Only in Jesus can you be happy;
In Him you receive grace from the Lord.
Only in Jesus will you find a strong shield
To shelter you from the darts of evil;
In Him, hidden from pain, from everything,
You will receive divine peace.
Only in Jesus, on the divine rock,
You will be saved from this world, like the sea;
Only in Jesus, yes in the light of this torch,
You can tread the holy path.
Only in Jesus, in this safe haven,
You can anchor your soul as a ship,
Only in Jesus, a bright future,
The sinner, you can find.
Only in Jesus, leave everything therefore,
Whether it be the world, evil or sin;
Come to Jesus, who by God I assure you,
What peace and joy you will enjoy.

hymns.title: The Holy Scriptures
stanzas: These are the holy Scriptures
What they tell us about Jesus,
Which coming from above
He made light shine in the darkness!
To give us eternal life,
Even death humbled itself;
Having already won the fight,
God the Father exalted Him.
Upon the cross was poured
His redeeming blood;
Duma lance pierced
It was the Lord's side;
His hands and feet preached
With some nails, on the cross;
They told me all this
Of the goodness of Jesus.
I want to keep listening
The story of the Lord;
Salvation I am enjoying
Of this tale of love!
I was freed from judgment,
Of condemnation, of pain.
From the Bible I am quite sure,
That Jesus is the Savior.
chorus: Will never be heard again
Another love tale,
That converts a lost one,
And rebellious sinner,
Like the holy Gospel,
That tells us about forgiveness,
And transforms the old man
In a new creation.

hymns.title: Raise Your Eyes
stanzas: Lift your eyes upward,
O redeemed ones of the Lord Jesus!
The fig tree shows that it is approaching
Summer: Sprouts are already producing!
Many say that Jesus is delaying,
To come and seek His people;
Which in the days of Noah, are sinning,
Without fearing the kind God.
Many, like Pharaoh, are saying:
“Who is the Lord to listen to you?”
And also the heart hardening:
But the plagues are coming.
I wish I could be taken away to heaven!
For the Church Christ will take.
The fig tree is in bloom, it's spring,
Raise your eyes now.
chorus: Get up, get up!
Your eyes to heaven where Jesus will come;
Get up, get up!
Redemption will soon take place.

hymns.title: Jesus, the Best Friend
stanzas: My Jesus is the best friend,
I put all my faith in Him;
My wounds want to heal,
And my soul console,
Oh, Jesus is the best friend!
My Jesus is the faithful friend,
And give me His strength and power;
Turn my pain into joy,
It inspires me, gives value;
Oh! Jesus is the best friend!
When the waves rage,
And my boat wants to sink,
He gives me calm and peace,
And good times always bring,
Yes Jesus is the best friend!
He gave His own life
To save the wicked sinner;
Oh! You never want to leave me,
Never forsake me!
Yes, Jesus is the best friend!
chorus: Jesus is the best friend,
Jesus is the best friend,
Always ready to help,
He wants to save everyone,
Yes, Jesus is the best friend!

hymns.title: The Light of Heaven Rayed
stanzas: In another time, I know how I walked,
From sin under the veil,
But it dawned from the sky and entered me
The light of the glorious sky.
And power gives me, which only comes from there,
Of Jesus, who saved me;
And I live here, praising God,
That my soul freed.
Rest has entered and the fighting has ended,
With Jesus, my Savior;
Your endless love revealed to me,
Fill me with peace and love.
I will live, then, in happy Zion,
With my Savior Jesus,
Forever there, I will enjoy pleasure
There in the glorious light.
chorus: In my heart the light dawned
From glory, for Jesus loved me;
And now I always live happily,
After the light from heaven dawned!

hymns.title: Oh! My Jesus
stanzas: O my Jesus, when you struggle on the path you find,
Your divine hand comes to help me;
I will not fear supported by Yourself, my Jesus,
O Savior, victory comes to me by Your light,
For You alone I wait, my Lord,
To move from value to value;
O my Jesus, I will see my strength increase more;
Having faith; Your grace will be enough for me.
O my Jesus, leaning on Your arm I will walk,
And meditate with love on the healthy Word;
Always like this in battle,
through Jesus I will overcome,
And by faith I will be sheltered from evil;
Already well armed, I will undo the darkness,
By the power of Jesus, my King!
My Jesus, who you give me,
in the heart, of Your love,
I will see You glorious, in the heaven of splendor!
O my Jesus, I will invoke Your name with great love,
All power was given to You, Savior;
Of every being, the knee before You will bow;
That you are the Lord, every tongue will testify,
Our feet, Salvador, please steady
On the rock, which cannot be shaken;
O my Jesus, I always want to seek Your grace,
I have to finally go into Your arms to rest.

hymns.title: Your Precious Name
stanzas: Jesus Christ, Your name
And so sweet to me -
Your incomparable sweetness
Fill me with endless love.
Your incomparable sweetness
Fill me with endless love.
You are the shining star,
That shines with brilliance,
And direct my steps,
In this world of horror.
And direct my steps,
In this world of horror.
Yours are the eternal arms,
Protecting the follower,
Don't get entangled
Tempting evil pious.
Don't get entangled
Tempting evil pious.
With my beloved Savior
I can happily proceed,
And with Him eternal joy
I will have it there in the future.
And with Him eternal joy
I will have it there in the future.
Oh! Your precious name
Continues to sound
For the world of sin,
For souls to awaken!
For the world of sin,
For souls to awaken!

hymns.title: The Bread of Life
stanzas: The bread of life, descended from heaven,
Gives peace, health and vigor;
The heavenly bread, sent by God,
It is Christ, the Savior;
The Redeemer comes without delay,
Heal the sinner's evil!
If anyone lost seeks Your light,
Peace will quickly come to you;
Don't delay any longer, loving Jesus,
Oh come comfort me!
There is holy joy for those who have the light,
In remembering your Lord,
And just talk about the love of Jesus,
The great Redeemer!
Your yoke is sweet, my Lord,
Your burden is light, what love!
If I can't carry my cross,
Quickly come and help me;
Don't delay any longer, loving Jesus,
Oh come comfort me!
Through harsh trials and persecutions,
You make the faithful pass by;
And whoever wins will have a reward,
Also in heaven place,
I will see Your splendor there,
Your glory. Savior;
If I can't carry my cross,
Quickly come and help me;
Don't delay any longer, loving Jesus,
Oh come comfort me!
Jesus, Your unfathomable love,
It makes me feel in my heart;
The love of God, this holy love,
And I will live, then;
To You, Jesus, I give praise;
You give me grace and vigor;
You are the bread that life produces;
My soul comes to feed;
Don't delay any longer, loving Jesus
Come comfort me!

hymns.title: Jesus is My Peace
stanzas: Jesus in his arms took me,
Jesus gave me peace;
Now I sing to those who loved me,
Jesus is my peace!
Hungry and thirsty I walked,
No rest here;
But living water I accepted;
I found rest here!
Omnipotent to love me,
It is Christ, the King of heaven;
Joyfully I will sing;
I found rest in God!

hymns.title: The Faith of the Saints
stanzas: By the faith that was once delivered to the saints,
Who comes to us through Jesus, and dries our tears,
Can believers, without having any astonishment,
Continue in the footsteps of the Lord.
Christians were judged by vile courts,
Into prisons, innocent people, forcibly thrown,
And of their earthly goods stripped,
But they followed the Lord joyfully.
Pilgrims the saints in the world walked,
In the caves of the earth they took refuge,
And gathered there, they celebrated
To Jesus, your beloved Savior.
It is by faith that we believers must always
Firm ourselves in Jesus and thus we will overcome,
And one day, in heaven we will find
The faithful, who loved the Lord.
chorus: In sadness, in struggles, in pain,
They turned to dear Jesus;
The Lord gave them victory,
By the blood shed on the cross.

hymns.title: O Dear Savior
stanzas: O dear Savior, fountain of love,
I feel you in me!
Your joy will come to me, I will never lack,
Which will take me to heaven at last.
O dear Savior, wealth of love,
Watch over me;
Hold me in Your hand, oh great Captain,
And I will then fight with you like this.
O dear Savior, my true intercessor.
Pray for me;
I can then speak, oh! of this unparalleled love,
Who came to save me from the world, yes!
O dear Savior, with Your power,
Lord, work in me;
On the path of value, full of vigor,
Without having any fear, I will go like this!

hymns.title: To Heaven I go
stanzas: To heaven I go, even though it's cloudy;
The path is sometimes thorny,
