By Jesus, my Master, always well guided,
In His steps I follow, until I get there.
To heaven I go, even though I struggle
Against temptations, which arise before me:
Under the blood of Jesus sheltering me,
Hidden and very safe, I am like this.
To heaven I go, though, very tired,
And old friends, turn back.
I remain strong with the Lord Jesus at my side,
Inviting others to accept peace.
To heaven I go, happily walking:
The pilgrimage will soon end,
If tired, in this world I walk,
I will rest in the divine! mansion.
chorus: Hallelujah! I'm walking to the sky,
Nothing will discourage me!
I'm getting closer to the sky,
Always my Jesus will guide me!

hymns.title: Heaven, My Home
stanzas: It's my home, the sky, the sky of light:
Free from the flesh, the veil, I will see Jesus;
Oh! How happy I will be in the fate of the Lord,
Praising my King, the Savior!
It is my home, the sky, the sky of light;
For me, as a defendant, my Jesus suffered:
Oh! How happy I will be in the kingdom of love,
For I will always enjoy my Lord!
It is my home, the sky, the sky of light;
And with my trophies I go to Jesus:
Oh! How happy I will be when, with great fervor,
At the feet of the King, giving praise!

hymns.title: The End Comes, Be Careful!
stanzas: The end of all things comes soon, be careful!
Do not want to refuse the grace of the Savior today:
Look quickly, stay sheltered,
In the blood of the Lamb, in the redeeming blood.
The foundation of the Christian is the chosen rock,
By bait you can resist the winds of temptation.
Christ accepts everyone who is sincere,
The blood of the Lamb guarantees salvation.
Therefore whoever hears will live with Christ in glory,
Whoever does not listen will die, will suffer torment,
For whoever desires victory over evil,
In the blood of the Lamb you will find power.
chorus: What precious blood came from my Jesus!
What glorious blood was shed on the cross!

hymns.title: The Day Is Very Close
stanzas: Close, yes, very close it is,
The day will not be late;
We will reside
With Jesus, who is to come.
Oh! How much glory there will be,
If Christ comes down today,
For those who believe in Jesus,
They will enjoy eternal light!
What immense, unparalleled glory,
We will have fun
Beside, yes, the Lord,
Our beloved Savior!
We must therefore wait,
And the world's eyes close;
Let us always walk in the light,
Looking for King Jesus.

hymns.title: Elijah's Prayer
stanzas: Elijah in Carmel prayed
With insistence to God;
Bowed to the dust, with faith he cried out
For rain from the heavens.
Go, my servant, from the mountain look
If dark clouds come;
Well, now God can send
The rain for us too.
A cloud appears like a hand,
On the horizon beyond,
In the distance, thunder is heard:
Yes, a lot of rain is coming.
Oh cold believer, go get it
To God in prayer,
And consecrate your life,
To receive the anointing.
chorus: Rain, send Lord,
The rain of the Holy Comforter;
Send heavy rain, Salvador:
In your church bring down
The rain of power.

hymns.title: The Good Jesus
stanzas: O good Jesus, treasure of power,
I want to feel You. always in my being!
Make me walk, oh, always in this light,
For within me you live, oh my good Jesus!
Good Jesus, O source of love,
Make me hear Your voice, Lord;
I always want to live in Delhi,
O manifest Thy power more in me!
The good Jesus, real Comforter,
Far from You is the sinner!
You live in me, you are my salvation;
Only what has you in your heart is happy!
chorus: Oh! In me, Jesus has finally risen;
I am free from darkness, by His light!

hymns.title: I want Jesus, Your Light
stanzas: I always want, Jesus, to receive Your light,
Put on the Comforter;
And one day in the heavens, next to the throne of God,
I will enjoy abundant love!
Under the blood I will be sheltered from the law,
From sin and vile temptation;
In this blood there is peace, a joy that satisfies
And I'm sure forgiveness will come!
Oh! What consolation will I have in Zion,
Seeing the face of the gentle Jesus;
An eternal praise I will give to the Lord,
Upon entering the city of light!
chorus: O Jesus, guard my heart,
In Him make Your eternal dwelling,
I always want to praise Your name!
Because you wanted to rescue my soul!

hymns.title: Resurrected Jesus
stanzas: Oh! resurrected Jesus,
Great is Your power!
Be with me, O my beloved,
Give me grace and knowledge.
My Lord, You are my guide,
Give me strength, life and light;
Full peace and joy,
Grant me, O my Jesus!
The light is so radiant,
That brings me consolation;
With Your painful death,
You gave me salvation.
I want, O God, to thank You
Your great, immense love,
Because you already granted me
The real Comforter.
chorus: To do Your will,
I want more power from You;
Give me Your holiness,
I just want you to live.

hymns.title: A Strong People
stanzas: Behold, a strong people arises,
Clothed with power;
And he doesn't even fear death,
Whoever belongs to it;
And you will have sublime luck,
For with Christ he goes to heaven,
You can say it too.
“Am I one of them”?
In the Cenác’lo gathered,
The power they sought then,
For the love of God united
Crying out in prayer;
Behold, a wind is descended
And fire from heaven falls;
You can also say:
“Am I one of them”?
These fearless people,
(They are Jesus' disciples)
By the persecuted world,
For carrying your cross.
And now coated
With power the world leaves;
You can also say:
“Am I one of them”?
Oh don't be careless
To seek the gift of God,
Gift that will make you happy,
It will give you visions of heaven.
And wonderful Jesus
Proclaiming to others you will,
You can then say:
“I’m one of those.”
chorus: One of those. One of those.
Can you also say: “I am one of them”?
One of those, one of those.
Can you also say: “I am one of them”?

hymns.title: The Aspiration of the Soul
stanzas: My soul aspires to dwell
In the courts of the Lord,
And forever hear the sound
The voice of my Redeemer.
Rest will not be found
In the sinner's home;
Only in Jesus will you find yourself
Justice, peace and love.
O come, believers, let us go now
The house of the Lord,
For He will teach us
Serve Him with great fervor!

hymns.title: The Heart Strings
stanzas: The strings vibrate from my heart,
Tuned for the Master to praise:
Sin does not grant this sound:
Only Golgotha can tune them.
We were also in tune in the world,
But the sound was not pleasant;
But at Golgotha ​​already transformed.
We have new harmony and tone.
It is Jesus who tunes souls,
He takes very good care of the instrument,
Every day the sound becomes more refined,
You can even play the chords from beyond.
If you try this tuning you want it.
Today approach the cross with love;
Harmony you will have if you are
In Jesus, your tuner!
chorus: Hallelujah! Glory to God,
That on Golgotha my soul tuned!
Hallelujah! Glory to God,
That on Calvary my soul tuned!

hymns.title: Open the Heart
stanzas: O sinner who has no light.
Open your heart;
Accept the good Jesus today;
Open your heart!
You who long to be saved.
Open your heart;
The peace of God comes to obtain,
Open your heart!
What a sweet voice you hear now!
Open your heart;
Jesus your soul will save,
Open your heart!
Yes, today come in Christ to believe
Open your heart;
What will there be tomorrow?
Open your heart!
Listening to the voice of the good Jesus,
Open your heart;
Oh come quickly, come to the light,
Open your heart!
chorus: Who do I feel beating in my heart?
Jesus says: “Open your heart without delay”.

hymns.title: A Friend Among the Lilies
stanzas: Among the lilies, in the middle of the valleys
'There is a friend, who is dear to me;
I want to follow Him, free from evils,
See Him in heaven, with the angels at last.
Today I seek You, come, reveal me
The divine light, where are you, my Jesus,
With Your flock, come and take me
To the river that life produces.
Hear me now, dearly beloved Jesus,
Let me enjoy Your great love;
No longer hide Your beloved face from me,
Because you called me to free me.
The voice of Christ is most precious to me
May the voice of angels; and from the sun the light,
It doesn't have the shine of a radiant face
When my beloved Jesus smiles.
chorus: My Savior Jesus, O Son of the good God;
Thanks for Your light, which came from Heaven!
For me you tried the Cross,
You died for me, Jesus!

hymns.title: Oh! I have fun
stanzas: Oh! I have joy in my heart,
Also life, and holy fervor;
For Christ gave me real salvation
And the certainty of a kingdom of love!
In the world you will never know
The holy joy of my Savior,
Who already enjoys, yes, everyone who believes,
And always live full of love.
Let us praise the King of Israel together,
By His grace, which gives us strength,
For He hides the faithful believer,
In His wings of peace and love.
The Eternal Father has sealed His people,
With the promise of the Comforter;
Oh! It was free of charge that God saved me
For His immense and holy love!

hymns.title: Heaven is Mine
stanzas: What joy now, heaven is mine,
For Jesus tore the sacred veil;
I will no longer fear condemnation,
And my Redeemer I will always praise.
I walked alone through the world,
Outside Sodom I saw the sky,
For I looked up, at my Jesus,
Who died for me on the bloody cross.
I am a soldier to fight.
And with God I will overcome all evil;
The flag is the blood of Jesus,
Which was poured out for me there on the cross.
When one day I perish,
Yes, my heart stops beating,
I will ascend to heaven, without any fear,
Resting in the arms of the Lord.
Before the joyful throne I will stand,
And with God I will overcome all evil;
I'll see the crowd's applause
May hallelujahs to God, they will always sing.
chorus: There in heaven I will rest
With Jesus, our King;
Come to God, O sinner,
For in heaven awaits you with love.

hymns.title: Come to Christ
stanzas: Come to Christ, come now,
Come just as you are;
From God, without delay,
You will obtain forgiveness.
Believe and establish your confidence
In His death for you;
For joy reaches,
Everyone who does this.
Come to Christ, not fearing
Think about His love;
Come soon, but believing,
For the Lord calls you.
He longs to redeem you,
He wants to free you from evil;
The doors open for you,
Of divine pleasure.

hymns.title: Far from Jesus
stanzas: He wandered far from Jesus, in complete solitude,
Until the precious light filled my heart,
So I saw my sins like black darkness;
At the foot of the cross, then, I fell, and received forgiveness.
Jesus died in great pain in order to save me,
He shed His atoning blood, which was able to wash me:
Without murmuring, Jesus suffered for me, a vile sinner;
That's why I came to the foot of the cross, overcome by love.
Listen to the voice of the Savior who calls you to the light;
Confess yourself a sinner, and come to the good Jesus,
That will give you real power, the joy and peace of God;
And when everything disappears, you will live in heaven.
chorus: Christ for me suffering, there on the cross dying,
My soul saved and my shackles have already broken
Hallelujah!
Christ for me suffering, there on the cross dying
It gave me peace, forgiveness, in my heart.

hymns.title: The Gifts of Heaven
stanzas: The promised gifts of heaven,
Father we wait here;
In holy love gathered together,
We beg You.
Send us constant rain,
Rains of the Comforter;
Rains, yes, but abundant,
Showers of life and love!
We wait for Your power,
O glorious Lord!
From the high heavens we wait
Rains from the Comforter!
Father blesses the believers
Who are always searching
Your face, fearful;
Rains, you want to send them.
chorus: Send, O Lord, rain from the heavens;
Rains of the Comforter,
Send from heaven, oh good God!
Send, O Lord, rain from the heavens,
That always give us vigor;
Send us there, oh good God!

hymns.title: The History of the Cross
stanzas: You have read the story of the hard cross,
In which Jesus died,
Dispelling the darkness, light dawned,
Flowing His blood?
Have you read that Christ did not complain,
In the wood, in great pain,
But he still begged the Father for forgiveness
For sinful people?
Have you read that Christ finally saved
On the cross, an evildoer?
Who, suffering on the cross, begged Him:
“Do you remember me, Lord”?
Have you read that Christ exclaimed on the cross:
“Behold, it is finished.”
It was for me, it was for you, that Jesus died,
Accept Christ now.
chorus: Jesus suffered on the cross for you;
Jesus suffered on the cross!
Oh! Great love of the Savior
Dying on the cross for me!

hymns.title: The Happiness of Salvation
stanzas: Happy are those who have the joyful sound
Of the real salvation of our God.
For they have heard in a sweet tone,
The crowd that sings in heaven.
The world's springs finally dry up,
Leaving here only dryness,
However, divine sources are not like that,
For living waters will always flow.
Paul and Silas, behold, they are in prison,
In the trunk they have safe hands and feet,
But without caring, even in prison,
Sing hymns to the Lord, with faith!
Here is Estêvão in great exultation,
Although he succumbed to stones,
Because of the full Spirit he had the vision:
The Savior at the right hand of God, see!
Many centuries have already passed,
After Stephen by faith died,
But salvation like Jesus still gives,
To all believers and faithful in God.
Like a lovebird already in a divine song,
What a praise: “Hallelujah” in our being;
If you ask: “Where will I get the same?”
“On Golgotha” we will answer.
chorus: Now the children of God are very happy,
But in heaven they will have better pleasure,
The Christian's enjoyments are just drops
From the sea of blessings, in Zion!

hymns.title: Jesus, Our Hope
stanzas: O Jesus, our hope,
Holy vine - we are the branches;
With fervor and confidence,
True grace we pray to You,
O Savior.
Our contrite hearts
To You we present.
Come wash them, Jesus Christ.
With Your blood we plead,
O Savior.
To those You have rescued,
More and more purifies them.
Since you have them for the light called
Your souls sanctify,
O Savior.

hymns.title: Come, O Prodigal
stanzas: O you who still wander in the world of horror,
In darkness and darkness,
Why don't you rest in Christ the Lord?
Who brought salvation from heaven.
The world lay in a harsh prison,
But Christ, the door opened;
O believe in the message that gives salvation,
For Christ on the cross redeemed you!
What complete joy you will have in Jesus,
If you accept His forgiveness;
O leave sin and come to the light;
Give your heart away.
chorus: O come, O prodigal, O come to Jesus;
Parti was raised high on the cross;
Now accept God's favor;
The Lord comes without delay to Christ.

hymns.title: Care of the Soul
stanzas: I have to save
My immortal soul,
And prepare her to enter,
In the heavenly kingdom.
For this I do,
My God, come help me;
At Your service, yes, my being,
I want to consecrate you.
I want to be your son,
With all my heart
And forever get
Your eternal protection.
Help me to watch,
In faith I stand well,
For in You I can trust,
And rest too!

hymns.title: Talk about the Love of Christ
stanzas: Talk about the love of Christ
To the sad sinner,
Love for all seen
On the Redeemer's cross;
He sings with joy
The peace that comes from heaven;
Your voice raises
In glory to God.
For the afflicted, sing,
The blessings that are in God;
From the cross the banner rises
For it gives us courage.
Sing for the lost
The grace of Jesus;
Your blood has already spilled,
That flows from the cross!
Sing with hope,
In the darkness too,
Sing with confidence,
There is life in the afterlife;
Sing at the dawn of the day,
And when the night comes;
In Christ, harmony
With God it is obtained!
chorus: Christ on the cross won us
Eternal salvation.
With His blood he washed us
The King of redemption!
In the temple, the veil was torn;
Path opened Jesus
On the cross, inaugurated
For the sky of light!

hymns.title: Sunday Prayer
stanzas: O our Father who art in heaven,
Of the universe the benefactor;
Hallowed be Your name,
The glorious God of love!
Your kingdom, come with power,
According to your announcement;
And your will always be done,
On earth, as in heaven.
And every day our bread,
Give us Lord, and without fail;
And our thirsty souls are,
Come forever to satisfy.
Come forgive our faults, come,
Eternal glorious Father!;
For we are forgiven, too,
Those who did us harm.
You want to free us from temptation,
And keep us away from evil well,
For the sky, the earth and the sea belong to You.
The kingdom forever, amen!

hymns.title: The End of Fights
stanzas: When this life of struggles ceases,
I'm going to heaven to enjoy my rest
With my Jesus, there in endless glory;
Oh! What a blessing it will be for me!
I think of peace and great love,
From my Savior's heavenly home;
To see His face, to smile too,
In the great glory of the day to come.
Parents and friends, brothers, will be
In the holy river, singing with joy,
Always joyful, praising the Lord,
Enjoying blessings from your Creator.
chorus: Oh! What a pleasure! Glory to Jesus!
I will see in the sky of light;
Never die, Jesus always see,
Oh! It will be eternal joy for me!

hymns.title: Lord, Send Your Power
stanzas: The faithful prayed together
In a cenacle to the Lord,
When it came down from heaven
The real Comforter!
Like a vehement wind,
The power filled the house;
Tongues came upon the believers,
But fire, from heaven!
In other languages, yes, they spoke.
As Christ granted;
From the Spirit they overflowed,
Exalting the King of heaven!
Power was promised
For the Lord's servants:
And for all granted,
If they ask for it fervently!
chorus: Lord, send your power now.
Lord, send your power now.
Lord, send your power now,
And baptize each one!

hymns.title: Come to Me, Sinner
stanzas: Behold, I cry, I Jesus, the mighty,
Come to Me, sinner;
I want to give you My peace, forgiveness and joy.
Come to Me, sufferer.
From sins today I can free you,
Come to Me, sinner;
For on the cross, I, suffering, wanted to free you,
Come to Me, sufferer.
Today I want to make you happy, blissful,
Come to Me, sinner;
With my blood I opened a glorious trail,
Come to Me, sufferer.
Do not proudly despise My invitation
Come to Me, sinner;
Because your heart is weak, it cannot resist,
Come to Me, sufferer.
chorus: I love you, oh lost sinner,
I died to be your Savior,
For your crimes and sins I was wounded;
Come to Me, sufferer.

hymns.title: The Precious Source
stanzas: Come to the healing source,
That opened the Savior,
Whose seductive waters
They have a divine flavor.
In this source, which heals us,
I found real forgiveness;
My garment became clear,
I have purification.
In this source, which heals us,
Christ gave me salvation;
Healthy has made my soul pure,
And it gave him consolation.
Come to the source that heals you;
Today comes to purify
Your soul. how unclean,
You can't enter heaven there.
chorus: Oh! Precious healing source
For everyone run, yes!
Oh! Precious healing source!
Glory to God, heal me!

hymns.title: The Pilgrim of Glory
stanzas: Pilgrim goes to glory,
For you will soon enter heaven!
Do you hear the victory songs yet?
Your voice will also unite there.
A sound of joy comes from heaven,
In the dark night I call you,
Very smooth and full of harmony.
- O my soul. return to your home!
Last rays of the sun hide,
At the golden gate of Zion;
When the fight is over, where will I be?
The misses will never come again.
From Jesus, the blood, gives entry;
Glory to God, the door is open!
Do you want a happy home in heaven?
It will be very sad not to go there.
chorus: Yes, you want to sing
The song of the saved, there in glory,
What will always sound in the heavens?
Yes, you want to sing,
The glorious hymns of victory?
To sing a thousand praises to Jesus?

hymns.title: The Spirit Says: Come!
stanzas: The Spirit and the Bride say:
“Come and drink the water of life”;
What a voice of love from the Savior,
To a lost soul!
And he who listens says: Come!
And speak of the peace obtained,
Well, he received it and already drank it
From the water that gave him life.
O thirsty sinner, come!
The source of pure waters!
Come and satisfy yourself, come without delay,
O unfortunate creature!
If you want, today: Come!
To Christ, thirsty soul;
You will drink, you will be satisfied
From the wonderful water!
chorus: The Spirit says: Come! The Bride says: Come!
And take the free water that gives life.
The Spirit says: Come! The Bride says: Come!
And take the water of life for free.

hymns.title: Consecration
stanzas: Love and life I give to You.
Jesus, there on the cross, for me,
Crimson blood spilled;
My God and Savior!
You saved me, this I know;
I will put my faith in You;
Happy, now I will live!
With you, my Jesus!
You who died on the cross,
Grant me, Lord Jesus,
May I always walk in Your light,
In sanctification.
chorus: Love and life I give to You,
That you went to the cross to suffer for me,
Love and life I give to You,
Jesus, my Savior!

hymns.title: Oh, what Peace!
stanzas: Oh! What peace I feel in the Lord Jesus
Eternal peace, which makes me walk in the light,
And it is in me in trial and in pain;
My peace is the Lord!
Oh! What peace I have in my heart,
Eternal peace, which gives me consolation!
And the peace that every believer enjoys;
From Jesus: Emmanuel!
Oh! What heavenly peace the Lord gives me!
Eternal peace, which fills me with love;
This is Christ, the victory of Israel.
Whoever is faithful possesses!
Oh! Beloved, let us walk with Jesus!
Just thinking about Him and His cross;
He is the peace that gladdens the heart
For give us His forgiveness!
chorus: Oh! What peace I receive through the cross
Eternal peace in the Lord.
If you always live in Jesus
And win for His love!
Oh! What peace what light has the sinner
When comes to YOU, Jesus!

hymns.title: Trust in Jesus
stanzas: I am weak, poor, blind,
Nothing can avail me;
At Your feet, I eagerly go,
For grace obtain.
For a long time the evil in me,
There is reign, without ceasing;
I, Lord, come to You,
Longing to rest.
Take my little soul,
He makes his home in it;
Never let me hold back,
The wiles of temptation.
Christ comes to the heart
For evils to dispel:
Give me your forgiveness today,
Come and console my soul.
chorus: Only in You will I trust
Oh! Jesus, my Savior,
In Your arms rest
And enjoy Your love!

hymns.title: The Birth of Jesus
stanzas: In Bethlehem Jesus was born,
Our great Redeemer,
Being the blessed light
For a sinful world.
With shepherds, to Bethlehem
Let's praise Jesus,
Our gratitude, too,
Give to those who wanted to save us.
In humble worship
To Jesus, yes, to offer
Our grateful heart,
Who felt unparalleled love.
From heaven Jesus came down,
He became man, being God;
Our pains suffered,
To take us to the heavens.
Let us give glory, glory to God,
For the gift of His love!
We will praise, yes, in the heavens,
To Jesus, with more fervor.
Angels sing, glory to God!
To men, holy peace!
His children sing glory:
Hail the King, what joy it brings.
chorus: Oh! Hallelujah to Christ Jesus,
The Sent, Son of God!
Joy and light that life produces,
Christ brought it from heaven!

hymns.title: Consoling Spirit
stanzas: Consoling Spirit, divine and eternal!,
Precious source of love and immortal life.
With symbols that the dying Savior left us,
We will celebrate His love, which He demonstrated on the cross.
You, bread of life Redeemer! In our heart
Infuse grace, fervor, and heavenly anointing.
Light up an effective fire of faith and value in us;
Grant us forgiveness and peace, humiliation and love.
Amen.

hymns.title: Jesus, Everything for Me
stanzas: I was in sin, lost, sad alone,
What a difference now, Jesus has to do with me.
Today I only trust in the grace you gave me;
I know His love and walk to heaven.
I am dead to the world, but I live for Jesus;
Only He is the right pilot; lead me;
The Bible teaches me that he suffered on the cross;
He bought me with His blood and His peace gave me.
I'm getting very close to the glorious home;
He has prepared a dwelling for me, where I will dwell,
Jesus sanctifies me, helps me fight
Against vile injustice and even deny myself.
chorus: Jesus, everything is for me, you freed me from guilt;
Love and eternal peace,
on the cross he won for me;
Yes, everything is for me,
showed His immense love,
Glory to the holy name. of the beloved Savior!

hymns.title: Under the Wings of God
stanzas: Under the wings of God, rested.
Even though it's night, I'm trusting;
Under His wings I find myself sheltered.
I have been redeemed, of Christ I am.
Under Your wings I have refuge,
My heart can then rest;
And if afflicted, to Christ I come,
Perfect joy I will find in Him.
Under His wings, precious promise!
Christ delivers me, he can keep me;
Well protected, on glorious wings.
Peace and joy I can find.
chorus: I will rest, I will rest,
Under His precious wings!
I will rest, and I will not fear.
Under such mighty wings!

hymns.title: Thankful to You
stanzas: O my Lord, give me more gratitude,
For everything you did for me
By Your grace in my heart,
That filled me with endless happiness!
You gave my heart for free
Holiness, peace and faith;
Heavenly joy and consolation,
And freedom to be at Your feet.
My Lord, You did for me,
What no one could do;
Nailed to the cross, you saw, like this,
Blood, in which I can always win!
chorus: More grateful to You, more grateful to You.
More consecrated, oh make me, Lord!
More humbled and full of love
Make me more grateful to you, more grateful to You!

hymns.title: The Day Comes Soon
stanzas: The big day is coming soon
What fights will end in;
All evils, agonies,
They will cease from this world.
Oh! What a joy, to be with Christ,
Listening to His voice!
I long for this today,
And always follow Him afterwards!
If Jesus Christ is my guide,
I will follow the Path;
Whoever trusts in God,
It will arrive in Heaven.
chorus: The crying will cease in heaven,
For there will be no more pain,
And the singing will be heard,
Of the redeemed of the Lord!

hymns.title: Will win
stanzas: Whoever possesses Christ is firm in Him,
You will find power to fight evil;
Because His promises He will fulfill.
Whoever is in Christ will always win.
In any battle, he will not faint;
The power of darkness will triumph;
God will give you strength, he will never fail;
Because Jehovah fights in his place.
Among enemies, he will be very bold,
Whoever is united to Christ will never waver.
In Jesus established, light will shine;
The light of the Gospel to set them free.
chorus: He will overcome, He will overcome, by His blood He will overcome;
Will win, will win, will always win;
For Jesus who reigns, gives new strength;
And whoever waits on Him will always win.

hymns.title: Come to Your Savior
stanzas: Sinner, you follow the wandering world
Without finding consolation;
Today, come to Christ, come confident.
And you will have salvation!
Sinner, if you feel in your soul,
From sin to slavery;
To Jesus, if you come, with faith and calm,
You will receive forgiveness from God.
Afflicted and so sick sinner.
Come to Christ to heal you.
Come to Him humbly today.
Because your soul wants to save!
chorus: O come to your Savior,
Who was killed on the cross,
For there, he saved the vile sinner;
O come to the Lord Jesus!

hymns.title: Abundant Life
stanzas: We want to have abundant life.
Of purity and holiness,
To truly love God,
By the grace He gave us.
We want to have abundant life
Of love, which the Father has given us
In Jesus, His beloved Son,
Whose life he poured out for us.
We want to have abundant life
Of Jesus, the true fortress,
That gives us certainty of forgiveness.
And fill us with consolation.
chorus: Come give us Your abundant life,
Our beloved and divine Lord;
Your life of exultant joy,
Abundant in Consolador.

hymns.title: The Universal Church
stanzas: On the firm, triumphant rock.
There is the universal Church;
Founded by You, Jesus,
When you expire there on the cross.
The immense grace of the good God,
Place gave me, as His son,
With complete peace in your heart,
True love, and salvation.
Behold, I am now a living stone;
He placed me in His temple;
Of His body, I am a member,
His blood consecrated me.
On the rock, it will not shake,
Your Church will win;
When this world ends,
With you, she will reign.
chorus: With Your power, fill my being;
O God of love, give me fervor;
I am redeemed, I am your son,
With Your power, come and fill me.

hymns.title: Let's All Work
stanzas: Let us all work for the Lord Jesus,
Our guide He is, to the field leads us,
We must be ready, because Jesus will not be late.
We will ascend to heaven, where we will dwell.
Gathered in love, with Jesus the Savior,
Let us always remember the words of the Lord:
“I will not leave you orphans, but I will pray to the Father,
Give you the Comforter, whom I will send from heaven.”
He ordered his disciples, shortly after resurrecting:
The Gospel of love, go to everyone, yes, preach,
He who believes will be saved, and he will receive signs,
By the Spirit of God, new tongues will speak.”
This seal of love was sent by Jesus,
The whole scene was filled with the power of heaven, with light,
Compelled, the Jews believed in the divine King;
They accepted Jesus through the power of the sign.

hymns.title: The Promises That Don't Fail
stanzas: From God you make promises,
Today they will be fulfilled.
As long as you always ask God,
I believe with my heart.
Abraham counting the stars
In the vastness of the heavens,
Seeing them shiny, so beautiful!
He believed in God even more!
If you have bitterness in you,
Firm yourself, yes, in God,
Soon, the dark night
It will end for His own.
If you are persecuted,
Only God will deliver you;
The Son of God, the Anointed One,
For you he will fight.
If yours become enemies,
They want to abandon you,
Christ, the best of friends
He wants to be by your side.
Believe, because faith relieves
Your suffering and pain
Whoever trusts in promises,
In heaven he will give praise!
chorus: Earth and skies burning,
The mountains are shaking,
But, in the promises believing,
God will always fulfill them!

hymns.title: The Master's Footsteps
stanzas: I want to follow in the Master's footsteps.
I want to go after my King and Lord,
So that in His power He may train me,
I go praying to my Redeemer.
I walk closer to One who guides me,
When the evil one comes to deceive me;
That supports me in the great struggle.
Therefore, I must exalt His name!
I follow His footsteps with tender affection,
Mercy, love and gentleness;
Which bird goes in search of its nest,
I head to holy Zion.
I want to follow in the footsteps of Christ,
Always above I want to climb.
To Zion, which by faith I see.
Where I will rest forever.
chorus: How sweet it is to follow in the Master's footsteps
In the blessed light, close to Jesus!
How sweet it is to follow in the Master's footsteps,
And carry the Cross!

hymns.title: Saved for Free
stanzas: What a joy, Jesus saved me.
By His grace, for He took
My sins, nailing them to the cross,
Making the light shine on me.
I have always wandered around the world,
Far from God, from the precepts of the law,
That promises me unparalleled enjoyment,
Also give me freedom here.
Crying and crying cannot be worth it,
Neither your efforts nor great knowledge,
For a lost person thirsting for light,
If he doesn't believe in the Lord Jesus.
I have rest from heaven, I enjoy it at last,
For Jesus Christ saved me;
When I enter Your kingdom of light.
I will better praise the Lord Jesus.
chorus: Saved for free by my Jesus!
Saved for free, I already have the light!
We gave Him glory for great victory,
That the Lord Jesus won for me.

hymns.title: Abraham and His Sacrifice
stanzas: Underneath some very beautiful date palms,
Now Beersheba was in darkness.
The birds listening, among the rose bushes,
The patriarch Abraham is seen walking.
Your heart before God is afflicted,
For He wants us to serve Him without murmuring;
And out of love he asks the blessed Lord:
"Does my beloved son want You then?"
The powerful voice of Jehovah is heard:
“Your Isaac offers to Me,
Even though your soul hurts,
For I bless you if you do this.”
From downcast Abraham becomes strong
And sing hymns, because with faith he already meditates:
“God can free my son from death!”
And not being afraid, he goes to Moriah.
At the foot of the mountain of supreme sacrifice,
Deep doubt entered Abraham:
“Will I lose the benefit of my life?”
And sadly it began to rise slowly,
Well, I was going to give hope from my heart
- In its autumn, sacrifice of a flower,&
So he led his lamb to the slaughter,
In obedience to the Lord's command.
Isaac with the firewood, quickly go ahead,
Oh! How beautiful is for Abraham!
But behold, he returns to his father softly
And he asks you this question:
“I see the fire and the wood that we brought,
But where is the lamb of sacrifice?”
And Abraham’s response in the Bible we have:
“My son, God for Himself, the Lamb will provide”
When Abraham arrived where God had sent,
He made an altar and arranged the wood on it:
And to his son, whom he had already tied up,
Taking him in his arms on the altar he lay down,
But when Abraham went to sacrifice him,
The Angel of the Lord cried out to him from heaven:
“Do not extend your hand to kill him;
For now I know that you fear God.”
Abraham raising his eyes suddenly,
See a lamb, stuck in the bush,
And taking it, he offers it joyfully;
Thus “It will be provided on the mountain of the Lord”.
The Angel's voice is heard again;
“Says the Lord: Because you have done this deed,
Indeed, I will bless your seed,
And in her, the blessed nations will be made.”
Our Isaac we offer firmly
In Moriá where the ideal ends,
For it was there that they gained strength,
The victors, under angelic song;
There our God swore allegiance,
Also the saints were filled with valor,
And we will only have perfect holiness,
After we go to the mountain of the Lord.

hymns.title: The Lamb of God
stanzas: I see a man on the cross hanging
Shedding blood, for my sin,
It is the Lamb of God slain,
Who suffers great pain for me;
How much he suffers on the cross, on the altar,
Christ Jesus, my good Savior,
To make me a treasure to inherit.
In the holy kingdom of the Lord!
In prayer, when the dawn breaks,
I feel remorse deep in my soul,
Because Christ suffered calmly on the cross,
All punishment, for me sinner;
The supreme Father wanted to determine
Such a cruel death to my Savior;
To grant me a place in heaven
Next to Christ the Redeemer.
Oh! How much pain did the Eternal feel,
When he gave us the gentle and tender Christ!
For my soul to save from hell,
My good Savior died for me,
My sins on the cross atoned
And horrible death suffered with love.
But upon Himself my guilt took,
My beloved Redeemer.
Jesus Christ does. that I love you more
And more and more Thy grace proclaim;
Free me from all strong bonds,
That the vile tempter always weaves;
Upon the altar, for me Christ ascended,
Offering a holocaust of love:
Like a lamb, he succumbed on the cross
Christ Jesus, my Savior.

hymns.title: Looking At Calvary
stanzas: On the cross of Calvary looking,
I saw the Savior;
My sin atoning,
His love was revealed.
I saw Jesus crucified
Suffering such great pain,
It was His blood shed
For the poor sinner.
O immaculate Lamb,
That you died on the cross!
Deliver me from vile sin,
O my Savior Jesus!
chorus: There at the source of this light,
that brought me a light,
That's where I found shelter,
life, peace and salvation.

hymns.title: Sustenance of the Soul
stanzas: Give sustenance to my life,
The Word of the Lord;
My dejected soul,
Come comforting power:
Glorious deliverance
We find in Jesus,
In Him the happy heart
Already enjoy His light.
Saints, let us all proclaim
That Jesus will return,
And what should we serve Him?
And sincerely love Him.
He rose from the grave,
And he showed himself alive
The happy creatures,
Who loved so much in the world.
Let there be no idlers
In the Church of the Lord,
But yes, fervent believers
Working vigorously;
Whoever won here
For Jesus and His love,
You must have a royal dress,
For the wedding of splendor!
We will enter beautiful
Room, full of radiance,
Prepared for the Wife
Of Jesus, the Savior;
When we get there
There will be a great party;
And Jesus, who has given us
Salvation will serve us
chorus: Jesus Christ gave me salvation,
Also eternal life;
It gave me joy in my heart,
And heavenly power;
Your grace is enough,
Divine! it is His love;
I have an exultant life,
By the good Comforter!

hymns.title: I feel the Life of the Lord
stanzas: I feel like I live in the Lord,
Who came to save me;
And His law, for His love,
I always want to keep it.
I feel like I live in the Lord,
Now free,
Jesus covers me with favor,
Rest always gives me.
I feel like I live in the Lord,
In the eternal rock,
That sustains me with vigor,
In the storms of evil.
I feel like I live in the Lord.
And I will always live;
By His comforting power,
In God I will remain.
chorus: I will always dwell in Jesus,
I will establish Him in my heart;
God, through faith, produces in me
Perfection!

hymns.title: Let us love the Lord
stanzas: Brothers, let us love the Lord,
For His divine love;
For our guilt has atoned,
With blood that spilled.
Brothers, let us love the Lord,
Our teacher;
He is the source of knowledge
For everyone who believes in Him.
Brothers, let us love the Lord,
Our good Savior;
And the perfecter of that faith,
Who comes down from God, who “Is”.
Brothers, let us love the Lord,
Also the Comforter,
And to our Heavenly Father,
What peace eternal gives us.
chorus: Brothers, let us love the Lord,
For He has already loved us;
And from deceiving sin,
With His blood He washed us.

hymns.title: Battles Won
stanzas: Oh, do not be afraid, Wife of Jesus,
In righteousness God will build you!
Your tent shines with living light,
It will increase more.
Every weapon manufactured with spite.
He fights you, but he will never defeat you,
The enemy that attacks with fury,
The Lord will slaughter.
There in heaven you will have no memories
Of the battles you suffered for love;
But there you will have a sublime position
With Jesus, your Savior.
Patriarchs and prophets are already
There in heaven waiting for you with love:
Be faithful and keep the divine! anointing
For the wedding of splendor.
chorus: Every weapon of spite,
Against you it will fall apart,
When the enemy
rise up with your rage
He will not defeat you!

hymns.title: Pour out your spirit
stanzas: Pour your Spirit upon us,
As you did in Jerusalem;
To Your flock, O send the same fire.
Indispensable for us too!
To Your flock, O send the same fire,
Indispensable for us too!
Pour your Spirit upon us
As in the centurion's house,
And give us the power of Your Word
Making the light shine in the darkness.
And give us the power of Your Word
Making the light shine in the darkness.
Pour your Spirit upon us,
And give us, today, many conversions;
O let us feel heavenly power,
And quicken our hearts;
O let us feel heavenly power,
And vivifies our hearts.
Pour your Spirit upon us,
And to those who suffer, give Your protection;
Praying we remain united in love,
To obtain the promised anointing,
Praying we remain united in love
To obtain the promised anointing.
Awake, Jesus Christ, those who sleep
The very deep sleep of the “garden”;
As you operated in ancient times,
With Your power guide us to the end.
As you operated in ancient times,
With Your power guide us to the end.

hymns.title: Sing, O Believer
stanzas: Sing with life, O believer!
Singing will be sweet!
Just walk forward,
Leave your grief behind;
Sing on sad nights,
Sing in the sun, in the light;
You resist evil like this:
Sing to Jesus!
Sing with life, believer,
Make your heart happy!
Praise the merciful God,
With happy song!
The world is full
Of trouble and pain;
Sing the deep love
From your Savior.
Sing with life, O believer!
God is your help;
Keep your powerful hand,
If you have faith.
Christ, yes, lift you up,
When you are afraid,
If trusting you sing
Your true love.

hymns.title: Wash me oh God
stanzas: I want to fulfill your justice,
I will happily be baptized
By immersion, for Christ to follow
And my sins, so bury.
When I rise from the waters,
I am already a new creation in Jesus;
I can and He serve and honor,
For believing in the sublime work of the cross.
With all strength, my good Savior,
Your holy name I will invoke,
So that I go from value to value,
To the sky of light, where I will rest.
chorus: Wash me, wash me, O God of love,
In the pure blood of Christ Jesus;
Make my soul whiter than the light,
In the pure blood of Christ Jesus.

hymns.title: A Kind Heart
stanzas: A kind heart, yes, costs pain to obtain;
Be meek, loving and holy in your entire being;
Sending new life to the heart - it gives light.
And all my work will be only in Jesus.
Who wants to follow the people
of our father Abraham,
In the heart, the bonds will then be broken;
Isaac is offered upon the altar;
Jacob, with a great groan, Raquel goes to bury him.
If great is the sacrifice - Isaac on the altar,
It becomes a benefit to whoever offers it,
For he has deep calm and heavenly peace,
Also from God it obtains, royal approval.
In the pit, Jeremiah, laments great pain,
In the darkness I did not see the good Comforter;
Yes, great bitterness turns into pleasure,
Angels come from above “The dreamer” to see.
Aaron was punished for his rebellion,
And, sad, humiliated, he accepts exhortation;
Consecrate your life to better honor God;
So in pain and struggle, you need to guard yourself.
Above dense clouds the sun always shines;
More immense promises cannot fail you.
Put full trust in those who cannot make mistakes,
Jesus, your pain will soon heal.

hymns.title: Jesus on the Mount of Ascension
stanzas: Jesus said to his disciples on the mountain as he ascended:
"Detain yourselves in Jerusalem, for the
The glorious coming of the Comforter,
To clothe the witnesses of the Lord."
The scene was filled with glorious light;
Descending the divine fire!, Jesus returned to us.
And all, clothed with the power of heaven,
They spoke in other tongues in praise of God.
The people, frightened by the power of heaven,
He did not understand that this was what God promised.
But Peter proclaims to them, "This is what the Lord says:
At the end of the days, I will give you a Comforter."
So Jesus tells you to pray and wait
The Holy Spirit of God, who comes to teach you;
Jesus, the glorious anointing, will send you,
And His sublime love, you will proclaim.
chorus: Descending the fire from the altar, the wind of love,
They quickly went to proclaim the Savior.

hymns.title: We are pilgrims
stanzas: We are pilgrims here
Until the work ends;
From this world we want to go
To the heavenly home.
My great consolation
It is always in you to live,
Oh, dear, beautiful Zion,
My eternal home!
Like Abraham's people,
Always traveling,
To the promised land,
Holy and sweet home.
O Lord, we want to win,
And reach you
Joy, peace, eternal pleasure,
In the blessed home!
It's my desire, Jesus,
Always pilgrimage;
Directed by moon light
You have to get home.
chorus: Oh! Very happy homeland
In you I will live;
I will live
I will live
Jerusalem, oh my country
And my dear home!
Jerusalem, oh my country
And my dear home!

hymns.title: There is a Very Close Friend
stanzas: There is a very close friend - Christ the Lord,
For he saved us from sin and fear;
This friend was in agony.
When the world rescued,
And God's love showed; give Him praise!
To know Him is to have life, Christ the Lord.
In Him we are allowed peace in our work;
He pours over us
His grace, for he loves us,
And he calls everyone to himself; give Him praise!
It's always the same, it never changes. Christ the Lord
And the stone of help; come, sinner!
Good manna is in the desert,
Our guide, right friend,
Your love is open sky; give Him praise!

hymns.title: Hand to the Plough!
stanzas: Who his hand has already put to the plow,
Constant needs to be;
The sun declines and, soon after,
It will get dark.
Forward, in Christ thinking,
In prayer watching,
With joy and love working,
For your Lord.
Don't be discouraged, because it's your cross
Greater than your brother's;
The heaviest took your Jesus,
Console you, then;
Your cross is carrying,
Like Jesus forgiving.
Happily walking
To the beautiful sky.
Be a good soldier of Christ Jesus,
Suffering afflictions,
Not suffocating the message of the cross,
In persecutions;
Go His love proclaiming,
News of peace, yes, taking.
To those who are waiting
Salvation.
When, finally, you let go of the cross,
Jesus will crown you;
With holy joy in glory and light
It will comfort you.
You will forget your worries.
Tribulations and sorrows,
When you enjoy heaven,
Perfect peace.

hymns.title: Go to Everyone
stanzas: Go into all the world and say:
“All power has been given to Me”;
Go. announce that I have already risen.
To give life to everyone who believes.
Go and teach all nations;
Publish salvation and peace;
Christ has already conquered death and its chains,
Freedom now brings everyone.
The door is open to salvation;
Who wants to enter it today?
It is Jesus who offers and who gives
Free entry into the heavenly home.
chorus: Trusting, I will go wherever I am sent;
By land, by sea too.
Behold, I am with you to keep you,
For all centuries. Amen.

hymns.title: Beyond Our Understanding
stanzas: Far beyond our understanding,
Loud above all thought,
Glorious in its sublime intent,
It is the love of God, without equal.
Made an infinite sacrifice
Of immense, unprecedented value;
Giving us His blessed Son;
I calculated the love of God!
Great, my sin was very great;
My condition is sad, dangerous;
But the love that was never fathomed
Saved me - God's love!
He was the one who forgave sinners,
Requests answered from evildoers,
Who healed the poor sufferers,
This immense love of God!
chorus: Big love! God's love!
Fill the earth and fill the heavens!
Big love! Love that encompasses
To everyone and it hits me!

hymns.title: The Savior Found Me
stanzas: In sins and fear the Savior found me,
Such an unworthy sinner, without having light from heaven,
On Calvary, when he died, he rescued my soul;
My forgiveness was consummated there on the cross.
My Redeemer Jesus rose from the tomb;
He has already conquered death - also our executioner;
Eternal life the sinner enjoys through His cross
For the dead will hear His tender voice.
Jesus ascended to heaven, wins victory here.
And in the right hand of the good God, he has Him as Mediator,
Intercede on your behalf, don’t stop there.
Do not despise this voice of your Lord.
chorus: Come to the Lord, come sinner:
He is tender and very faithful! Come sinner!
Come to the Lord, God is love;
Hear His tender voice “Come, sinner”!

hymns.title: Close to My Redeemer
stanzas: I want to be in a place
Very close to my Redeemer;
There I can rest,
For His support and His love.
No one can take me away
The peace that enjoys the heart;
kind Jesus will give me
The safest protection.
Sadness, I will not even be afraid,
Being close to Jesus;
I will always see myself wrapped,
With His brilliance, with His light.
chorus: Very close to my Redeemer,
Safe shelter I will find;
He will keep me from the tempter,
So I will fear nothing.

hymns.title: Land of Jesus
stanzas: Of this world, yes, beyond, there is a country of light;
Oh! Don't you want to go there? Oh! Don't you want to go there?
Where darkness cannot be seen,
for Jesus shines there;
Oh! Don't you want to go there? Oh! Don't you want to go there?
Through the doors of brilliance, evil cannot enter;
Oh! Don't you want to go there? Oh! Don't you want to go there?
Neither death, mourning nor pain will have a place in heaven,
Oh! Don't you want to go there? Oh! Don't you want to go there?
Oh! How divine! mansion Jesus prepared us!
Oh! Don't you want to go there? Oh! Don't you want to go there?
Where all the brothers
go see who saved them,
Oh! Don't you want to go there? Oh! Don't you want to go there?
chorus: Land of Jesus, land of love!
Oh! Don't you want to go there? Oh! Don't you want to go there?
Where the light of my Savior shines;
Oh! Don't you want to go there? Oh! Don't you want to go there?

hymns.title: In Jesus
stanzas: In Jesus, living each day,
In Jesus I have joy!
In Jesus, oh, sweet harmony!
In Jesus, I enjoy the peace of God!
In Jesus, on the unshakable rock,
In Jesus, in the incomparable man!
In Jesus, in the God so adorable!
In Jesus, I will not fear evil!
In Jesus grace is infinite,
In Jesus, oh! unprecedented blessing;
In Jesus, my mother is blessed;
In Jesus I have salvation!
In Jesus I do not fear evil and death,
In Jesus I am firm and strong!
In Jesus my boat heads north;
In Jesus I will always win!

hymns.title: Jesus Will Return
stanzas: Everything shows us that Christ is already back;
Jesus will soon return!
Already in this world the sea revolts;
Soon Jesus will return.
Christian, wake up, His coming is certain:
Jesus will soon return!
Are you alert enough to receive Him?
Jesus will soon return
Believer proclaims to sinners:
Jesus will soon return!
There will be no more sadness or pain:
Soon Jesus will return.
Console the heart that cries out to you,
Jesus will soon return!
For His wedding the good King calls us:
Soon Jesus will return.
chorus: It will come soon, it will come soon,
Soon Jesus will return.

hymns.title: To Golgotha
stanzas: My soul ascends to Golgotha,
Behold your Lord there,
Also the agony I had,
Suffering for you with love;
Don't you see a red torrent
Covering the earth in horror?
And the blood of innocent Christ
Spoiled for me, sinner.
My soul, wash you happy
In the blood of your Redeemer!
Christ alone is the path.
Which leads to the rest of love;
Rejoice in the omnipotent
By all His mercy,
Also for the excellent gift
Of Christ in everyone who believes!
My soul, o rise to the heights!
There you will hear the talk
Of Him whom I exalt;
Don't you know that he sees your pain?
In divine grace meditate,
Which you have in Jesus, your Lord;
Receive the blessed glory
Praying to God, fervently!
Hosannas to the omniscient!
Jesus came here to save
My soul of the “old serpent”
Who goes around the world trying;
Hosannas to God let us sing
By His Word of love;
Hosannas and glory we yield,
To Christ Jesus, the Lord.

hymns.title: Real Enjoyment
stanzas: Oh! What real joy I feel in my being,
I already have God's forgiveness!
For Jesus tells us: Whoever believes
Receive salvation.
What mercy, what love the Lord showed
Dying on the hard cross;
Divine blood! poured out for us,
The Savior Jesus!
chorus: If you believe, the next step will come,
The step is coming, yes, the step is coming!
If you believe, the next step will come,
Because Jesus wants to save you.
2 For love was Christ, my Redeemer,
From glory, here he came down;
And transforms the life of a sinner,
In the grace he gave us.

hymns.title: In Glory Will Come
stanzas: Wait for heaven, your Lord, the faithful
Wait praying, because he will return
In the cloud, in glory Emmanuel,
With great power, in order to seek it.
O loving Father, send Jesus.
The faithful believer awaits Him from heaven;
Oh, send him the heavenly light,
In which the Son of God will come.
The holy Gospel will be fulfilled
And soon in the clouds we will see Jesus;
“So he will descend as you saw him ascend"
What He sacrificed for us on the cross!
chorus: In glory the Son of God will come,
Always praying Jesus wait;
If you see the “morning star” in the sky,
Alert here!

hymns.title: Do you want forgiveness
stanzas: Do you want to be saved, do you want forgiveness,
Peace and rest in the heart?
What will you do to have the light?
With all your strength - Believe in Jesus;
If today you want to believe in Christ.
Even if you are dead you will live;
Leave this deceiving world,
Believe only in Christ. your Savior.
O believe in Christ - here he is
In our midst, cry for you;
He loves you; Do you want the light?
Do you want victory? - Believe in Jesus,
Yes! Today I believe in the Savior,
And my life, my Redeemer;
In my fights, the Captain;
I believe in Christ with my heart.
When the enemy with his terror
Roars around with great fury
Do not be discouraged by your cross,
Look up - Believe in Jesus;
And in the terrible trials of horror,
Go forward with your Lord,
He keeps you from corruption
And free you from temptation.

hymns.title: The Shadow of My Redeemer
stanzas: I always need to lean on
At the feet of my good Redeemer;
Presto will come to take me
To the heavens, my homeland of love.
I always need to stop
The shadow of my Redeemer;
I can't just defend myself
And raise the flag of love.
I always need to reach out
Contrite at the feet of the Savior,
So that I can console myself
In His abundant love.
chorus: I always need to launch myself
In the arms of my Redeemer;
Only in Jesus will I also take shelter
In His sublime love.

hymns.title: O Blessed Creator
stanzas: O blessed Creator, O source of hope,
To You, O contrite Father, we seek with confidence;
You have given us eternal glory as an inheritance;
The bread of eternal life, O send us from heaven!
United we await Your heavenly teaching;
O manda, we plead for Your divine power;
Accept this hymn, which we sing to You,
For we gratefully praise You for Your salvation.
The heart rejoices and the soul is content
On the day you surrender
to the omnipotent God;
What profound peace the soul of the lost feels
Who today is redeemed by Christ, the Savior!
chorus: Exalted Creator, supreme benefactor,
Your love pours into us, like a living flame
Exalted Creator, supreme benefactor,
Your love pours out, for Your Comforter.

hymns.title: Open My Eyes
stanzas: Open my eyes to Your light,
I want to see your face, Jesus,
Put your love in my heart.
And give me peace and Your fervor;
I humbly come to You.
Because I heard Your tender voice
Be my guide, Consoling Spirit.
I open my ears to listen
Your Word to anoint me.
Beautiful words of sweet love,
Oh! My blessed Savior,
I consecrate my fragile being to You!
To fulfill Your will,
Fill my being, Consoling Spirit.
Open my mind to see
Your love in great power;
Give me Your grace, give me strength;
Make me fight, winner;
Be You my refuge here,
Increase my faith in You,
Sustain me, Consoling Spirit.
Open the divine door for me
From Your crystal palace.
For Your beautiful face Lord,
I want to see the splendor in heaven;
And when you finally get in there,
I will praise your holy name
By your good Consoling Spirit.

hymns.title: Gospel Workers
stanzas: Gospel Workers,
Soon you will reap;
Whether you are weak or old,
You will have strength from heaven.
In good work, how many times,
We are failing,
We must always take turns
Trust in Christ.
Jesus is by our side.
His strength will give us;
Our beloved Savior,
Yes, everything will do.
In Christ always trusting
We will have help;
The Savior from heaven descending
He will come to help us!
chorus: Those who wait on the Lord
New forces will obtain;
Like eagles will fly,
They will ascend to the heights;
They will run without getting tired,
Without tiring they will walk;
They will run without getting tired,
Without tiring they will walk;
They will run without getting tired,
Until you reach heaven!

hymns.title: Jesus My Glorious King
stanzas: Jesus is my glorious King,
It is grateful to sing His praise;
He is King, but he makes me happy,
Filling me with Your love;
Leaving His throne of glory
He came to free me from this scum.
I'm already very happy, I'm already very happy with God!
Jesus is my most beloved King,
In struggles, in pain, he is always there
Patient and humble at my side,
Help and comfort give me;
That's why I constantly follow Him,
Because he is my Pastor and friend.
I'm already very happy, I'm already very happy with God!
Jesus, what could I give You?
Why so much love for me?
Is it enough to serve You and love You?
And give everything to You?
So accept my life,
Who prostrates himself to You alone.
I'm already very happy, I'm already very happy with God!

hymns.title: We are yours
stanzas: Son of the eternal God, we are Yours!
You bought us, Jesus, by Your cross,
We surrender, Lord, full of faith and love;
We are Yours, Son of God!
Your way, O God that leads to heaven,
Make us walk until we die.
Everyone who walks in it does not have to fear;
You are, Lord, the good Shepherd.
To those who wanted to save us we will praise
With voice and heart, in holy union,
Accept, therefore, Lord, our true praise!
Thanks, oh! God, we are Yours!

hymns.title: Jesus Christ, Beloved
stanzas: Glory to the divine Savior.
Our guide and Redeemer,
Glory be to the triune God;
Hallelujah to the God of love!
Everyone should rejoice
For the great salvation;
Honor and glory to God lift up,
For He gives us His reward.
I worshiped God, with song,
He is compassionate and good,
O divine Holy Spirit,
Descend upon us Your gift.
To Your name be glory,
O blessed and good Lord!
You guide us to victory,
Hallelujah to the Redeemer!
chorus: Jesus Christ, beloved,
Mighty Savior,
He was yesterday, he is today,
He will always be the God of love!

hymns.title: My Shepherd
stanzas: My Shepherd is Jesus Christ
I want to trust Him;
With Jesus, I have no lack,
Next to Him I want to walk;
Lead me to good rest;
To the green field in bloom,
Yes, it refreshes my soul,
Satiating me with love.
He is my companion;
With Jesus I desire to walk;
For it gives me vigor and strength,
So that I can walk;
He is the one who gives courage,
For nothing I fear;
Even close to death
I'm sure I'm going to win.
Walking by Your Side
I will no longer fear evil;
His staff and His staff
They give me real protection;
Against my enemy
The Lord will always come;
Prepare a table for me
And it's with me in it.
Anoint my head
With the oil of His love;
My joy is overflowing,
For my cup is sweet;
By His mercy
And for His sublime good
I will dwell in Your house
Forever, amen?

hymns.title: Have Compassion for the Sinner
stanzas: O Savior, O Father of love?
Have compassion on the sinner;
Without being in You, he will not find
The salvation that You give us.
Without You there is no forgiveness
For the sinner, not even salvation;
Only in You the sinner
You will find a Savior.
O King, give kings, have compassion
Of the sinner in perdition
Your heart, come and wash
In Your blood purify.
chorus: Have compassion, O Savior,
Have compassion on the sinner!
Oh come wash your heart,
Oh come and give him salvation!

hymns.title: Jesus Wants to Heal You
stanzas: The tender voice of the Savior
She speaks to you moved;
"Oh come to the doctor of love,
That gives life to the dead!"
Believe you, whom Satan has already
He's been calling for years;
Faith saves you, go in peace,
From all evil cured!
The deaf hear, the blind see,
For Christ is powerful!
the lame are healed and walk well.
By His glorious power!
Signs will forever follow
To true believers!
Demons, yes, they will cast out,
And they will heal the people.
chorus: Christ Jesus wants to heal you,
And it has the power to heal you,
Free you from all evils,
If you trust Him!

hymns.title: When the Saved People Enter
stanzas: Angels by the thousands, in heaven, will see
When the saved people enter;
Crowned believers will be too.
When the saved people enter.
The redeemed will meet there,
When the saved people enter;
Everyone must wear white robes,
When the saved people enter.
All winners will be there,
When the saved people enter;
Tribulation will not take place,
When the saved people enter.
The slain Lamb, (who is alive)
When the saved people enter;
Forever in glory will dominate,
When the saved people enter.
chorus: When the saved people enter,
When the saved people enter;
There will be great joy in heaven,
When the saved people enter.

hymns.title: Enough for me
stanzas: In the midst of great pain,
I saw the cross of Christ,
What a living source of love,
Enough for me!
My heart, wavering
And just, I could
In grace believe; but I found it
Enough for me!
Nailed, then, to the cross,
I have seen my sins;
And I found grace from my Jesus;
Enough for me!
With my Jesus I will sing
In heaven, happy, finally;
That His grace was, I will say:
Enough for me!
chorus: From the cross he runs without ceasing,
Unfathomable as the sea is.
This grace, which springs up like this,
Enough for me!

hymns.title: I'm a Soldier
stanzas: I am a soldier of Jesus
And servant of the Lord;
I will not fear carrying the cross,
Suffering great pain.
Others fought without fear,
Very strong I will be;
I will fight for my Lord,
Trusting in His power.
If I'm faithful to my Jesus
And don't go back,
I will reach the sky of light,
Place of holy peace.
chorus: After the battle he will crown me,
God will crown me;
God will crown me;
After the battle he will crown me,
In the heavenly mansion;
There I will see my King,
And I will have my reward,
After battle he will crown me,
In the city of Zion!

hymns.title: Come, Sinners
stanzas: Come all sinners
To Jesus, the Savior;
Come quickly, without fear,
Find the Redeemer.
Give strength to the weak;
From the mountains he makes plans,
The desert gives beauty,
And to believers, light and peace.
In weaknesses, he is near,
Dominating the evil force;
On the way, right guide,
And His grace always gives.
I have very supernal enjoyment
For the blood he shed,
Neither the world nor hell,
They take the life you gave me.
When Christ comes in glory
Searching for His people.
We will sing the story,
Of God's love, in heaven.
chorus: Yes I know; Oh! I know,
Christ saves the lost sinner!
Yes I know; oh! I know,
Christ saves the lost sinner!

hymns.title: What Are You Looking For?
stanzas: What are you looking forward to?
O lost sinner?
Everything you hold dear,
It will wither like a beautiful flower!
When your end comes,
When your end comes,
Your enjoyment will cease,
But the believer will enter,
But the believer will enter,
In an eternal home of rest!
In this world there are beautiful flowers,
Who want to seduce us,
But thorns they have, what pains,
They will always produce;
But Christ the Savior
But Christ the Savior
Of Sharon is a beautiful rose,
It has an excellent odor,
It has an excellent odor,
And cheers the unhappy soul!
Let go of the world and sin
That bring you perdition;
And gladly accept
To Jesus in the heart.
Eternal life you will have;
Eternal life you will have;
Yes, you will enjoy holy joy;
Christ will be your peace,
Christ will be your peace,
And the high heavens are your rest.

hymns.title: I care about Jesus
stanzas: When I need you
Jesus, my Savior!
Your love comes to make me happy,
When I need You.

hymns.title: No Sin Enters into Heaven
stanzas: Sin does not enter heaven
Fatigue, sadness, nor pain;
There is no broken heart,
For everyone is full of love,
The clouds of terrestrial life
Glory cannot overshadow
From the kingdom of heavenly joy,
That God wanted me to prepare!
Paying is not necessary
The house, which I will have there;
And my eternal clothing,
In heaven, it will never break.
I will never live in poverty,
Afflicted in my holy home,
There is a lot of wealth there,
Which I can enjoy.
In heaven mourning is banished,
Burials will not take place;
Sepulchers are never built,
I won't find dead there.
The old will be transformed;
Changed we will stay.
Which stars are scattered by God
In the sky, forever shine.
chorus: I will go to the beautiful city,
Jesus will give me a place,
With believers of all ages,
I will always praise God.
I miss heaven so much,
Of the glories that I will see there;
Oh! What fun will I have,
When I see my Lord,
Surrounded by great splendor!

hymns.title: I Need You More
stanzas: Jesus, I need more love,
Kingdom of God, in my heart;
Of compassion You are the Lord;
I need you more.
I need you more,
Of Your true love;
I know you're ready to help me,
I need more of you!
Jesus, I need more power,
Gift of the eternal Comforter;
You are the giver that fills my being;
I need more of you!
I need you more,
Of Your true power,
From the moon, grace, come and fill me,
I need more of you!
Jesus, I need to imitate You more,
With humility and submission;
Tua instrução eu quero guardar,
I need you more,
I need you more,
Of effective grace,
I know that You want to grant it to me,
I need more of you!
Jesus, I need to hear more
In my silence the voice of love,
That gives me strength to serve You.
I need you more.
I need you more.
Your true voice
In my silence always answer,
I need more of you!
Jesus, I need more communion.
With you to be in holy Tabor;
And splendor, transfiguration;
I need you more.
I need you more.
True transformation;
I want to have Your face,
I need more of you!

hymns.title: Your Precious Blood
stanzas: Jesus saved me with His precious blood;
Jesus bought me with His precious blood,
With His power He has already healed me;
My sin has already nailed it to the cross!
Jesus forever saved me!

hymns.title: Lost Andei
stanzas: Lost in this world I walked,
Immersed in its darkness;
In vain promises I trusted;
There was no God, no salvation.
I had no strength to live,
With nothing more I hope;
When a light I could see,
Who came to enlighten me.
I looked at the light and then I believed,
And I was very happy;
Pleasure from heaven I also felt;
When this light I embraced.
I confess with satisfaction,
That in this light I feel good;
Peace entered the heart,
Because I saw a shelter beyond.
In the arms of the Lord Jesus,
I enjoy living,
United to the saving light,
That Christ came to bring me.
chorus: I was lost, but I was saved,
Being guided by the light,
That on Calvary I saw
And took me to King Jesus!

hymns.title: Union of Brothers
stanzas: When we gather here,
O brothers, in holy love,
We certainly enjoyed it,
Blessings from the Comforter!
May His presence always,
Of Jesus testifying;
With words and sentences
To anyone who wants to listen.
When we humble ourselves
Before the good Comforter,
The power we seek.
Grant us with love;
And you see, glorious,
In vision, Jesus passes by,
Behold, he seeks eagerly,
A soul baptize.
When we all find each other
Ready to listen,
By the anointing, listen we will
The good God, speaking to us;
And in heaven, yes, when we arrive,
Oh! What party will there be,
When we already meet
In the place that God will give!
O redeemed ones, ever firm,
Waiting ardently,
May God confirm more in us
His comforting power;
Hey! Onward, on the way,
By the glorious light,
Because there's a lot of neighbors with us,
The beloved and good Jesus!

hymns.title: Go Praying
stanzas: You are surrounded by grief,
Are you tried by pain?
You are tired of suffering,
And also your work?
In illnesses, uncertainties,
That your soul will pass,
Only Jesus will give firmness,
And it will also heal you.
To the Lord the voice raises,
Pray to God with great fervor,
Because the faults are worth it to you
And ease your pain.
Is God slow to console you?
Pray with power;
I'm ready, I can give you help,
Answer your request.
chorus: Keep praying, keep praying,
When the hurricane blows.
The Lord is watching,
It will give you consolation.

hymns.title: The Dawn Star
stanzas: Show yourself, morning star,
O kind Savior!
Without Your light, life is vain,
Without Your light we have no vigor!
Without Your light we have no vigor!
Christ Jesus is, of the faithful,
The shining star,
Also the good Emmanuel,
That in the morning fills us with love,
That in the morning fills us with love.
Blessed star of the Hebrews,
That the world lit up.
And sent us His rays,
Rays of love, which has already saved us,
Rays of love, which has already saved us.
chorus: O morning star, star that saves
The lost soul that wanders without direction!

hymns.title: Listen to the Gospel
stanzas: The desirous sinner
Of true forgiveness,
The voice of Christ, blessed,
Listen carefully!
Today, with faith and grace
Come accept forgiveness,
Of Christ, for he embraces you,
Giving you salvation!
Christ Jesus has spoken
Your blood with great pain,
To save you, lost,
And fill you with love!
If you contritely accept
Of Christ, His forgiveness,
Then you will have perfect peace
And I enjoy salvation.
chorus: Listen to the Gospel
From the Son of God,
The divine advice,
That comes from the highest heavens!

hymns.title: Gospel of Salvation
stanzas: Do you hear how the Gospel
It gives us true salvation.
And transforms the old man
In a new creation?
I didn't see any good in me,
But only corruption,
And tired of the fight
In Jesus I found forgiveness.
Like the dove that is tired
He went to rest in the ark,
My tired soul
In Jesus you will rest;
But the crow went away,
It landed on the dead,
Do you do this now?
Do you want to return to evil?
Jesus is my ark
Where can I rest,
And from there, the evil marks,
Even I can't see it!
Oh! How sweet the call
That Jesus made me!
“Come, O soul so weary,
Come from darkness to light’.
Sinner you are listening
The message of the Lord,
You are welcome in the ark,
In the refuge of love,
For the waters of sin
They will soon reach you,
By death awakened,
You will knock on the door in vain!

hymns.title: Christ Calls the Sinner
stanzas: Christ calls, calls, calls with much love,
“Today come to Me, sinner!”
To Christ give your heart,
Stained already by atrocious evil;
Come, today, come! Beautiful occasion!
Don't you want to come to this voice?
Christ calls, calls, calls with great love;
“Today come to Me, sinner!’
Jesus is waiting for you,
Because he wants to give you unparalleled love;
Don't delay any longer, come to the light,
Don't you hear Jesus calling?
Christ calls, calls, calls with great love;
“Today come to Me, sinner!”
Oh! Tomorrow? You won't live...
And why wash... your heart?
Happy time you will lose
And you will no longer have salvation.
chorus: Will you accept the Savior?
He is your Lord, and benefactor;
Call you now, come without delay,
Will you accept the Savior?
Will you accept the Savior?

hymns.title: Consecrated to the Lord
stanzas: My life be yes,
Consecrated to You, Lord;
May You always be there for me,
Operate Your love.
That my feet only go
Where the saints can go;
In an eternal song,
My voice be heard.
Be my time already,
Consecrated in Your labor;
May my lips, Jehovah,
Just talk about Your love.
Take, O God, my will,
Make it Yours, O Savior,
Today it lives in my being;
Fill me with Your fervor.
Oh receive me, Lord,
When I come to prostrate myself
At Your feet, O Savior,
Today come and consecrate me.
chorus: My soul washes Salvador
In Your pure, crimson blood;
My life takes to be, Lord,
Yours forever, yes.

hymns.title: You are welcome
stanzas: Our jubilant voices
We raise with fervor,
For the friendly welcome
Of the Lord's workers.
Receive the fighters
Of truth, of love,
We gave Jesus praise,
Which brought them with vigor.
Embrace the good soldiers
From the ranks of Jesus.
To those who fight hard
To diffuse the light.
Of the faithful it is very supernal
Work without delay;
To make the King eternal
Reign in every heart!
chorus: You are welcome,
You are welcome,
Jehovah’s Champions!
Congratulations, but not fake,
The congregation gives it to you.

hymns.title: At Your Feet
stanzas: At Your feet, O Jesus Christ,
I will seek your face,
Listening to which Mary,
The words of love;
At Your feet, O Jesus Christ,
I will forget my past,
For Your faithful and tender hand,
It has saved me from fear.
At Your feet, O Jesus Christ,
I find tender compassion,
For all my regrets
My conflicts, my pain;
Deliver me, O Jesus Christ,
Of care, of affliction,
And grant me constant
Your comforting power!
At Your feet, O Jesus Christ,
I enjoy Your love,
In Your eyes there is sweetness
In Your bosom protection;
Give me, O Christ, Your mind.
Give me grace and fervor,
And may the world always
See salvation in me.
At Your feet, O Jesus Christ,
I have a divine pleasure!
At Your feet I find shelter,
Oh! Kind Savior!
Only in You, O Jesus Christ,
There is unparalleled comfort,
For my downcast soul.
In this world of horror.

hymns.title: Jesus Lifted Me Up
stanzas: The Savior, for His love,
To the vile world he descended for us,
And from an abyss of horror,
My soul has risen!
I resisted His voice!
While lover called me,
But His grace I received,
Which lifted me up!
Oh! How much pain you suffered for me,
Nailed to the cross, he expired.
But Jesus saved me like this,
Ali lifted me up!
What a happy gift you see in me,
For Your grace has saved me,
But I don't understand why
Jesus lifted me up!
chorus: What salvation did Jesus give me,
Who won for me on the cross,
Being in shadow, in full light,
With your power you lifted me up!

hymns.title: Believers Sing!
stanzas: Believers, sing and sing praises
To the Lord, to our God,
God of infinite, immense goodness,
Creator of the earth and heavens;
That, with power so vast and effective,
He gave us salvation and complete peace.
Glory and praise to the God of love;
Fervently, sincerely,
Glory to the omnipotent Father!
Believers, sing and sing praises
To Jesus, the Savior,
Who loved us and saved us forever,
From the power of the tempter,
Glory to Jesus, author of salvation,
All honor, glory and worship,
Glory and praise to the Savior,
With vigor, ardently,
Glory to the omniscient Son!
Believers, sing and sing praises
To the divine Preceptor,
Who sent us Christ, already exalted,
By the right hand of the Lord;
Today I praised the good Comforter.
That fills us with fervent love!
Glory and praise to the teacher,
With ardor, and a beautiful song
Give to the Holy Spirit!
chorus: To our Creator,
Let us pay honor and glory,
To our Savior,
Let us sing a thousand praises;
And to the good Comforter,
Honor and praise we also gave;
Honor the Trinity forever, amen.

hymns.title: The Celestial Gift
stanzas: As soon as God baptized me,
My soul saw more light,
For the heavenly gift the Father sent,
To give praise to my King Jesus,
I am a witness of my Lord,
And I will always talk about Him;
Also from the seal of love,
That my cup overflows.
I will follow the good path,
If I want to obey
To the Gospel, to the unparalleled light,
Where will I receive life,
Of Jesus Christ I will speak,
who is the Savior of men;
O come today and receive,
Divine grace from my Lord.
chorus: Praise be to Jesus, the Christ,
Who continues to baptize,
With strange tongue we have seen,
The heavenly gift, the Father commands!

hymns.title: Turn to Me
stanzas: This is what Jesus spoke to us:
“Turn to Me,
Salvation. peace, light,
You will finally find it.”
Oh, wait for the good Jesus,
The morning star.
For He leads you to heaven;
Leave life empty!
Also, Jesus said to you:
“Give life, I am water,
And whoever is thirsty come to Me.
I give you the gift freely.”
And from your womb they will come out
In glory to the Savior,
Live torrents, which will be:
Peace, faith, love!
Yet Jesus spoke
To every sinner:
"O come to Me, I am the light,
That shines brightly”;
And you, who lie, O mortal,
In the darkness of horror,
Oh come to the heavenly light,
To Christ, the Savior!
Those who are redeemed from Him are,
Your steps will follow;
His justice, and His forgiveness,
They will enjoy it for free,
Jesus is everything to me;
The King, and my Lord;
Looking, yes I do,
From heaven real vigor!

hymns.title: At the Prostrate Feet of Christ
stanzas: Of the risen Christ,
At your feet we prostrate ourselves;
With faith we adore Him,
Of the world is the Savior;
We redeemed believers
By blood already washed,
In grace well kept,
We have God's favor!
Everything we suffer,
Christ has already proven,
To the tired sinner,
You can, you want to help;
Oh! How much pain we see,
Christ on the cross suffering,
Thirsty there dying,
For the mortal to save!
"I'm thirsty," he exclaims
Oh divine! Lamb,
Nailed to the tree,
On the cross of the curse;
Oh! How much Christ loves
The lost sinner,
For blood has spilled,
To give you forgiveness!
To us, what saints we are,
Give us true grace,
For this to be done,
In us your will,
We went to the cross to find
Abundant consolation,
God's grace enough,
And divine! power!

hymns.title: Do Your Want Now
stanzas: In living for Christ you will remain firm
And peace after, will you always follow?
And will you leave your cares at the foot of the cross?
Do what you want now!
Do you want to go after Christ and carry the cross?
Do you want to know the peace that Jesus gives?
Do you want me to guide you with the true light?
Do what you want now!
Do you want your friends to meet you in heaven?
You must prepare your life without delay,
Do you want your life to be consecrated to Jesus?
Do what you want now!
chorus: His power and His gifts will give you;
Christ will overwhelm you with joy;
From the heart the stains will be cleaned
Doing, forever, His will!

hymns.title: The Comforter's Rain
stanzas: Unanimous at the foot of the cross,
We ask fervently,
Send us today, O Jesus,
The good Comforter!
Which lives fire or hurricane,
He makes Him come down to us;
And may every heart
A temple of His being.
Through faith and prayer,
You will open the sky,
The holy anointing oil,
You will pour it into us!
We ask you now
Oh burn all evil
And vivify us here,
With heavenly fire!
chorus: Yes, send another rain,
O good savior!
And with Your flame
Destroy evil from us;
Give us the rain,
From the Comforter;
Inflame your people
With heavenly power!

hymns.title: Soon I will see Bom Jesus
stanzas: Soon in heaven, Jesus will appear
In glorious light; everyone will see it
On that day, then, I will receive
Christ's reward; oh! what a pleasure!
At the coming of the Lord I will receive,
Of His eternal love, rest and pleasure,
- Of this, my good Jesus, you have already told me
And the heavenly light of Jehovah!
At the coming of the Lord I will enjoy pleasure,
When my Savior in glory appears;
Behold, He is coming soon, the saints will take
To the mansion beyond, where will it come from!
chorus: Soon I will see the good Jesus,
And I will live in full light;
In the beautiful sky I will enjoy...
From all pain, by God, I will be free.

hymns.title: Let go of the World!
stanzas: Sinner, we want to give you an invitation.
A divine and consoling invitation;
Today you want to return to your paternal home,
Where Christ awaits you full of love.
When Christ suffered nailed to the cross;
He prepared a divine dish for your being;
And now calls you to His light;
For your hungry soul He wants to satisfy!
Oh, accept the invitation that Jesus gives you,
Which opens the entrance to the mansion of light;
And the divine joy that satisfies you,
Oh, accept the invitation of the Lord Jesus!
Woe to the holy invitation to refuse,
And consider the blood of Jesus profane;
The heavenly banquet will not enjoy,
Who despises the invitation made there on the cross!
chorus: Leave the world now, come after Jesus;
Which can save you right now!
Everything is ready, what a divine light!
Today Christ invites you to come and have dinner!

hymns.title: Listen, Poor Sinner
stanzas: Listen, poor sinner,
In Christ there is forgiveness;
Now accept the Savior,
For in Him there is salvation!
To redeem you, the Redeemer
Your blood has spilled!
On the cross; suffering great pain,
Jesus rescued you!
The right path is Jesus;
We find peace in Him!
Holy and light path,
Which always satisfies!
Come today, come deliver yourself
Leaving all evil,
God now wants to save you,
Oh come to the real light!
chorus: Come to Christ without delay,
Receive forgiveness,
And the life of hope
Then you will succeed!

hymns.title: Redeemed With The Blood of Christ
stanzas: I was not rescued with gold and silver,
Earthly treasure, never saved me;
The price was the blood of Christ, herded
On the cross of Calvary where life dawned!
Gold and silver value, oh! they didn't have
To satisfy God's justice.
But Christ paid all my debt;
It filled me with love and peace from heaven.
For gold and silver I could not reach
Before God and obtain forgiveness;
Pious blood of Christ, I was able to throw myself
In divine grace and favor receive.
I have not been redeemed by gold and silver;
Entry to heaven cannot be bought;
But only by the blood of Christ shed
On the cross, we will be able to achieve glory.
chorus: By silver and gold I was not redeemed,
Not for treasure of great value,
But for the blood that was shed
By Jesus, my Savior!

hymns.title: Oh Come Now!
stanzas: Come, oh weary soul, who feels pain,
To your good Savior, to Jesus,
And trust in the blood of the Redeemer,
Poured out, which was there on the cross.
You who wander far from the Savior,
In sin, in evil you are trapped;
Only Jesus will free you from pain.
I will give you salvation today.
