Christ further calls: "O you come to Me,
Oppressed, tired, without peace;
I will give you eternal life, finally,
In my kingdom of true joy."
chorus: Oh come now! Oh come now! Come to Jesus as you are;
Do not delay, sinner, in accepting your Savior.
Oh come now! Oh come now! Come to Jesus as you are,
Do not delay, sinner, in accepting your Savior.

hymns.title: Born Again
stanzas: Are you born again? Are you already with God?
Do you belong to the people, who go to heaven?
Do you have the law written in your heart?
Does full salvation already dwell in you?
Have you gone down into the waters, crossed the Jordan?
Do you still have sorrows in your heart?
Were you baptized like Jesus was?
Do you follow His side into the heaven of light?
Have you received the coming power?
Do you have your treasure hidden there?
Do you already live a life of victory with God?
Marching for glory? Do you walk to the heavens?
When he heard the cry, “Behold, Christ is coming,”
Are you prepared to say amen?
White is your dress, clear is your light?
Sing with the redeemed - Come, Lord Jesus.
chorus: If the path is narrow, the door is too,
Everything is done, don't delay, come!
At the portal of life Christ you will find,
When you finish the job, you will be there in heaven.

hymns.title: Believers, Advance
stanzas: Believers, advance,
Fight firm
Against vice, against evil!
Who wants to triumph,
Christ please,
Come to the divine fight,
Our guide is Jesus,
He always leads us;
Victory will give us,
Christ will always win.
The heavenly home
Let's reach,
If we fight with value;
March to heaven,
Always go forward
Giving glory to the Redeemer.
His blood that He shed.
He gave salvation to all;
Whoever believes in Him will enjoy,
Eternal life will be enjoyed!

hymns.title: By the Road
stanzas: On the side of the road are
Many who wait for salvation;
Can such godless souls perish,
Or are you ready to help them?
On the side of the road are
Many who seek bread from heaven;
For the hungry, oh! who will speak
Of the Gospel that will satisfy them?
Along the way you go,
There are spiritually sick people;
What good Samaritan will you do,
Or which scribe will you pass beyond?
When the journey ends
And the end of the road approaches,
You will know many in the crowd,
Who received salvation from God.
chorus: Who today will say: “Here I am, Lord,
I want to talk to the lost about love,
As many as you find on the path of life,
Of Christ I will speak"

hymns.title: Sun of Justice
stanzas: The sun of justice we will proclaim
Your light shines anywhere,
Your golden glow of love and peace,
Complete salvation to the fallen brings.
Celestial radiance shines from the heavens.
Tell us about Christ, about the love of God;
With Jesus we will all work,
From heaven to the lost, splendor will take.
Just a few strong rays of this radiance,
The whole earth may flood with love;
They can make a garden out of a desert;
Sun shine. Oh shine for me.
chorus: Shine, O true sun!
We will spread your heavenly rays;
Shine, O true sun!
So beautiful rays we will proclaim!

hymns.title: My Jesus Comes
stanzas: The testimonies indicate
How soon Christ will come;
The signs already testify
He will come soon.
Oh! Day of great glory,
It will be for the redeemed!
It will be a day of victory;
Jesus will soon come.
Everything is dark in the world,
The night has come,
But a voice of very deep love
It says Jesus will return.
My body has already transformed,
An open sky will find!
With a thousand angels at His side,
Jesus will soon come!
Sadness disappears
And there will be no pain;
Stars are already shining;
The party will begin!
Rest promised there,
My soul will then enjoy;
Listen to the message, lost;
Jesus will soon come!
chorus: My Jesus comes, my Jesus comes;
I will meet Him in heaven!
Angels on harps play,
Giving praise to God!

hymns.title: I will follow Christ
stanzas: Always! Always! I will follow Christ!
Wherever He goes, I will follow Him,
Always! Always! I will follow Christ!
Wherever He goes, I will follow Him!

hymns.title: God is the same
stanzas: Oh! How good it is to remember primitive times
And the revivals we hear about;
God wants to give us more spiritual fervor.
To His people send Pentecostal power.
Oh! How good it is for early believers to remember
The fervent prayers, their joyful singing,
God listened to them and always freed them from evil,
And he also filled them with Pentecostal power!
Some say: "Everything has changed today."
But I know that my God will never change;
God will remain like an eternal lighthouse,
Sending His people Pentecostal power!
chorus: Our God is the same today as then,
He heals, baptizes and gives us salvation.
Spiritual life is abundant here
For those who receive Pentecostal power!

hymns.title: Rejoice, O Redeemed
stanzas: Glorious is the Lamb,
He is worthy of praise;
It's the real rescue
From sin and horror,
Rejoice, O redeemed ones;
Sing glory to the Redeemer!
Honor, glory and dominion
To Jesus, the King of kings!
That in the holy prediction
It is the light of His faithful ones.
Rejoice, O redeemed ones:
Sing glory, and you will win!
chorus: Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Sing glory and give praise!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Sing glory to the Redeemer!

hymns.title: The People of God on Earth
stanzas: The people of God, here on earth have a sign:
People who live in holy war against evil;
People who wait for Jesus Christ, who comes quickly
It is He Himself who tells us this: “Watch very well”.
My peace, yes, not that of the world, I will give you
The heart with deep joy, I will fill;
With His arm He guides us, oh! big love
For those who ask Him, He sends the Comforter soon!
O come to Me, Jesus invites, whoever is thirsty is!
Drink, O come, of the water of life, heavenly well!
Christ quenches the sinner's thirsty soul!
Saves, purifies and feeds, fills with love!
In Christ. always believing in following Him how sweet it is
Deep peace and love feeling: All by faith
Happy is the man who keeps this, for life has
He will always reign with Jesus Christ in the mansion beyond.

hymns.title: The Overflowing Fountain
stanzas: Oh! What an overflowing fountain!
Deeper than the sea.
It is from God, the immense love,
That Jesus came to give me.
Like the persecuted dove
And tired I was
But Jesus never rejects,
Whoever seeks shelter from You.
Grace abundantly
It has already spilled over me;
Where sin abounded,
Grace abounded.
When my day dawns.
With Jesus, I will go to heaven;
I will exalt Him forever,
Because he saved a lost defendant.
chorus: He opened the door for me,
And reconciled me,
By His shed blood;
He consecrated me to God.

hymns.title: The Feast of Glory
stanzas: Oh! What a feast of glory for us it will be!
When you are in the clouds, Christ will appear.
On that glorious day, my mortal body,
It will be like that of angels, in the heavenly home.
Oh! What a blessed coming of my Savior!
I am waiting for Him, very firm in His love!
O Christ, hasten the day when you return!
To see Your face I'm waiting.
chorus: Oh! In this very happy event
and pleasure too,
I will see my good Jesus,
source of all good.

hymns.title: My Steps Guide
stanzas: Guide my steps, Lord Jesus,
Lord of consolation,
Take me to the path of Your light,
The source of Your forgiveness.
Lead your faithful sheep
Through valleys, vergelis in bloom,
To Your fold, Lord Jesus...
Jesus, our good Shepherd.
On the wide road it goes sad and alone
The son of Belial...
Sad, hungry, covered in dust,
Unhappy slave of evil.
Lord of the simple, Lord Jesus,
Oh! Glorious God of love!
The wandering sheep attracts, leads
To Your fold, good Shepherd.
chorus: Outside, he is crying, without God.
no light, no home.
The sinner... Listen, Lord,
the sinner's complaint.

hymns.title: The Firm Promises
stanzas: God's promises are very firm
Firmer than the mountains are.
When earthly help ceases,
Those of God will not fail!
If you lack faith, in your troubles,
In His promises rest in peace.
When you're tempted, I'm pretty sure
What help Christ brings you.
If the fever burns, life ends
And death wants to take you away,
In His promises you will have refuge
Enough to shelter you.
We promise that we will go to heaven with joy
King Jesus will come to take us;
So to the faithful, courageous believer,
It will give a crown of light.
chorus: God's promises are very firm,
If everything fails, they will not fail;
If the stars shine ceases,
But the promises will shine!

hymns.title: Tell it to Christ
stanzas: If you are tired and down,
Tell it to Christ; Tell it to Christ;
If you feel weak, confused,
Tell it to your Savior.
When you are surrounded by temptation,
Look at Christ; look at Christ;
When hosts of sin roar,
Look at your Savior.
If others have already left the path,
Follow Christ; follow Christ;
If the strife increases around,
Follow your Savior.
When you reach the end of the journey,
Trust in Christ; trust in Christ;
He will give you a happy entry into heaven,
Trust in your Savior.
chorus: Tell it to Christ; tell it to Christ;
Who is the most faithful friend;
There is no other friend like Christ,
Tell it to Emanuel.

hymns.title: Jesus Wept Over Jerusalem
stanzas: Jerusalem by Christ is beheld.
With its heights that shine there,
But among the beautiful towers raised;
See those of the temple where you have already been;
Jesus with His very penetrating gaze,
Don't just see the beautiful exterior,
But rather sad, wavering souls.
Who rejected His divine love.
Jesus wept: His heart torn
Regrets and feels unparalleled pain,
To see His people going careless,
To eternal perdition walk!
A joyful sound rises from the city,
The people are celebrating jubilee,
But when the sun hid in the afternoon,
Jesus went to Kidron to mourn.
Jerusalem, you follow the bad path,
And you stone the faithful of God;
Oh how many times I wanted to bring your children together,
As a hen gathers her chickens;
But for Me, the doors you closed,
On the day that I came to give you peace;
By your blind sin you became,
Not accepting my true love!
The same story still repeats itself,
Jesus from heaven is contemplating
Cities that have apparent glory,
And he always continues to cry;
For He is the one who can give life
To the multitudes who in condemnation
Yes, they reject the grace offered,
The eternal and great salvation!

hymns.title: Glory to the Savior
stanzas: Glory! Glory! Hallelujah!
Glory! Glory to our Savior!
Glory to Jesus! Glory to Jesus!
Our great Redeemer.

hymns.title: The People of Abraham
stanzas: Like Abraham's people
To the land of Zion
He traveled among enemy peoples;
Today I am full of love,
And faith in the Savior,
Walking towards heaven, I go happily.
Sustained by love
Of the blessed Savior,
Watching, always praying, right I go;
Driven by the light
From the presence of Jesus,
Walking to heaven, I always am.
There in heaven I will arrive,
I will enjoy your glory
With those who serve the Lord;
I always want to work
To glorify Him,
So that everyone sees Your love in me.
chorus: Up in the sky, up in the sky,
The sorrows I will never know;
Golden streets shine there,
In the city of Jehovah;
Always happy, I'm marching to heaven!

hymns.title: Full Grace
stanzas: Full grace to save me
Pure blood to wash me,
And be able to keep me forever,
There is my Lord.

hymns.title: He suffered for me
stanzas: I read that Jesus was arrested;
With pain my soul vibrated;
I didn't feel like this before,
Now this excited me,
I read that He was led
To the court of Jerusalem;
There he suffered a great insult.
It was also covered with thorns.
I read that Jesus was judged;
He carried a very heavy cross,
And in her, for me expiring,
My vile sins he took away;
While on the cross, hanging,
U'a spear His side pierced;
They gave him vinegar on the sponge,
And He, for me, swallowed it
After Joseph of Arimathea
And other disciples too
They placed Him in a tomb,
And the guards kept good watch:
While in the world, He said,
That he would be resurrected,
And then God performed a miracle.
Making Him return from the dead!
The guards still watched,
When an angel came from heaven,
And the stone that was at the door,
With great power he removed;
Soon the bonds fell;
God's plan was like this;
And light and life shine,
And this was all for me!
chorus: I know I was guilty,
But He has already suffered for me;
I know He was innocent,
Suffering everything like this.

hymns.title: How wonderful
stanzas: Friend, you know, you also praise
Jesus, the Son of God?
You have already believed in Him, and thus received
Jesus, the Son of God?
Follow, who longs, and in his soul desires
Jesus, the Son of God?
Who was rejected by this beloved
Jesus, the Son of God?
If you trust today, you will also accept
Jesus, the Son of God.
You will be jubilating, and always praising
Jesus, the Son of God.
From the heavens, very soon, it must come down to us,
Jesus, the Son of Godl
Oh come, I cry out to you. Oh come, because I love you,
Jesus, the son of God.
chorus: How wonderful! How wonderful!
Jesus, the Son of God!
Oh! I adore you! Yes, I love you!
Jesus, the Son of God!

hymns.title: About the Sea Waves
stanzas: Oh! Why doubt,
Over the sea waves,
When did Christ open the way?
- When forced, you fight against the waves,
His love for you wants to reveal.
Darkness comes to scare you,
Storms at sea?
- From the mountain the Master sees you;
And in tribulation
He comes to help,
Your hand can hold you well.
Can you remember,
Wonders, like no other?
- In the desert the people had enough;
And the same power
He will always have,
For it does not change and will not fail.
When you ask for more faith,
He hears, oh believe!
Even though it is in tribulation;
When the hand of power your “ego” takes away,
You can walk on the waves.
chorus: Release the ship's cable
Take the oars in your hand,
And sail with faith in Jesus;
And then, you will see what a bonanza it is
For with Him, you will be safe.

hymns.title: Christ Is Calling
stanzas: Do you want to follow Christ,
And walk in His light?
Do you want to be seen by everyone
Carrying your cross?
Do you want to take the step today
And become a Christian?
From sin, break the bond
And you will have salvation.
Why have you resisted,
This voice of compassion?
Be of the love of God overcome,
Come, receive salvation.
What you ask for, here you receive,
Forgiveness in His blood;
Whoever drinks the living water,
There will be joy in heaven!
chorus: Jesus Christ is calling,
You want to free yourself from death;
With patience waiting for you,
Come, so He can save you.

hymns.title: By Blasting the Trumpet
stanzas: When the angelic trumpet in this world blows,
I will hear my name called by Jesus;
Because I believe in the promise, and that God will fulfill it
When I hear Jesus proclaim my name!
When the sky is rolled up and the sun gives no more light,
I will hear my name called by Jesus;
The land and the sea will pass away, but Jesus will remain,
That my name will be pronounced in glory.
Oh! What soft music will it be for me to hear
My name Jesus Christ announce,
Oh! What joy will my soul enjoy in the high heavens
When Christ proclaims my name!
chorus: Glory! Glory! Hallelujah!
I will hear my name called by Jesus;
Glory! Glory! Hallelujah!
I wait to hear Jesus calling me.

hymns.title: Baptism
stanzas: Your grace. is God beloved,
Come now grant,
To those who are going to be baptized,
Give them the Spirit and power.
In order for them to live for You,
Dead to the world they are;
For the Spirit to receive,
Give them a pure heart.
With God-given Spirit,
Come, come and baptize,
Those who today their sins,
They come in the waters, to bury.
Already with you resurrected,
They will praise Your name;
In Jerusalem, dressed;
Yes, in white, they will reign!
chorus: With Your Holy Spirit,
These souls come to seal;
Give them life and new song,
For Your glory to conquer.

hymns.title: Advance Faithful
stanzas: Advance, faithful soldiers,
Against the infernal hosts;
You hear war cries,
Be you men of Gideon;
Of this world, the illusion,
The terror of one's own death
It does not trouble our hearts;
Makes God, the weak - strong.
Advance, faithful soldiers,
Then the pavilion;
Here he is in front, raised
By Jesus, our Captain;
Let us hear the cry
Of those who were slaughtered;
Let's go, without fear,
To the aid of the injured.
Advance, faithful soldiers,
Always strong, fighting,
And the enslaved people,
Go forward, to free,
Send Christ forward
The vanguard of the redeemed;
Reward will be achieved
Those who are fearless!
chorus: By the blood of the Lamb
Yes, we will triumph,
The Lord will crown the victor;
I have to win
With Jesus, the true one,
I will win,
By His power.

hymns.title: In My Place
stanzas: Christ Jesus there on the cross already suffers
In my place, in my place;
All for me He suffered there,
For my soul to save.
Glory to Jesus, my sin has stuck
Over the cross, over the cross;
Precious blood washed my soul;
Glory to the kind Jesus.

hymns.title: I Will Not Find Another Good
stanzas: What other eager good shall I seek?
Much better, than Jesus I will not find;
In Him alone forever, I will be,
And from the heart I love Him.
The vanity of the world will end,
Everything here will end in its own time;
Forever only, it will last
Whoever walks in the light of Christ.
Among men I will not seek the light;
I no longer live, but Jesus lives in me;
Your grace is enough for me,
There will be no end in heaven!
chorus: I will not look for another good,
I will not find another good;
Already in me, there is Jesus,
I will only trust Him.
Who here can satisfy me,
In this deceiving world?
Only Jesus, Jesus, only Jesus, Jesus,
My King and my Lord!

hymns.title: Peace, Sweet Peace
stanzas: Peace, sweet peace! That springs from the cross;
The blood of Jesus brought us peace.
Peace, sweet peace! Walk in Your will,
From Christ, peace will bring us.
Peace, sweet peace! For every sinner!
Rest and peace you will have in the Savior.
Peace, sweet peace! Peace in separation,
The peace of Christ gives consolation!
Peace, sweet peace! As for my future,
Jesus, peace, will always make me enjoy.
Peace, sweet peace! I don't fear death, pain,
Jesus conquered death and its terror.
Peace, sweet peace! Jesus will not be late,
And he will give us heavenly peace and light. Amen.

hymns.title: In Belém
stanzas: There in Bethlehem Jesus was born,
Exalted prince of peace;
Divine love and holy light,
To the lost world He brings.
Honor and praise loudly,
We gave to the Son of God,
For we are sure,
To inherit the shining heavens.
The angels are rejoicing,
For the Lord was born;
The magicians come to worship
Of Jesus, the true Redeemer.
Just the deepest love
From our blessed God,
I sent the world with horror,
His Son, to save His own.
chorus: Let us praise the blessed King;
Let us praise the blessed King;
Let us praise the blessed King;
His power is infinite.

hymns.title: The Blind Man of Jericho
stanzas: While to Jericho
The good Jesus passed by,
A blind man, son of Jacob,
Without getting tired he cried out:
The crowd seeing him cry out,
- "Be quiet", I told him;
But he didn't listen to her,
Stronger he repeated.
Jesus then sent for
The blind man who screamed,
That came quickly, without delay,
But “still cried out”
Jesus asks with pleasure:
“What do you want me to do for you?”
"Jesus, I want to see today,
By Your power and grace.”
Then Jesus answered him:
“Go, your faith has saved you.”
And soon he saw, Bartimaeus,
And the good Jesus praised!
chorus: “Jesus, O Son of Devi,
Have mercy on me, Lord!”
“Jesus, O Son of Devi,
Answer my cry!”

hymns.title: Strong Headquarters
stanzas: Be strong, brothers in the work,
It is Christ who leads you;
Guaranteeing eternal life,
To those who walk in the light.
Be holy, watch and pray,
Love with holy fervor;
Many will be crying,
At the coming of the Savior.
The sleeping faithful,
They will hear the voice of the angel;
Transformed the redeemed,
They will find Christ.
And you will see that day
His glory in splendor,
You will enjoy peace and joy,
In the arms of the Savior.
chorus: Yes, walk in the light of Christ,
Freed from eternal pain;
Seek, you who have seen her,
The glory of the Redeemer!

hymns.title: Here I am Jesus
stanzas: Here I am, Jesus, praising You,
For You suffered thus;
Your blood spilling,
On the hard cross for me.
You filled me with Your love,
Oh! Wonderful Jesus;
When the Spirit gave me,
Bringing enjoyment to the flow!
Your disciples, you made
In strange tongues speak;
You granted me the same,
And you give to those who seek.
May Your Spirit descend,
In order for Your people to seal,
Fulfilling the promise
Whoever you trust.
The gifts of the Holy Spirit
There are nine, which Christ gives us;
And to the one who asks contritely,
Jesus will not deny them.
It is Your love, heaven and joy,
In which I will always rejoice;
To my Lord so kind,
I will give you a thousand glories!
chorus: Glory, hallelujah! O Lamb,
Your life gave me peace!
I give You true praise,
For grace so true!

hymns.title: At the Dawn of the New Year
stanzas: It's midnight, the year is already over,
We lift our eyes to the heavens,
Everyone praying for it to begin
The new year in God's grace.
Lord, we ardently ask,
Hear, for Your infinite love;
Save everyone from our homeland,
For Your honor, and for Your praise.
Our souls become untainted,
Not letting us fall in weakness,
Our prayer, Lord, listen today,
So that we can serve you here.
Thanks to You, for this past year,
For you have supplied us with much power;
Thank You, for this coming year,
For a thousand blessings we will receive.
chorus: Let us raise our voices together,
With joy and sweet sound;
In gratitude to Christ, let us rejoice,
For the dawn of another good year.

hymns.title: End of the Year
stanzas: Eternal God, in Your presence,
Our centuries hours are
And a second existence
Of the human generation;
But the man who by your side,
By faith he wants to fly now,
In this world of sin,
Slowly time passes.
Another year has passed away,
That life has become shorter,
And the desired rest,
Something else approached.
Thanks a thousand for Your favors,
Thy Church, O God, give it to Thee!
Hallelujahs and praises,
Your power will sustain us!
You protect families,
Visiting each home;
If the Lord helps us,
What could we miss here?
Wherever man loves You,
And serve You, walking well,
Make it your name
Always exalted! Amen! Amen!

hymns.title: Christ and His Humiliation
stanzas: You left, Lord,
Your glory, splendor,
When you wanted to descend to the world,
They couldn't find it
In Belém a place,
You were born in a nativity scene.
Hymns of worship,
Angels in heaven give you,
Giving you excellent praise.
But humble the Lord
Came to the world of horror,
To give life to the vilest sinner!
The foxes here
Graves have for you,
And the birds of the air nest in their nests,
There just wasn't a place
For your head to rest
Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
Jesus came from heaven,
Bringing us Your light,
Who gives us eternal salvation;
And with hatred and fury
They nailed you, Lord,
On the cross, where you gave forgiveness!
Hallelujahs in the heavens,
To the Lamb of God!
When His people come to seek;
Your voice will be heard
And for me, oh! It will say:
“Come, I have a place for you.”
chorus: Come to my heart, O Christ,
I have a place for you in Him!
Come to my heart, O Christ come!
You can live in it forever!

hymns.title: Communion
stanzas: Blessed Jesus, we call upon You,
We surround Your table, Lord;
By Your Paraclete presides over us here;
Come and fill us with holy fervor.
The great tenderness of Your heart
Called us here, oh! Sir!
For us to celebrate in holy union,
Your death, oh! good Redeemer!
Washing the feet of Your servants, Lord,
You wanted to set an example for us,
Of Your humility, of Your great love,
That among us must always reign.
You blessed the bread and broke it saying:
“Take my body and eat,
And every time, as is the duty,
In memory of Me do it.”
The cup of the New Covenant of love,
In Your blood, O sweet Jesus,
Fill us with grace, with new vigor,
Cheer us up on the path of light!
We want, Jesus, in this act of love,
Celebrate Your memorial;
For us it has infinite value,
A value that will never cease.

hymns.title: Now Come Jesus
stanzas: Jesus said, behold, I come,
I also bring with me a reward;
I come from heaven with the glory I have,
Watch him steadfast in prayer!
Jesus said, behold, I come,
And I will take the redeemed to heaven,
And instead of the reproach of wood,
I will give them a crown!
Jesus said, behold, I come,
I will rapture my Church;
Today seek Me with all your commitment,
So that I can prepare you!
chorus: Now come Jesus, glorious light,
We still wait for You; Now come Jesus!
To see You, thirsty we cry: Oh! Lord Jesus
We are watching over You; Come now, Jesus!

hymns.title: My Sins Took
stanzas: There was One who died for my crimes on the cross,
'Still unworthy and vile as I am;
I am happy, because His blood shed my Jesus
And with this, my crimes washed away.
He is tender and kind, there is no other like him!
For it converts the unfaithful heart;
And for this patience and divine love
I am free from condemnation.
My constant longing is to live in Christ,
My path, Your example marked;
And to give me life, Jesus wanted to die;
On the cross he took my sins.
chorus: My sins he took to the cross where he died
The sublime and gentle Jesus: the slights he suffered,
My soul saved
And changed my darkness into light.

hymns.title: Walking to Heaven
stanzas: 'I'm walking to heaven
Where the saints already are:
'I am happy and satisfied!
My homeland is Zion,
Death will not enter there;
What a joy there will be!
'I'm walking to heaven,
Where the streets of gold are;
'I am happy and satisfied!
I have a happy mansion there,
My Jesus will be there!
What a joy there will be!
'I'm walking to heaven,
Where joy and peace reign,
‘I am happy and satisfied!
Holy and true joy
Every believer there will have,
What a joy there will be!
'I'm walking to heaven,
To see my Savior;
‘I am happy and satisfied!
I will sing Your praise,
For my soul is happy;
What a joy there will be!
chorus: Oh! Glory! Hallelujah!
My desire is to be in heaven;
‘I am happy and satisfied;
Oh! Glory! Hallelujah!
My desire is to be in heaven;
What a joy there will be!

hymns.title: Overflow Vases
stanzas: What empty vessel is your heart,
To receive salvation from God?
Only Jesus can fill your vessel,
Of blessings that give power.
You will receive abundant life,
And constantly in God you will rejoice,
What stream of water does the Lord want to see?
The desert bloom
The Lord needs vessels to fill.
But empty vessels that will contain
All His grace, embers of the altar,
For the fire to spread.
chorus: Let your vessel fill until it overflows;
May Jesus rule your life,
Place your sacrifice on the altar today;
And you will see the blessings descend without ceasing.

hymns.title: Doxology
stanzas: Glory! Glory! Glory be to the great omnipotent God
To Your name we give glory because You are omniscient;
Hallelujah! Hallelujah to God the omnipresent Father.
Glory! Glory! Glory to Jesus, the beloved Savior,
To Your name we give glory, because You have freed us
Hallelujah! Hallelujah to the risen Jesus.
Glory! Glory! Glory be to the Holy Spirit,
To Your name we give glory, we sing this song;
Hallelujah! Hallelujah to the triune God, to the Holy God.

hymns.title: The Golden Day
stanzas: At the dawn of the golden day, the good Jesus comes to seek us
For with Him, we will always be there in heaven;
The millions purified by the blood of Jesus
They will rise to contemplate His beloved.
From India comes a people that Jesus purified
And from Africa, the tribes will arrive,
Who from Christ, the message took them, conquered them
Together, everyone will rejoice in heaven.
When China's millions,
everyone that Jesus won
Together with those who were saved in Brazil,
There in heaven united, glory may all give to Jesus,
Triumphant will be in His fold.
Let us spread the message that Jesus gave us
Of the glorious news that comes from the cross;
That His precious blood purifies the sinner,
Shedding glorious light on him.
chorus: When the saved gathered together,
Among the peoples and nations,
See Christ, dearly loved,
Oh! What joy will fill your hearts.

hymns.title: Arrive to Worship
stanzas: Arrive, little shepherds, arrive to worship
The King of the universe, who is born in Bethlehem,
Yes, rich gifts we can give Him.
Faith, love, our life too.
A rustic roof gives him shelter;
For a house, a nativity scene, for a temple, a portal;
On a bed of straw he lies,
Who gave the stars heavenly light.
Following a star that came to announce Him,
The magicians of the East behind Him go:
And they prostrate themselves before the King of Judah,
Of incense, gold and myrrh, tribute they give Him.
Oh! Glory, Hallelujah, the saved give You,
Hosannas the angels also sing.
Praise the Messiah, who brought forgiveness;
To Christ Jesus, who was born in Bethlehem.

hymns.title: Passing is
stanzas: Come, weary heart,
Christ is passing by;
Extend your hand to Him,
In His love, trusting.
Come, oppressed sinner,
Christ is passing by;
Come receive His love,
What is he offering you?
Come, O hungry, be satisfied!
Christ is passing by;
The bread of life comes to take;
Why are you delaying?
Come, sinner, without delay,
Christ is passing by;
In His arms comes to throw you,
Jesus is calling you.
chorus: Passing is - passing is...
O loving Savior!
Come to Him, O sinner!
Come by - Call for you.

hymns.title: There is Power in the Blood of Jesus
stanzas: Do you want to leave your sin behind?
In the blood there is power, yes, there is power;
Do you want victory from evil?
Your blood has this power!
Do you want to abandon your addictions?
In the blood there is power, yes, there is power;
Trust Christ to heal you;
Your blood has this power!
Oh! Paralytic, do you want to walk?
In the blood there is power, yes, there is power;
To make you walk too,
Your blood has this power!
Do you want purity for your heart?
In the blood there is power, yes, there is power;
More loyalty, more consecration,
Your blood has this power!
Do you want the message to take from Christ?
In the blood there is power, yes, there is power;
Do you want to sing with the angels in glory?
Your blood has this power!
chorus: There is power, yes, strength and vigor
In this blood of Jesus;
There is power, yes, in the good Savior;
Oh! Trust in Christ on the cross.

hymns.title: Jesus Will Come from Heaven
stanzas: Jesus will soon come from heaven,
Fulfill what you promised,
Everything reveals that it will come soon,
With Him we will go to His kingdom.
And, through the world without resting,
The messengers are announcing
The Gospel of the beloved Son,
Who wanted to rescue this world!
They will arrive from all over the world!
Soon you will no longer find a place;
If you see what you want, don't delay,
But come quickly to save you.
The day is coming, it is getting brighter,
For the trumpet will soon sound,
His Bride in white robes,
Jesus will lead to glory.
chorus: Jesus with blood has bought me,
And by the Spirit he has sealed me;
‘I am redeemed, I have the pledge
Of my inheritance in my Lord.

hymns.title: Return to the Father
stanzas: Return to the Father, you who cry,
Return to your paternal home;
For there Jesus, in holy light,
Give you eternal joy!
The Father is anxious there,
Because he wants to see you safe;
Then you will have salvation
If Christ is the target!
Leave the evil and return
To the home of the glorious Father,
Then, like this, you will finally be
Forever very happy.
Do not refuse, but choose
To Christ, the true path;
Go back home, to live there,
With God and with His Son.
chorus: Return to the Father, return to your eternal home;
Take to God, your paternal home.

hymns.title: Heavenly Jerusalem
stanzas: Heavenly Jerusalem,
So divine mansion of peace!
There is a wall of jasper around it;
Where is the light, my Lord.
There is a river. and which crystal,
Whose water makes one immortal;
The trees there are very beautiful,
And to heal oh! will serve.
There is no more crying and pain;
The curse has no force;
The night has gone and will not come again;
The sun rose, the "woes" passed.
There I will see my Lord,
I will contemplate its radiance,
And I will sing your praise
In gratitude and with fervor.
chorus: Jerusalem, mansion of light,
Jerusalem of my Jesus!
City that God made for us;
Eternal glory to your children.

hymns.title: Christ is at the Door
stanzas: Jesus Christ is at the door;
Always knock to enter;
If you hear it, open it now;
Open your heart.
Jesus still knocks there
And if you don't open it now,
He will return sadly;
Open your heart!
Jesus knocks, open now,
Open, yes, O sinner!
Judgment is at the door;
Open your heart!
chorus: Open your heart!
Open your heart!
Jesus wants to set you free;
Open your heart!

hymns.title: Jesus Pulled Me Out of the Mud
stanzas: I lay in a lake of fame, of horror,
I had no hope in me, a sinner,
But I have cried out to Jesus the Savior,
The Lord took me out of the lake.
Now I wish Christ to follow,
With all my being I want to feel Him,
For He saved me to serve Him,
And for His enjoyment, I also enjoy.
Only I want to serve the Lord,
With all pleasure and with great fervor,
So I will move from value to value,
In the glorious light of the Comforter!
Forever now I will proclaim,
"It was by believing in Christ that I was freed,
And it was in His blood that I washed myself,
I will stand firm on the eternal rock!"
chorus: Jesus took me out of a horrible lake,
Upon the rock my powders firmed!
A new song in me sounded,
To the Savior, Hallelujah!

hymns.title: My Good Savior
stanzas: Jesus is precious, my good Savior,
Forever I praise Him, for He gave birth to me;
If I find myself weak, give me Your strength,
For me, Jesus is precious!
Walking in the world, without God, wandering,
On the path of evil, which death leads,
Jesus said to me: “I want to save you”
For me, precious Jesus!
Already by His grace, I can enjoy;
He filled me with joy in the kingdom of light;
I contemplate by faith, my heavenly place.
For me, Jesus is precious!
Jesus is precious, because he wanted to save me,
Dying for me hanging on the cross,
And very glorious will come and get me,
For me, Jesus is precious!
chorus: Precious is Jesus, my Jesus!
Precious is Jesus, my light!
What glory will be His face to look upon!
For me, Jesus is precious!

hymns.title: Guide me oh Savior
stanzas: Guide me, O Savior, along the divine path!,
At Your side, without fear, I have eternal joy!
Do not leave me, O Lord, in this horrible and
strong sea; Take me by Your love to my eternal home.
You are my salvation, my dear Redeemer;
From terrible corruption you saved me with love!
I want only to be You, to love You and to serve You,
Christ is, for me, living and dying, enjoying heaven.
chorus: Christ! Christ! Do not leave me, O Lord;
Guide me by Your love, and I will be a winner.

hymns.title: The Holy Bible
stanzas: Holy Bible, for me,
You are my treasure, yes;
You contain the law of God
And you show me beautiful skies;
You tell me who I am,
Where did I come from, where am I going!
You rebuke my speech,
You encourage me without ceasing.
You light up my feet,
And you guide me, by faith,
To the fountains of love,
From the blessed Savior!
You are the voice from the high heavens,
From the Spirit of God.
What vigor it gives to the soul,
When in distress he is;
You teach me to triumph
Among the dead, from sin!
By Your holy letter I know,
That with Christ I will reign;
I am so unworthy,
By Your light, to heaven I go;
Holy Bible for me,
You are my treasure, yes!

hymns.title: I want to see Jesus Christ
stanzas: I want to see Jesus Christ, my precious Savior,
See the face of my Master, who suffered for me on the cross;
I want to go to the sublime sky, see the throne of the Lord,
Yes, I will live in this homeland of eternal joy and light.
I want to give Jesus Christ, without reservation, my love.
And also live forever among the angelic choir;
I want to be a messenger leading the sinner
To the cross of Jesus Christ, to the heavenly homeland.
For the redemptive work of Jesus who saved me.
I will live eternally to enjoy His love;
By the blood of the Lamb, I am already redeemed
With redeemed branches I will praise my Lord
I'm going to live in my homeland that Jesus went to prepare,
Dwell among those redeemed by the blood of the Lord;
Among the angels and archangels there in the kingdom I go
And give glory forever to the kind Savior.
chorus: I want to see the desired
Homeland where eternal love reigns;
I want to have a happy home,
With Jesus, my Savior.

hymns.title: Winning with the Good Captain
stanzas: Whoever serves God from the heart overcomes evil;
Whoever wins will have an eternal reward;
Oh, don't want to be discouraged anymore, when the trial comes;
Whoever keeps his heart pure will win.
Faith can take nothing away, which God gives;
For your people will always lead to the heavens;
Whoever confesses everything to Him will never fight in vain,
Whoever keeps his heart pure will win.
Behold, the weapons to fight come from the heavens,
They are the weapons of the effective power of the good God;
With the sword you can fight and overcome temptation,
Whoever keeps his heart pure will win.
chorus: With all fervor, against the tempter,
You will win then, like the good Captain!

hymns.title: O Blessed Shepherd
stanzas: O blessed Shepherd, listen
From Your children the prayer,
Little lambs that, in the fight,
They give You their heart.
Christ the King, my sovereign,
Do that when you rest
I contemplate you in soft sleep,
And seek You when I wake up.
Thanks a thousand, beloved Shepherd,
Today Your lambs give,
For Your hands, oh! have given us
What to wear and our bread.
Little ones, we seek you,
Tonight in prayer,
Reverently we wait,
In the morning a new anointing. Amen.

hymns.title: Lives Consecrated to Work
stanzas: Christ seeks already pure hearts,
May they always proclaim the forgiveness of the cross,
May he show the transgressors the good things to come,
To return from sin to light!
Pure lips Christ needs,
Let them speak of this salvation with joy;
Tongues full of infinite grace,
Let them proclaim to the captives, redemption!
Christ seeks hands, but consecrated,
To work with holy readiness;
They ask for your help in the already golden months,
The ripe wheat fields will soon fall!
Holy lives Christ needs,
Let sinners show His power,
In Jesus established and also contrite,
So that for them, do His will.
chorus: Go and work beyond the fields of the Lord,
That for the harvest they present themselves white Now;
Hurry to work, commands Jehovah,
You will then enjoy His great love!

hymns.title: Solemn Moment
stanzas: The moment is solemn;
The year is already expiring;
I pay like the thought,
What remains will pass away.
A faint breath is existence,
Brief, ephemeral like a flower;
For there is only science,
Who values time.
Name, fame, empire, glory...
Nothing human stands;
For only firm is victory,
Which is achieved by faith.
Fool the man who runs behind
To achieve goods under the heavens;
Woe to the wretched one who dies,
Without finding the peace of God!
The unfathomable eternity
She is blessed by Jesus,
That gives me immortality,
Eternal joy, full light!

hymns.title: The Words of Jesus
stanzas: I long to hear the voice of my good Savior,
Your sayings are a healthy feast, a feast of love
Like heavenly manna, vigor they give me too,
They always bring me instruction from the Master of Belém.
Only the words of Jesus give me value,
Keep evil and pain away from my heart.
The meekness of the Savior makes me known,
The divine joy of heaven brings me to my being.
At all times my Jesus, words will tell me,
In trials they are my asset, your voice will encourage me,
My soul has peace in them, who can disturb me,
Jesus gives me a real feast and calls me to supper.
There is no place. nor will there be in the world of horror.
May the lost have peace except in the Lord
For the words he speaks to us are a source of power,
For every poor sinner, who is humiliated to believe.
chorus: The words of the Lord,
These are powerful words,
They teach me, guide me,
The words of Jesus bring me light.

hymns.title: Holy Bible
stanzas: Holy Bible, sent by God;
Celeste torch, of true light,
Make my soul full of calm,
For in her I hear the voice of Jesus!
Glorious Bible, precious jewel,
It is my heart treasure.
That enriches me, strengthens me;
Show me salvation in Christ!
Blessed Bible, infinite grace,
God reveals His power!
True gift to the whole world,
I get a lot of knowledge from her!

hymns.title: Jesus Saves
stanzas: The Savior wants to save you,
O sinner, come without delay;
Receive it in your heart
Glorious salvation!
The Savior calls you, come,
Receive the greatest good immediately;
Salvation, the gift of God,
To Jesus Christ, the King of heaven.
The Savior is crying,
Why don't you turn yourself in now?
Come to Jesus today.
Come receive heavenly light!
chorus: Jesus saves, Jesus saves,
Jesus saves the sinner.
He loves you, today he calls you,
With His voice of love;
Jesus saves, Jesus saves,
Jesus saves the sinner.
You come now, come without delay,
Give yourself to the Lord.

hymns.title: His Word Revealed
stanzas: Fair, explicit and very pure
It is the law of my Lord;
For the sad it gives happiness,
Freeing them from fear.
His Word revealed
It is a flow of great power.
Where the troubled soul,
You can drink it at your leisure.
Look at the sky so beautiful
Where is your Redeemer;
Forever cease the duel;
Make peace with your Lord.
Cry out to the Savior, and the soul
Give it to him, oh sinner!
He will give peace and calm,
Ending your pain!

hymns.title: When crossing the Jordan
stanzas: When we cross the Jordan together,
And we enter heaven, we will see there,
Like beach sand the redeemed,
Oh! What a glorious sight it will be!
When we see the saved of the world,
That death will never reach,
If they greet you with deep joy,
Oh! What a glorious sight it will be!
There on the bank of the river of life,
Where peace and justice will be,
We will see the promised land;
Oh! What a glorious sight it will be!
When we contemplate Christ Jesus,
Crowned in the sky as it is,
And prostrate at His feet we worship,
Oh! What a glorious sight it will be!
chorus: As many as the sand on the beach!
As many as the sand in the sea!
What joy you will feel
All who are saved will see,
Yes, as many as the sand on the beach!

hymns.title: Divine Wealth
stanzas: A real gift God awakened
In your faithful - Gift of healing!
Every disease God healed,
And it still heals and it will heal;
For Jesus, for Jesus,
Oh! It hasn't failed, nor will it fail!
Are you blind? Believe, you will see,
Are you mute? Believe me, you will speak;
Are you deaf? Believe that you will hear,
Are you lame? Believe me, you will walk;
Faith in God, faith in God,
Believe that Jesus will heal you!
What do you suffer from? From the kidneys, lungs?
From fever, flu, or heart?
From coughing, nerves, or injuries?
Of skin, teeth, defluxion?
You will heal, you will heal,
By the power of prayer!
Leave the covers and you will see,
The wonders of the Lord!
Take away the stone and you will enjoy
The great blessings of love!
Faith in God, Faith in God,
To whom we give praise!
When illness comes to us,
In God we must trust,
For Jesus Christ has power,
To heal us in a moment;
Glory to God, glory to God.
Which is powerful to heal.
chorus: Oh! What divine wealth,
I already enjoy faith and light,
By triumphal vision,
But I will enjoy my Jesus!

hymns.title: Glorious God
stanzas: Glorious God, who is in heaven,
Counselor is against the setback.
If there is darkness here, it will illuminate me;
In tribulation, believers are firm in Him.
When death comes to strike my home,
So, I know very well where I will find it,
Peace that satisfies, because Jesus brings me
What is my task and what can contain me here.
Far from my home, I feel regret,
But the good Jesus gives me His light.
And my soul says: "'You are happy within me,
'I'm with you here', yes, you will be with me there.
I am a pilgrim, but soon I will be
Where I will always stay with His flock;
There I will enjoy His unparalleled love;
Thankful I will sing hallelujahs to the great King.
chorus: Oh! How good is our God!
He prepared everything for His own,
That through Him, they will arrive,
Satisfied in His mansion.

hymns.title: The Inexhaustible Love
stanzas: The holy love of Christ, which will have no equal;
His true grace, sublime and eternal,
And mercy as immense as the sea,
Which reaches the sky, with joy, I will sing.
Jesus walked the world, and people sought Him,
And all anguish, yes, at His feet he left;
And His love flowed, like a divine river.
Powerful, strong, immense, healing all evil.
Also, in blind eyes he put a new light,
The light that gives us life, which already shone on the cross;
And He also gave to souls the glory of His being,
By deploying His grace, and His real power.
The love of Jesus Christ, in the world, is a fanal,
What a victorious mark the path of the ideal;
Even though the years pass, it is always effective,
Precious is to give the soul incomparable peace.
chorus: How inexhaustible
The love of my Jesus!
Rich and Ineffable; nothing is comparable
To the love of my Jesus!

hymns.title: My Soul Wants to Have
stanzas: Come, O my good Jesus, console me;
Come, take me away from here, so I can be with you.
What atrocious suffering I feel here.
Far from the homeland beyond, I cry for You.
I want to rest near You.
I just want to leave this world here.
Nothing satisfies me far from home,
That you prepared there for me to live.
What glory, what pleasure I will feel,
When I leave here, with the eternal King.
Come, come now, Lord, you are King of heaven!
Come free me now, to be with God.
chorus: My soul wants You, come, my peerless Jesus!
Come, take me away from here, so I can be with you.

hymns.title: In Splendid Glory
stanzas: In splendid glory, in the shining cloud,
The Lord will come again to the world;
The holy Lamb, who there on the tree,
He shed His purifying blood.
Anger begins, the lie perishes,
On the day of the coming of Christ the Lord;
The world, deceived, in vice and sin,
He will not take part in the love wedding.
Perfect grace, not fearing, accepts,
For Jesus will soon come, from heaven;
O wear your soul, with grace and calm.
Day and night, praying to your God.
chorus: If Christ now returns, will your soul rejoice?
You have a lamp ready and you wear your clothes too,
To go with Christ beyond?
Delay no longer, but come to Jesus.
In order to turn on your light.

hymns.title: If Christ Goes With Me
stanzas: If, through the valleys, I make a pilgrimage, I will walk
Or in the glorious light of Christ dwell,
I will go with my Lord wherever He goes.
Trusting in the grace of my Savior.
If Jesus wants to send me to the desert;
Bringing good news of unparalleled salvation;
I will then deal with peace in my heart.
Following Christ, without further delay.
It will be my luck to bear the hard cross,
I always want to tell you about His grace and His power.
Happy with Jesus, carrying my cross.
I speak of Christ who is my light.
To the Savior Jesus I desire to obey,
For in His Word I find my knowledge;
Faithful to God I will be, the world will win,
Jesus goes with me, I will no longer fear.
chorus: If Christ goes with me, I will go
And I will not fear, I will go with joy; go with me;
It is grateful to serve Jesus, to carry the cross;
If Christ goes with me, I will go.

hymns.title: Christ My True Friend
stanzas: Before I didn't know Jesus the Savior;
For he lived in sins and fear;
But I thought that my faults, Jesus took upon Himself
And my enjoyment never ceased here.
Before, I didn't know this purification
And the power that the heart desired.
But the vigor of the promises transformed my life
And Jesus took me to the living source.
I am ready to go with Christ to proclaim the message,
For the vineyards where I go to work;
Well I know it's powerful;
Your grace will give me; And full victory will grant me.
chorus: It is Jesus Christ my true friend,
That my faults forgave.
It is Jesus Christ my true friend,
Because my soul has been freed.

hymns.title: Divine Healing
stanzas: Christ Jesus will heal you today,
If you can believe, if you can believe.
For he has unparalleled virtue and grace,
To heal your being!
Believing in Christ you will receive.
Healing from heaven, healing from heaven;
For He still has the same power,
The power of God!
Very powerful is Christ Jesus,
To heal you, to heal you.
All diseases nailed to the cross,
To heal you!
“Did I not say to you: If you believe in Me,
What will you see, what will you see;
Divine healing finally flowing,
If you can believe!”
chorus: Come, come, to heal you,
Believe, believe, that you will see;
Divine healing manifest
In your weak being!

hymns.title: Lifeguard
stanzas: For his sins, 'tis the sinner
Like a poor shipwrecked man without a Savior;
What a sad fate, perish at sea,
Nothing, you get tired, and you will sink.
The lifeguard doesn't want to launch
What drowns in the sea waves?
What a horrible death the sinner has,
Who does not accept the good Savior!
It is Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
The life preserver thrown from the heavens;
Christ can save you even today,
The lifeguard holds on with faith.
chorus: Praying, throws to the drowning,
The lifeguard without delay;
Before it goes down - Disappear
In the depths of the sea.

hymns.title: I Found Jesus, My Savior
stanzas: I found Jesus, my Savior,
Of faithful, truthful love;
I will not stop giving Him praise,
For I have salvation and peace.
Come keep me Your strong hand,
From all vice and evil;
I will overcome every temptation;
Support me the divine arm.
Jesus found me, so afflicted and in trouble,
Without having consolation;
He called me to Himself, with real love;
I arrived and found salvation.
He rescued me from eternal death,
From harsh slavery;
I am safe on the eternal rock;
I will sing, with gratitude.
chorus: I am saved by Christ,
Saved by those who loved me!
Perfect peace, He now brings me,
Because I'm saved!

hymns.title: The Sweet and Precious Voice
stanzas: I found myself in a state of sadness and pain,
Already foreseeing the end of life;
Today, I rejoice in remembering the happy hour,
In which Christ looked at me.
Today, I joyfully testify to you,
May Jesus, my good Savior,
He is my defender, my guide and light,
My comfort, in the struggle, in the pain.
Oh! What a happy and beautiful day for me,
When I heard the voice of my Lord,
I urge myself to trust in Him,
For He healed me, by His great love!
chorus: It was just Your sweet, precious voice
That I always heard sound,
Then I received hope,
That Jesus would heal me.

hymns.title: Come Passo Dar!
stanzas: With your sin, come to Jesus now.
He wants to forgive you.
Leave the darkness, come to the light;
Come save your life.
Against sin there is no other source,
Only Jesus can clean;
From your fears and guilt, come now
Take refuge in Him.
Oh! What offering for you did Jesus make?
To purify you!
He gave His blood on the top of the cross;
Come wash your soul!
Come take the step, without hesitation,
Jesus wants to forgive you;
Right now take salvation
Come save your life.
chorus: Come! He comes! Take the step!
Come give your heart;
Come and say: “Jesus saved me,
I am clean from my sin.”

hymns.title: King of Glory
stanzas: The King of glory, who will be,
Omnipotent Lord?
Only God, the Son, can be.
Who reigns eternally.
The wounds He received,
The death he suffered on the cross,
Prove it completely!
The death that He gave to death,
Winning the victory,
The grave that broke,
Ascending to exalted glory,
Declare His real power,
And make it known to the world,
That Christ is the King of glory!
Behold, high up in the sky,
Jesus, the King of glory,
There reigning beyond the veil,
With God, in eternal glory,
Where the multitude redeems,
In an ecstasy of adoration,
Give Jesus the glory!
Oh! How happy whoever believes in Him,
For you will see Him in glory!
Yes, everyone who is reborn
It has the pledge of glory!
Confess to be a sinner.
Trust only in the Savior,
Jesus, the King of glory!

hymns.title: Christ, the Hidden Source
stanzas: Christ gave us a hidden spring.
That any thirst can quench.
And whose waters are full of life,
They will always satisfy us for free.
There are many sources of joy in the world,
Men always go to drink there,
But they are filthy cisterns and wells,
What living waters they cannot contain.
Many men have already spent money,
Without the source of God to find;
But Jesus Christ is our roadmap,
That to the source, will guide us.
Oh, Alleluia to the good supreme Father,
For the blessings that he wants to give to everyone,
And for the source of peace that we have,
In our being, to rejoice!
chorus: Water will come out, live it will flow
From the fountain that the Lord opened, water will flow!
If everyone wants to drink, it won't run out;
Thousands of thousands come; it will always come out!

hymns.title: Christ Thinks of Me
stanzas: Through the storm
In any calamity,
This truth comforts me:
Christ thinks of me.
When comfort I desire,
Strength, boldness I long for,
In this, then, I see everything:
Christ thinks of me.
If I fear the enemy,
Being afraid of danger,
In Jesus I find shelter:
Christ thinks of me.
If I go away,
Separate me from my brothers,
In this I will console myself:
Christ thinks of me.
chorus: Think of me, Jesus
There in the excellent light;
You have already tasted the cross,
With endless love;
I am satisfied,
Without fear I go;
Christ thinks of me.
Christ thinks of me.

hymns.title: Winning Come Jesus
stanzas: Eternal glory already shines
Of Jesus, the King of kings!
Brief the kingdoms of this world
They will follow your laws!
The signs of your coming
More are showing each time:
Winning comes Jesus!
The bugle that calls believers
The battle has already sounded:
Christ, at the head of his people,
Crowds have already conquered.
The enemy, in retreat,
Your fury has already demonstrated:
Winning comes Jesus!
Behold, in refulgent glory
Over the clouds will descend,
And the nations and the kings of the earth
With power he will govern.
Yes, in peace and holiness
The whole earth will rule:
Winning comes Jesus!
And finally enthroned
The nations will judge:
Everyone, big and small,
The Judge will face it.
And the redeemed triumphant,
There in Heaven they will sing:
- “King Jesus won!”
chorus: Glory! glory! Hallelujah!
Glory! glory! Hallelujah!
Glory! glory! Hallelujah!
Winning comes Jesus!

hymns.title: Great Are You
stanzas: Lord, my God, when I, amazed,
I contemplate your immense creation,
The land and the sea and the starry sky
They come to tell me about your perfection.
When the stars, so far away from me,
I see it shining with vivid splendor,
I remember, oh! God, the sparkling glories
That my Jesus left, for my love!
I look at the forests murmuring in the wind
And, seeing that You planted each foot,
I remember the cross, the wood so bloody,
And in your Son I affirm my faith.
And when I think that You didn't spare
Your Son, beloved for my sake,
My heart, which You won in it,
Overflows, oh! Father, of love that has no end!
And when Christ, my beloved, returns,
When his people come from the heavens to seek him,
In the eternal home I want, jubilating,
To contemplate your holy face.
chorus: So my soul sings to you, Lord:
- “Great are You! - Great are You!”
So myh’aima sings to you, Lord:
- “Great are You! - Great are You!”

hymns.title: Dominator Is God
stanzas: Dominator is a peerless God,
For, with a mighty hand,
The storm stops,
And peace reigns, then.
The heavens and earth He created;
Beings and sources.
His will He dictated,
And brings life to everyone.
Oh! saints! wait for him!
Even in distress;
For the promises of the good Father
They will never fail us.
Oh! Never doubt God!
We must trust.
He blesses your children,
For loving them so much.

hymns.title: I Love You, O God
stanzas: I love you, oh God, not just because
I long for Heaven to enjoy,
Not just because I fear here
In death succumb.
I love you, oh God, because on the cross
You proved your love:
Jesus came down and in my place
He died, suffering the pain.
Therefore, oh God, my love
Eternal must be.
Sing your praise in Heaven
It will be my pleasure.

hymns.title: In His Grace
stanzas: In your grace, your rich love.
My Lord came from Heaven to Bethlehem.
How wonderful! My Savior
He died for me on the cross!

hymns.title: Enliven Your Church
stanzas: Enliven your church,
O blessed Savior!
Without your grace, it withers
It will remain, and without vigor.
Vivify! - vivifies
Our souls, oh! Sir!
Vivify! - vivifies
Our souls, oh! Sir!

hymns.title: Precious Name
stanzas: Take the name with you
From Jesus, the Savior!
This name gives comfort
Today, whenever and wherever.
This name always carries
To defend you well:
He is the weapon within your reach,
When evil appears to you.
Oh! what a precious name!
Joy brings to the heart!
Being accepted by Jesus,
You will have his forgiveness.
Holy name! adorable!
There is Jesus, your beloved:
- “King of kings”, “Eternal Lord”
You will acclaim him in Heaven.
chorus: Good name! - sweet to faith
- The hope of the future!
Good name! - sweet to faith
- The hope of the future!

hymns.title: Holy Name
stanzas: This holy name,
Name of Jesus,
Sweet melody
In my heart it produces.

hymns.title: Honors Be to the Lamb
stanzas: Christ, our Savior,
We adore you, Lord!
Thankful, we give you praise,
Honors be to the Lamb!
He was the one who suffered,
Who died for us on the cross!
And that's how it happened for us,
Honors be to the Lamb!
Sufferer who suffered there,
Winner who triumphed!
Savior who loved us,
Honors be to the Lamb!
Worthy are You, Lord, who to You
We gave our worship here!
Like yours, in the heavens, there
Honors be to the Lamb!

hymns.title: Christ Is Real to Me
stanzas: Christ is real to me,
Christ is real to me,
He lives in my being;
Your peace I can have,
Because Christ is real to me.

hymns.title: You are faithful Lord
stanzas: You are faithful, Lord, my heavenly Father:
You will give full power to your children.
You never changed: you never lacked:
Just as you were, you always will be.
Flowers and fruits, mountains and seas,
Sun, Moon, stars in the sky shining:
You created everything on earth and in the air.
The entire Universe comes to praise you!
Full forgiveness you give: peace, security:
You guide me every moment, Lord.
And in the future, oh! what sweet hope:
I will enjoy your rich favor!
chorus: You are faithful, Lord! You are faithful, Lord!
Day after day, with endless blessings,
Your mercy sustains me and keeps me.
You are faithful, Lord, faithful to me.

hymns.title: Friend Without Equal
stanzas: Unique friend!
Unique friend!
Jesus died in my place
In order to save myself.
Unique friend!
Unique friend!
Your great love will not change,
And it will never fail.
Unique friend!
Unique friend!
It is very close and wants to save
Whoever trusts him.
Unique friend!
Unique friend!
Invite with immense love
To every sinner.

hymns.title: Always with me
stanzas: Jesus is always with me.
Whether in darkness or in light;
He protects me, takes care of me;
I want to love whoever keeps me like this.

hymns.title: You, Lord, Are Our Friend
stanzas: You, Lord, are our friend,
That you came to save us,
You, who have always loved us,
You live to protect us.

hymns.title: When Thinking About Crucial Pain
stanzas: When thinking about suffering and crucial pain
Who on the cross endured our King for love,
Self, life, finally, and worldly pleasure,
Vain things here I will never love again.
From these hands, from these feet blood is gushing,
Source of power, and peace, and love.
I will always glory in this cross of the Lord,
In this endless love for the vile sinner.
Not even Heaven is capable of containing
The unparalleled breadth and power of this love.
There in Heaven, by faith in this love and power,
I will be at the feet of my good Savior.

hymns.title: When Seeing the Cross
stanzas: When I saw him die on the rude cross,
In pain and anguish my Jesus,
I understand being a sinner,
And my worthless pride.
Hands, feet and forehead in pain
They shed blood for love;
Oh! holy hand! Wounded hand!
You want to give me salvation.
I give a thousand thanks to my Jesus;
Love proven on the cross
Will stop and drive
My life in the future.

hymns.title: Calvary, Revelation of Love
stanzas: On Calvary we contemplate
Our gentle Savior!
- Oh! revelation of love! -
The mystery so long hidden,
God in Christ revealed!
- Oh! revelation of love!
God loved this world
And his Son offered.
- Oh! revelation of love! -
The Lord, on the dying cross,
He felt sorry for us!
- Oh! revelation of love!
God the Father looked upon Calvary
And his Son abandoned him!
- Oh! revelation of love! -
But suffering this abandonment,
Christ gave us his forgiveness!
- Oh! revelation of love!
chorus: Calvary! - Calvary!
- Oh! great pain!
Calvary! - Calvary!
- Oh! revelation of love!

hymns.title: History of Christ
stanzas: Tell me the story of Christ,
Engrave it in my heart,
The beautiful untold story,
Of grace, peace and forgiveness!
It tells how He, incarnating,
Came to the world to live,
And to sinners, unworthy,
God's love reveals!
Tell how He, kind,
Never rejected anyone,
How, with outstretched hands,
Everyone is invited!
How can the good Master not,
Whoever it is, refuse,
If, convinced and contrite,
Accept your invitation.
Tell me when on the mountain
Over the city cried,
because proud and rebellious
Your love rejected!
Tell me how he still cries
About those who follow evil;
And, hardened, they resist
To your divine love.
It also counts as Christ,
Even on the cross, he remembered
From your cruel enemies,
And he prayed to the Father for them!
Like the dying thief
So readily listened,
And on that day, I can
He took him to rest!
Tell me the harsh affronts
Who meekly suffered:
How, on the cross raised,
He died for the wicked!
Give me to live in certainty
That it was really for me!
May your ineffable love
There is no change and no end!

hymns.title: Christ, My Redeemer
stanzas: Christ, my Redeemer!
Christ, my good Shepherd!
You, who died, and shed your blood,
You are my Savior!

hymns.title: I believe, Lord
stanzas: Christ Jesus, your blood,
Your great love and righteousness
They are a glorious veil for me
To cover me with your forgiveness.
I believe, Lord, in redemption
Given on the cross to the sinner,
Who rescued from perdition
My poor being, for holy love.
I believe, Lord, that never again
It will barely be possible to enter the home beyond,
That, through the cross, the immortals
They will enjoy eternal good.

hymns.title: Because He Lives
stanzas: God sent His beloved Son
To forgive me, to save me.
On the cross He died for my sin,
But He rose and lives with the Father.
And when at last the hour comes
When I must face death,
Without fear I will have victory:
I will go to Glory, to my Jesus who lives.
chorus: Because He lives, I can face tomorrow.
Because He lives, there is no fear.
But I know well, I know that my life
Is in the hands of my Jesus, who is alive.

hymns.title: Resurrection Morning
stanzas: When the Savior finally returns,
In the blissful dawn,
Never again will there be atrocious death and pain.
What a morning! happy resurrection!
Dear ones, there they are!
All the redeemed will have life in God.
Oh! supreme pleasure that seduces!
Resurrect in light!
See the peace of Heaven while contemplating Jesus!

hymns.title: The King Is Returning
stanzas: The faithful are translated; your work here is finished.
The career of these saints in this life has already ended.
The good harvesters of the Lord have finished their work;
The harvest is complete: it is the coming of the Lord!
From this Earth the redeemed are ascending to heaven,
To meet God the Son, who appears beyond the veil.
And the temple is deserted; his preaching ceased.
It’s news everywhere: “Jesus Christ has returned!”
The redeemed go up: it is the heavenly feast:
All of Heaven is opening, in a “Welcome!” without equal,
What is the sound of many waters, we hear it chanting
Hallelujahs to the Lamb! - Let's go Home!
chorus: The King is returning! the King is returning!
The trumpet is sounding, for the saints to be translated.
Yes, the King is coming back! the King is returning!
Hallelujah! He's coming to get us!

hymns.title: Jesus Will Come Soon
stanzas: Soon Jesus will come from Heaven, take us home.
I must be ready when Jesus arrives, and so I go Home.

hymns.title: Now Come, Lord Jesus
stanzas: Lord, don't delay any longer
The light of Your kingdom,
Well, life here
Everything was converted into pain.
For You, Jesus, we look forward
There are the hearts;
Oh! come without delay,
Undo the afflictions.
With faith the Church awaits
The dawn of your light,
And he is begging:
“Come now, Lord Jesus!”

hymns.title: He'll be back soon
stanzas: He returns soon;
When, I don't know;
He returns soon;
Jesus will come again.

hymns.title: The Holy Spirit
stanzas: The Holy Spirit, Comforter,
He has already filled us with his eternal love,
Of your grace and full anointing,
To announce salvation! Amen.

hymns.title: When to Heaven We Go
stanzas: Sing the great love of Christ,
His grace and compassion:
In a peaceful and beautiful place
Make us an eternal mansion.
We are pilgrims today:
Clouds cloud our sky,
But one day - road ends -
No more shadows, no more veils.
Let's be loyal, therefore,
Whether in believing or serving!
A glimpse of Gloria
Attraction gives to the future.
Hey, to the reward quickly:
Let's get to Heaven soon:
The glorious portals open:
Here is Jesus greeting us.
chorus: When we reach Heaven,
Oh! what a day of joy it will be!
To Jesus we will give
Hosannas, full of pleasure.

hymns.title: Oh! Father, the Holy Spirit
stanzas: Oh! Father, the Holy Spirit,
We ask, come and give us,
So that He comes now
His power bestow upon us!
Convict us of all evil,
Console the hearts,
Support us with faith
In the midst of pain and afflictions!
Inhabit our hearts
To be your temples,
Operate conversion
And redemption, oh! our God!

hymns.title: The Gospel
stanzas: My Savior, for his great love,
From heaven, he came here to die,
To safely take whoever trusts in him
And always go with Him to live.

hymns.title: The Redeemer
stanzas: I know that the Redeemer lives,
I know there is life in your favor.
He died here on the cross:
Reigns in glory there in Heaven.
Lives to intercede
And in the fights I will be worth it,
Live to support me,
And protect me from evil.
God free me from fear,
Easing my pain.
Sadness tears me apart,
Give me joy, life and peace.
Live! Hosannas I give you!
Live! reign! and saved I am!
I live in him, the Redeemer,
Always firm in your love!

hymns.title: Read the Bible
stanzas: If you want to know
The message of the Lord,
Your soul will enrich
In Truth and Love,
If you aim to achieve
The promises of Jesus
And you want to walk
Under the protection of the Cross,
If you really want to go
Dwell with the Lord,
Together with him, enjoy
Of the richest and fullest love.
chorus: Read the Bible! - Your fervor
It comes to feed!
Your redeemed life
In the Lord he will exult.
Read the Bible - Your fervor
It comes to feed!
Your redeemed life
In the Lord he will exult.

hymns.title: The Word of Life
stanzas: Christ, oh! heavenly life,
Manifest your power!
Enlivens the breathless,
Make the dead come back to life!
Eternal life - eternal life
Come grant everyone!
Come grant everyone!
Open to us your holy Book!
Shine the light of heaven on us!
Clear up all the mistakes
And free your own from mistakes!
Light up! - illuminates
Our souls, King of heaven!
Our souls, King of heaven!
When reading this Bible
Give us joy, oh! Sir!
Having, by your teaching,
Communion in holy love,
Let us rejoice - let us rejoice
Singing your praise!
Singing your praise!
By studying the Word
We learned oh! Jesus!
- God grants the beautiful fruits That your instruction produces.
We enjoy - we enjoy
Joy, life and light!
Joy, life and light! Amen.

hymns.title: Give me the Bible
stanzas: Give me the Bible, which I long for:
I always want to walk your path.
For your words are the grateful new
That Jesus Christ came to announce.
Give me the Bible: I need it,
For he will free me from sin
And your words are so powerful,
That my soul can renew.
Give me the Bible! May my guide be!
And in this life my path is light!
And your teachings - the right script -,
May they lead me to the good Jesus.
chorus: Give me the Bible, such a precious book!
Holy Doctrine: source is light.
And his teachings, like a glorious beacon,
They lead us to the Lord Jesus.

hymns.title: Holy Bible
stanzas: Holy Bible,
You are the Word of God:
You are the map of the journey
Of those who go to Heaven.
You are the letter sent,
What Atalaia has in his hand:
You are the sails on the raft
Of those who bring salvation.
Holy Bible,
You are the book of brilliance,
You are the rejected jewel
By the vituperator.
You are the book for the path,
Against the horror of corruption.
You are the book that sends us
Talk about this salvation.
Holy Bible,
You are the light of my Brazil,
You are the spear and the sword
Of these manly people.
You are from the fingers, the brilliant one,
You are from the garden, the beautiful flower,
You are the most radiant light
Which shows us the Savior.
chorus: book of love,
Book that gives us pleasure
In Salvador,
In the Spirit and in knowledge.
Blessed book!
Only in you can he dwell
The Word of love,
That from the lips of the Lord
He came out to talk to you.

hymns.title: I have peace in my being
stanzas: I have peace in my being, perfect peace,
That the world cannot give me.
And in the fatal test or in the mortal struggle
I have peace to comfort me.
When I came to Jesus, I found full light,
My soul was filled with peace.
Every night passed: a new day dawned,
Because Christ Jesus saved me.
This unparalleled peace, which frees me from evil,
Sublime, peerless, eternal,
I don't want to leave her: she will help me,
Until you reach the heavenly mansion.
chorus: In my being dwells Christ, the Lord.
Deep love dwells in my being!
Yes, he does not forsake me: He is faithful:
You will be with me, my Savior.

hymns.title: What a Blessing!
stanzas: What a blessing: the moon shining in space!
What a blessing: the waves that roll in the sea!
What a blessing: the flowers blooming in the fields!
But the greatest blessing I will tell you:
What a blessing: the birds that sing and enchant!
What a blessing: children simply playing!
What a blessing: flocks grazing among the rivers!
But the greatest blessing I will tell you:
What a blessing: friends who seek me!
What a blessing: the Fatherland, which I can love!
What a blessing: family, health, abundance!
But the greatest blessing I will tell you:
chorus: Jesus saved me from my sins,
What a blessing, Jesus! what a blessing, my God!
Jesus saved me from my sins,
What a blessing, Jesus! what a blessing, my God!

hymns.title: Author of Life
stanzas: Author of life. Christ, God!
Life flows as you want.
Forgiveness for you comes to us from the heavens
And you give us real pleasure,
Doing it in our hearts
Shine the light of salvation.
You gave us eternal life -
Once dead to God -
You made your voice heard
- The voice that vivifies yours.
To give you real praise,
We are together, oh! Sir!

hymns.title: Always Happy
stanzas: Happy, I'm happy, happy, oh! always very happy!
For Christ came and saved me, my heart washed.
Happy, I am happy, oh! always very happy!
Happy, I'm happy, happy, oh! always very happy!

hymns.title: Count your blessings
stanzas: If in life the turbulent waves are,
If, with dismay, you think everything is vain,
Count the many blessings, say them all at once,
And you will see, surprised, how much God has already done!
Do you have any regrets? Sad is your deal?
And the heavy cross, what do you have to carry?
Count the many blessings, you will not doubt,
And in joyful song you will pass the days.
When you see others with their gold and goods,
Remember what promised treasures you have!
The goods of the earth will never be able to buy
The celestial mansion you will inhabit.
Whether the conflict is weak or strong here,
Do not be discouraged: God will be for you,
His divine help, alleviating evil,
It will give you comfort and final reward.
chorus: Count your blessings! tell me how many there are,
Received from the divine hand!
Come and say them all at once,
And you will see, surprised, how much God has already done!

hymns.title: You Are Mine
stanzas: Jesus, I know you are mine,
The Gift that God, the Father, gave me.
Your majestic deeds are
The joy of my heart.
Everything you have is for me.
My pleasure is in you.
You took my place here,
For me to be in the holy home.
For me you are in heaven. Jesus.
May I show your light here!
Always reveal your love!
Until you come, my Lord!

hymns.title: Perfect Peace, Yes, I Seek
stanzas: Perfect peace, yes, I sought,
And I never found her,
Because I didn't want to pay the price.
Far from God to wander,
His promise to reject.
From sin not wanting to separate me.
I was in prayer,
God touched my heart
And he said to me: “Put your life on the altar
For me to sanctify!”
The sin then I left:
I soon dedicated my life to God.
With your blood you bought me,
My being purified.
- A life of -victory I found.
“I have forgiven your sins
For how much I loved you”
The Great King spoke to me tenderly.
chorus: But now I'm living for Jesus,
I want to hide next to your Cross.
Even though suffering pain,
I want to be with my Jesus:
I finally found life in my Lord.

hymns.title: I'm happy
stanzas: I am happy, happy, happy in my life!
I am happy, because I have a great Savior.
Ever since you saved me with your power,
I live happily, very happy in your love.

hymns.title: Meek and Gentle
stanzas: Meek and gentle, it is Christ calling:
Call for you and me.
Behold, He waits at the doors, watching:
Watch over you and me,
With patience He is waiting,
Today, for you and for me.
Oh! do not despise anyone who, inviting,
Call for you and me.
The days pass, the hours pass,
They pass by you and me.
Death trances finally arrive,
So much for you and me.
Oh! how much love Jesus has given us!
All for you and me!
His blood was shed on the Cross,
Yes, it was for you and me.
chorus: Come now! come now! tired soul, come now!
Meek and gentle, Jesus inviting,
Call: - “Come, sinner, come!”

hymns.title: I died on the cross for You
stanzas: “I died on the cross for you:
I died to free you!
My blood, there, I spilled,
And I can save you.”
“I lived like this for you,
In pain, in discomfort,
And I did everything here
To be your Savior.”
"I suffered on the cross for you, -
In order to save you.
I got life,
That you will enjoy.”
I brought salvation,
From the highest heavens praise.
My forgiveness is certain,
My love is great!”
chorus: “I died! I died on the cross for you:
- What do you do for me?
Died! I died on the cross for you:
- What do you do for me?”

hymns.title: The Last Hour
stanzas: - At the end of the labor of this life
When death arrives at your side,
What fate will your soul have?
What will be your home in the future?
You seek peace in this world,
In pleasures that pass in vain.
But, in the last hour of life,
They will no longer satisfy you.
- Did you laugh, my friend?
When did you hear about Jesus?
But only Jesus can give you
Salvation through death on the cross.
You have stained your soul and you cannot
Contemplate the countenance of God:
Only believers with clean hearts
They will be able to have joy in heaven.
If you decide to leave your sins,
And give your life to Jesus,
Yes, you will tread in the last hour
A shining path of light.
chorus: My friend, today you have the choice:
- Life or death - which will you accept?
Tomorrow may be too late:
Today Christ wants to set you free.

hymns.title: Surrender the Heart
stanzas: Yield your heart now to Jesus,
Well, it's waiting for you, with love.
Whoever surrenders to Christ enjoys peace and light;
Oh! Come to the Savior!

hymns.title: The Sou Door
stanzas: 'I am the door'. says the Lord,
Someone coming in for me, for me,
Saved will be, saved will be; will be saved

hymns.title: The Grace of Our Lord
stanzas: The grace of our Lord,
And the love of God,
And the communion of the Holy Spirit,
Be with us. Amen, Amen.

hymns.title: O Kind Father
stanzas: O kind Father, come and guide us!
In the new year, come and protect us!

hymns.title: I hope in You
stanzas: I only hope in you,
Lamb, who for me,
You went to the cross.
Hear my prayer.
Give me your hand,
Fill my heart
With holy light!
Give me consolation,
Guard my heart!
Your great love,
Your crimson blood,
You gave yourself to the cross for me.
May I live for you,
With great ardor!
I will follow the trail,
And I will have proof.
Be my guide.
From evil come to deliver me:
Pure conservation!
I will sing forever
Your praise.

hymns.title: Just as I am
stanzas: Just as I am: without saying anything,
But for me you died.
And you invited me to turn to you:
Blessed Jesus, I come to you!
Just as I am: without further delay,
My evil soul wanting to cleanse,
To you, who can wash me from everything:
Blessed Jesus, I come to you!
Just as I am: in great distress.
So worthy of death and perdition,
Praying to you for life, with peace and forgiveness:
Blessed Jesus, I come to you!
Just as I am: your great love
Overcome me: and believing in you, without fear,
I want to serve you, divine Lord!
- Blessed Jesus, I come to you!

hymns.title: In Fervent Prayer
stanzas: In fervent prayer, come your heart
In the presence of God pour out!
But you can only enjoy what you are asking for,
When you leave everything on the Altar.
The Lord will do wonders of love for you.
Responding to the prayer you accept.
His immense power will come to your aid,
When you leave everything on the Altar.
If you pray, however, without your heart
Have the peace that the Lord can give,
It was because God didn't feel that your soul opened,
Everything, everything, leaving it on the Altar.
chorus: When everything is before the Lord,
And your whole being He will control,
Only then will you see that the Lord has power,
When you leave everything on the Altar.

hymns.title: Calm down!
stanzas: — Oh Master! The sea revolts:
The waves scare us:
The sky is covered with darkness:
We don't have a Savior!
Don't you care if we die?
You can sleep like this.
If every moment we see each other,
Yes, about to submerge?
— Master, in my sadness
I'm almost succumbing:
The pain that disturbs my soul,
Oh! I beg you, come banish!
Of waves of evil that cover me,
Who will make me leave?
I perish without you, oh! my Master!
Come quickly, come and help me!
— Master, the calm has arrived,
In peace behold the sky and the sea!
My heart enjoys calm
That cannot end.
Stay with me, oh! my Master,
Owner of Earth and Sky,
And so I will arrive safely
To the port, my destination.
chorus: — “The waves obey my command:
Calm down!
Be the rough sea
The wrath of men, the evil genius:
Such waters cannot be swallowed by the ship,
Who carries the Lord, King of Heaven and sea,
For everyone hears my command:
Calm down! — calm down!
I am with you to save you:
Yes, calm down!”

hymns.title: Why do you worry?
stanzas: Oh! Why do you grieve, poor heart?
Because your Jesus wants to give consolation.
Are the loads too much? Is pain cruel?
Look at the sky and see your home of love.
Does your vile sin weigh on your conscience?
Look at the cross, Jesus is so kind!
His precious blood He has already shed
To give forgiveness and open the way to heaven.
When claws of fear squeeze you,
When in distress, trust in the Lord.
He protects you, sad heart!
He leads you to heaven with his hand!

hymns.title: Psalm 121
stanzas: I lift my eyes to the high mountains:
Where will my help come from?
My help comes from the eternal God
Who made the earth, made the sky and the sea.
He protects you if your foot falters:
Your guard will never slumber.
It's your shadow: not even the moon at night
Not even the sun during the day will bother you.
He is the one who drives away all evils,
For your soul She will guard.
