Guard the exit, guard your entrance,
Yes, from now on, forever, amen.

hymns.title: Strong Castle
stanzas: Strong castle is our God,
Support and strength:
With your power you defend your own
In struggle and weakness.
Satan tempts us,
With stubborn fury,
With tricks like
And such cruel cunning,
There are no equals on Earth.
Our strength does nothing:
Yes, we are lost.
But our God brings help
And we are protected.
Defend us Jesus,
What won on the cross
The Lord of the high heavens.
And being also God,
Triumph in battle.
If they wanted to devour us
Demons untold,
They couldn't scare us,
Nor are we defeated.
The great accuser
Of the servants of the Lord
Already condemned is:
Vanquished will fall
For one word.
May God win the fight,
We know for sure,
And nothing will scare us
With Christ for defense.
If we have to lose
Family, goods, power,
And although life goes,
Jesus is for us,
And he will give us his kingdom

hymns.title: The Boat of Life
stanzas: I have to walk this world
Like a boat sailing on the sea,
But I know the deep secret
To never sink in it:
The light that directs me to Heaven,
The Holy Word of God,
Correct deviations and faults,
Showing the way to heaven.
The stormy sea of life
Roaring, seeks to lose me,
But always by Christ maintained,
My soul will have peace.
So I fear no danger:
I will not sink in this sea.
If Christ Jesus goes with me,
In heaven, yes, I will enter.
chorus: Christ is the Pilot to guide me,
From life to boat, until you reach Heaven.

hymns.title: Be You My Guide
stanzas: Be thou my Guide, O Christ: I am afraid
Of walking alone through solitude!
Be thou my Guide, and the dreadful wilderness
It will no longer be a place of darkness!
Be you my Guide, take me by your side,
Well, I want to be with you, Lord!
For by your arm, being thus established,
I will not stumble or be afraid.
Be you my Guide, in radiant time,
Or in good times, or even in storms!
Be you my Guide, may I proceed forward,
Without straying from the divine path!
Be you my Guide, until I have entry
in the paternal home, in Heaven beyond;
There, finally. my soul at rest
You will have your eternal good with you.

hymns.title: The Pilot
stanzas: Guide, Christ, my ship
Over the turbulent sea,
So enraged and evil,
He wants to make her sink.
Come Jesus, oh! come guide,
My ship comes to pilot!
How do you know how to calm down
Good mother, your son.
Come, calm the sea
That rises to the sky.
Come Jesus, oh! come guide,
My ship comes to pilot!
If, at the port when you enter,
But the sea rages,
May I delight
Hearing Jesus say:
"Come in, poor traveler,
In the rest of the Lord.”

hymns.title: Jesus Satisfies Me
stanzas: Jesus satisfies me.
And I enjoy your peace;
I go with Him,
I'm happy:
- Jesus satisfies me.

hymns.title: Enjoyment and Life I Have
stanzas: I have joy and life in my heart,
Since Jesus Christ gave me his forgiveness.

hymns.title: In this Wood I Glory
stanzas: In this wood I glory,
Source of radiance;
The torture shines intensely
Of the divine Redeemer.
When we have charity,
Meekness, perfect love,
An intense light
Show the world your brilliance.
What supreme pain and anguish
Endured the Savior!
Yes, for such a terrible death
He redeemed us with love.

hymns.title: I'm very happy
stanzas: I was a sinner, perverse and evil,
Far from You I wandered!
But, I am very happy today,
Jesus, my God and King.
I heard your voice
Calling me: "Oh, come!
Come, my son! I will give you
My forgiveness! Yes, come!”
Right at your feet, humble, I came,
And I prostrated myself, Lord!
Oh! I'm happy, because I felt
Your benign love!

hymns.title: Quadruple Amen
stanzas: Amen, Amen, Amen, Amen!

hymns.title: Contentment
stanzas: I'm already happy: I have Jesus!
With joy I go: I have Jesus!
The joy that the world brings is soon undone:
I have perfect peace, peace in Jesus.
I can grow old, never Jesus!
I can become poor, never Jesus!
Everything will provide for me, it will always be worth me,
I will lack nothing, having Jesus.
Everything will end here, except Jesus!
When the Judge arrives: it’s my Jesus!
I will be very grateful when my King comes down.
Sure He will say, “I am your Jesus!”

hymns.title: Pure, Yes, More Pure
stanzas: Pure, yes, purer I want my mind to be!
I enjoy, yes, more joy I can know!
Oh! Blessed Jesus, hear this prayer,
Because my heart belongs to you.
Calm, yes, I always want to be calmer.
Firm, yes, firmer may I always walk!
Never let this heart weaken me,
For in Christ I have all perfection.
High, yes, higher than the stars I go.
Closer, yes, closer to Jesus I am.
Christ is my model, I will always follow him:
Everything I long for I will find in it.

hymns.title: The Place of Blessing and Peace
stanzas: I am in the place where there is blessing and peace,
Where I feel Jesus with me.
To the humble his blood assures forgiveness:
His Spirit fills them with light.
What a joy to be where there is blessing and peace!
What an unparalleled wealth of love:
The tired receive nourishment and vigor:
For the sad there is real consolation!
How tender to be where there is blessing and peace,
And forgiveness of ineffable value!
But only the faithful can count
This grace of the good Savior.
There is unparalleled praise where there is blessing and peace!
And behold, the angels wish to sing
With men, in chorus, the blessed mercy
Of Jesus, who came to save us!
chorus: I am in the place where there is blessing and peace,
Where Christ shows us affection.
Rest! rejoice!! confess it!
- Publicize that there is salvation in him.

hymns.title: I'm safe
stanzas: Oh! Jesus, my Savior,
I am safe in your love,
And because of you I am winner,
Well, you're with me!

hymns.title: Persistent Faith
stanzas: I long for the faith that is strong
In the face of terror,
That, calmly, will not retreat
From the terrifying world.
The faith that doesn't make me complain
In the pain of correction,
But the more the fire burns,
Firmer the heart.
The faith that always shines brighter
In the black hurricane,
Who feels peace in danger,
Bold in the dark.
O God, give me such faith,
Whatever comes!
So in the fight I will prove
Heavenly pleasure.

hymns.title: Only to You!
stanzas: Who do I have, O God, in heaven there
But to you - only to you!
And no one else loves it here
Besides you, only you!
The Rock of this heart
It is you, Lord, and my lot.
With your gaze you will guide me
And you will receive me in glory.

hymns.title: Gratitude
stanzas: I thank you, Jesus, my Lord,
Your blessings flow.
I am overwhelmed by your great love
Manifested on the cross!
I am beside the riches of the heavens,
Flowing from your hands.
I want to sing a thousand songs!
- Deep offering from my heart! ;
Your goodness is sublime and real,
Forever for me.
Now accept my loyal vote
By your endless grace!
You provide us from the abundance of the heavens,
With your divine hands.
That's why I sing a thousand songs,
That flow from inside my heart!
You are very loving, Christ Jesus,
Since the Calvary of pain.
Where the source of Light opened
That heals the sufferer.
Out of gratitude, I always want to sing
Praises of salvation,
I want to sing a thousand songs
With immense joy in my heart!
chorus: Let us therefore praise our King Jesus,
Who for love died on the hard cross!
Only He gives us peace,
His grace satisfies:
Let us therefore praise our King Jesus!

hymns.title: Grace Dou
stanzas: I give thanks for this life: for the good it revealed.
I am grateful for the future, and for everything that has happened.
For the blessings poured out, for the pain, for the affliction,
By revealed grace! - I thank you for your forgiveness.
Thanks to the sky blue and clouds that are there too,
For the roses along the way, for the thorns they have,
Through the darkness of the night, through the star that shone,
For the answered prayer, for the dream that failed.
Through the cross and suffering and through every trial,
For the love that is without measure, for the peace in the heart,
For the tears shed, for the relief that is unparalleled.
For the gift of eternal life, I will always give thanks!

hymns.title: Heaven's Riches
stanzas: Oh! seek, not riches
From this world of uncertainty!
Those in Heaven have no sadness:
Oh! seek them, yes, seek them!
Oh! seek. not the crazy things
That only bring bitterness.
But the eternal bliss:
Oh! look for them, yes. seek!
Oh! seek Jesus first,
To the real, faithful Lamb!
In Him there is true joy:
Oh! seek him, yes, seek him!
Yes, seek blessed Jesus,
Your love is infinite,
Ineffable, unheard of:
Oh! seek him, yes, seek him!
Oh! seek holiness,
Purity, charity!
With fear, with humility,
Oh! look for them! yes, seek!
Of Jesus imitators,
Be good workers!
And seek out the sinners:
Oh! seek them, yes, seek them!
With love, to invite you.
Go look for them now,
For Jesus sends to call them:
Oh! seek them, yes, seek them!

hymns.title: Heir of the Kingdom
stanzas: O you, heir of the heavenly kingdom,
No, don't sleep, the end will come;
Oh! gird up your weapons and join the fight,
For victory you wish to win.
Don't let earthly pleasures hold you back,
Well, they will have to pass quickly;
Oh! Let go of the life that holds you back,
Come, come to Christ who will save you!
Here are the powers ready to fight;
Be fervent, faithful, a good Christian;
Glories shine on the horizon
Oh! noble heir, burst into song!

hymns.title: Get to Work
stanzas: Get to work, believers,
Dawn is already passing.
Come on, while we have
Our life in bloom!
Come on, while it's daylight,
Hard to work:
Hey, when the night comes,
No more dealing!
Get to work, believers,
Walk, while there is light:
Hey, now is the time
To serve Jesus!
Go the vigor of life
Everyone welcome to vote.
Hey, when the night comes,
No more dealing!
Get to work, believers,
The end comes soon.
Stand firm while death
Don't blow the bugle!
Let's go, brothers, to work,
For Christ works:
Hey, when the night comes,
Let's rest!

hymns.title: The Harvest is Ripe
stanzas: The harvest is ripe;
There's work to do.
Hear the voice of God calling
To bring you to the harvest!
Blessed is the servant
Who lived working.
To the faithful the Father declares:
"In my joy you will enter."
chorus: From your labor the fruit increases,
When you always pray.
You will have just reward,
If you go to work.

hymns.title: Together We Work
stanzas: Together we work for our King;
We will show you the fruits when you return here.
Bad men we seek for your flock,
Because our King also wants to save them.
Even in our home our surroundings,
Let's work for the Savior...
Our reward will be greater,
Being faithful to him and his supreme love.
We have the message to proclaim.
These are dangerous times;
Christ will soon return, we have to place;
Always forward, like this - Never go back!

hymns.title: God's Method
stanzas: It's good to talk to someone
Of Christ, of Christ,
It's good to talk to someone
Of Christ.
Go today and bring someone
To Christ, to Christ,
Yes, go and bring someone
To Christ.
Go pray for someone today
To Christ. to Christ.
Yes, go pray for someone
To Christ.
Someone like this you will save
For Christ, for Christ.
And you will have great joy
In Christ.

hymns.title: Lord, Your Messengers
stanzas: Lord, your messengers
They will take it wherever you go
The light of grace to the evil world,
And faith in the Savior.
Lord, send good workers,
Of faith, courage, zeal and love;
Faithful to You and your duty,
Loyal to the Redeemer.
Lord, may we all
Here I speak of your forgiveness;
To whom evil is captive,
Until Jesus returns.

hymns.title: I want to serve you
stanzas: I want, Jesus, to do what you want;
I want to serve you, yes.
Thy word always obey,
For you have loved me.
On this journey I will always trust
In your great love.
I will always carry your message
To those who suffer pain.
One day, here, the fights will end;
I will be with you.
I will go joyfully to happy Zion,
With your holy flock.
chorus: I want to serve you
Oh! my Savior
I want to serve you,
For you are my Shepherd.

hymns.title: Triumph
stanzas: I will triumph through the blood of Jesus;
Yes, I will triumph through your cross.

hymns.title: Light after Dark
stanzas: Light after darkness, glory after light,
Gain after loss, throne after cross,
Peace after struggle, fruit after flower,
Laughter after crying, joy after pain.
Believer after wicked, righteous after defendant,
Grace after wrath, seen after veil,
Sun after rain, honey after salt,
Home after deal, good after bad.
Near after far, Christ after me,
Life after tomb, land after Heaven,
Glory, peace, life, faith, throne and light
All this I have, believing in Jesus.

hymns.title: If on Your Path
stanzas: If on your way here
Darkness and shadows come,
And if no glow smiles,
Bringing light from the vast beyond,
You will have the light of Heaven.
If you live here
Persecution brought pain,
Bring suffering to you,
Oh, yes then, in your favor
You will come peace from Heaven.
But oh! if yours suffer
And the atrocious fight ends here,
And peace, finally, you can have.
How calm and good, how sweet to you
They will be home to Heaven.

hymns.title: Victory God Will Give Me
stanzas: Victory God will give me, I know,
Victory God will give me, I know.
If I walk in full light,
Trust only in Jesus,
Victory God will give me, I know.

hymns.title: Faith Is Victory
stanzas: Faith is victory,
Yes, faith always has power.
Faith is victory:
The world will win.

hymns.title: Christ, Commander
stanzas: Always forward! sends the General;
Always forward! war against evil!
Firm, strong, never waver!
For his faithful will win.

hymns.title: O Eternal Father
stanzas: O eternal Father who dwells in Heaven,
We, your children, came to ask you
May your blessed hands support us.
In our struggles today and in the future.
Do not impute to us our vile sins.
Yours, let us be, always more and more;
For, confident, we are strong
In your paternal divine arms.
O Father, transform our nature,
Come and teach us how to do good.
In our mind it gives us more purity,
More holiness, for Jesus. Amen.

hymns.title: Final Victory
stanzas: When you reach the end of the journey,
The fight is over and I go to Heaven;
Sweet it will be. yes, enjoy the rest
And the welcome of Christ, Lord.

hymns.title: Happy Land
stanzas: I see a happy land,
Where will I forever live:
There are mansions in this beautiful country,
That Jesus was there to prepare me.
I'm going to live! - I'm going to live
In this heavenly land to come!
I'm going to live! - I'm going to live!
In this heavenly land to come!
I will sing in this beautiful country
Beautiful hymns to my Savior.
Because there I will live very happily,
No anguish, sadness, or pain.
I will sing! - I will sing
In this heavenly land to come!
I will sing! I will sing
In this heavenly land to come!
I will leave this world after all,
To go to Jesus and worship.
In this beautiful royal city,
I will be in endless adventures.
I will be! - I will be
In this heavenly land to come!
I will be! - I will be
In this heavenly land to come!

hymns.title: I'm Going to My Home
stanzas: I'm heading towards my home, my heavenly home;
I'm heading towards my home and towards Christ;
There, no more grief, sadness or pain;
I'm heading towards my home and towards Christ.

hymns.title: How much I crave!
stanzas: How much I long for, heavenly home,
Thy glory see!
White, evergreen robes,
From God to receive!
How much I long for with the choirs
My voice raise!
With my Master walk,
It will be my pleasure!
How much I long for your return,
See it come into light,
To soon enjoy
Peace with Jesus!

hymns.title: How much I yearn
stanzas: How much I long to contemplate Christ;
How much I long for your divine face to see!
'I'm tired of walking like a sad pilgrim here;
How much I yearn for Christ.

hymns.title: It's Our Home
stanzas: It is our home in heaven, where no evil enters,
Dwelling, next to the holy God, in divine glory.
hand of the loving Father leads us home:
Blessed home that has always been God's place.
The blood of Jesus has already assured us of this;
His death on the cross confirmed the title.
And the good Comforter, pledge of redemption.
Take us to heaven with love, peace and satisfaction.
A unique comforter here will be for us,
Until we hear the tender voice in this home of Christ.
Eternally, then, rejoicing in the Lord,
At home we will, in song, sound his praise.

hymns.title: My Home, Jerusalem
stanzas: Happy Jerusalem, my home!
I long to be in you!
Feel the calm in glory there,
And enjoy your pleasure.
Oh! happy home of love and peace!
Garden like no other!
Your shine of glory and light,
He never saw him mortal.
Jesus will soon return,
And the peace of home beyond
He will then reign in you,
My home - Jerusalem

hymns.title: On the Journey to Jerusalem
stanzas: On the journey to Heaven,
I always meditate.
I'm very happy, I'm singing
And heading to my home.
I'm very happy, I'm singing
And heading to my home.
Walking with Jesus,
My pleasure always increased:
The love of the cross revealed to me,
That my crimes forgave
The love of the cross revealed to me,
That my crimes forgave.
A flash of light from Heaven
My soul lit up
Then I saw the eternal abyss
From which God has already saved me.
Then I saw the eternal abyss
From which God has already saved me.
On this glorious path,
Help me my King:
I have peace, and I am very happy,
And I will have more peace in Heaven.
I have peace, and I am very happy.
And I will have more peace in Heaven.
chorus: I know that victory is certain,
That Jesus assured me:
I will reach Glory (bis)
That the mortal has not yet seen.

hymns.title: Together, in Heaven
stanzas: We will live together in Heaven;
Happy we will be.
Happy there in Heaven,
We will live together in Heaven:
Jesus and me!

hymns.title: I am so grateful to remember
stanzas: So grateful it is for me to remember
That every day I am
Closer to the heavenly home,
Where am I going to live?
I'll be leaving soon
To where there is no pain.
Delights in heaven I will enjoy
In that home of love.
The Master, how loyal
I will always be here!
Because I want to be with the saved a thousand
With you being there.
chorus: Closer and closer to home,
Close to my eternal home,
Where will I live?

hymns.title: Oh, Yes, I Know
stanzas: Oh, yes, well I know that the Redeemer
In the high heavens it is;
That I will see you when I return,
And life will give me.
In the full light of my eyes
I will see the Savior;
In the flesh, yes, I will see God,
In the peace of the sky of love.
Oh, yes, I know, I'm sure
Who lives beyond, my King;
And for your eternal love,
With Him I will live.

hymns.title: I long for a place of love
stanzas: I long for peace, a place of love!
I miss this happy home;
Rise in robes of brilliance
To the everlasting, good parents.
Vile sins will never come
Penetrating the portals of light;
It will be in the center of the country
The eternal throne of Jesus.
There you can enjoy endless peace,
Living there are my dreams;
And the sweet rapture it brings me,
Real it becomes, God willing!

hymns.title: Unspeakable Glory
stanzas: I have read of the beautiful city
Located in the Kingdom of God,
Railing of shining jasper,
And strewn with golden trophies.
Right in the middle of the square is the river
Of eternal life and vigor;
But half the heavenly glory
The mortal was never told.
I have read of the beautiful palaces,
That Jesus went to Heaven to prepare,
Where the faithful saints, forever,
Very happy they will dwell;
Neither sadness, nor pain, nor old age
We will see in the paternal home;
But half the heavenly glory
The mortal was never told.
I have read of the shining garments,
Of the crowns that believers will have,
When the Father calls them proclaiming:
- “Receive eternal reward!”
I have read that the saints in glory
There is joy and everlasting pleasure.
But half the heavenly glory
The mortal was never told.
I have read the blessed story
Of Jesus, the faithful Redeemer,
Who suffered for us on Calvary
And receives the vilest sinner.
I have read of the blood spilled
Who redeems everyone from evil;
But half the heavenly glory
The mortal was never told.
chorus: The mortal was never told!
The mortal was never told!
Half the heavenly glory
The mortal was never told!

hymns.title: Triple Amen
stanzas: Amen, Amen, Amen!

hymns.title: My Prison Ends
stanzas: There, I will see my Savior,
Choirs of angels I want to hear;
I will also sing together
That my Jesus wanted to redeem me.

hymns.title: Beyond the blue sky
stanzas: Beyond the blue sky,
Jesus prepared
A home to give to anyone
Victory to achieve.
Because of Him I got it
The life of the future,
With faith in my Lord Jesus.
I know well that I of myself
I have nothing to give
But I know that my Jesus
He's already come to save me.
Through Him I am free,
Following Him I go,
Until your face sees beyond.

hymns.title: We'll talk there in heaven
stanzas: We will talk there in Heaven,
We will talk: Jesus and me.
He will tell me why I suffer.
That day I will understand.

hymns.title: There Is No Separation in Glory
stanzas: There is no separation in glory;
At dawn, in the heights.
There is no separation in glory,
When we are there in Heaven!

hymns.title: In This Place
stanzas: Behold planted on this day,
Which unique seed,
This stone - what a joy
Make the people here sing!
So many lives so empty
Or full of affliction,
In this temple, new days
In the Lord they will enjoy!
How many young people without a future
They will arrive at this House
-And the black wall was undone
Peace and love will breathe!
Sighing mothers and wives
Crying out, here they will come;
Soon after. victorious,
Glory and glory to the King will give!
Many broken beings,
In this House of Prayer,
By the Spirit visited,
“Hallelujah!” they will exclaim.
chorus: Hear, oh! Earth and everyone,
Praise, gratitude
To Jesus and the Father alone
For the souls to come!

hymns.title: Another Temple
stanzas: Today, it opens here, holy God,
Another pattern of your love:
A new temple, fanal to the heavens,
Cause for more praise!
House of worship and light source,
Where, Lord, do you give salvation
Through the Gospel that brought Jesus,
With so much compassion!
Sublime milestone of the proclamation
Of your love - of your want:
The sinners here will hear
What is your duty.
Let this house be a place of prayer,
Your home, oh! God!
And the gate of Heaven, a place of forgiveness,
Life of peace in the heavens!
chorus: Glory to God! - glory to God
Let your children sing!
Glory to God! - glory to God!
Glory in the high heavens!

hymns.title: My Brazil
stanzas: My Brazil, a giant and very sublime nation,
I hope to see you very soon, much bigger,
Fighting inequity, vice, crime,
Redeemed at the feet of Christ the Savior.
To defeat the darkness my soul longs for
From your midst, where the Gospel preaches peace.
Spreading holy books by the handful,
Victory, my Brazil, you will achieve.
I do not ask you, my Lord, for power, wealth,
Nor the glories that the vile world offers:
So I can see it shining with beauty,
In the crown of Jesus - my Brazil.
chorus: My Brazil! - my Brazil!
Open your broad chest and let the light shine!
My Brazil! - my Brazil!
The Gospel of Jesus wants to save you!

hymns.title: Prayer for the Homeland
stanzas: My Homeland for Christ!
- Here's my petition.
- My beloved homeland,
I gave you my heart.
Dear home, beautiful home,
My love is for you.
May my God of excellent grace
Dispense your favor!
I want, therefore, with joy,
Seeing the gentle mother happy,
For overcoming the Gospel
In this land of Brazil.
Brave Brazilian people.
Far go servile fear;
Or keep the country safe,
Or die for Brazil.
chorus: God save my country,
My manly homeland!
God save my land,
This land of Brazil!

hymns.title: Behold Brazil in Your Hands
stanzas: O our King and Redeemer,
Come answer our prayers;
Be the supreme Protector,
Here is Brazil in your hand.
Gives understanding and thousand blessings
To those who lead the nation;
Put more feverish zeal in them
By your Law and righteousness.
Father, when Jesus finally returns,
Come to give us reward,
With the redeemed there in the light,
Give Brazil salvation.

hymns.title: For our country we pray
stanzas: For our homeland we pray
To you, supreme God!
For our home we cry
To you, O King of heaven!
Bless the pastoral life,
Rules the lordly pride,
Moderate commercial activity!
- God save the Fatherland!
From the Fatherland, which you gave us,
Turn away your hand
Misfortunes, famine and pestilence,
Perfidy and sedition!
Sustains national order,
Good impartial government,
And give us divine grace!
- God save the Fatherland!
Give us real civility,
Faithful, constant, bold!
Promotes Christianity
From the Prince of Peace!
From the Homeland, remove vain beliefs,
Pour early blessings!
Just dominate. sound doctrines!
- God save the Fatherland!
Your Church ignites
With zeal and tender love,
And be your program
Fulfilled with vigor!
So, those saved by Jesus,
Fighting firmly for the Cross,
They will spread the light of Christ
All over the country! Amen.

hymns.title: Anthem to the National Flag
stanzas: Hail beautiful tassel of hope!
Hail, august symbol of peace!
Your noble presence to remember
The greatness of the Fatherland brings us.
In your beautiful breast you portray
This purest blue sky,
The unrivaled greenery of these forests,
And the splendor of Cruzeiro do Sul.
Contemplating your sacred figure,
We understand our duty,
And Brazil. for your beloved children,
Powerful and happy you will be.
About the immense Brazilian nation,
In moments of celebration or pain,
Always hover, sacred flag,
Pavilion of justice and love!
chorus: Receive the affection that closes
In our youthful chest,
Dear symbol of the earth,
From the beloved land of Brazil!

hymns.title: Brazilian National Anthem
stanzas: They heard from Ipiranga the placid banks
From a heroic people the resounding cry,
And the sun of freedom, in shining rays,
It shone in the sky of the Fatherland at that moment.
If the pledge of this equality
We managed to conquer with a strong arm,
In your bosom, O freedom,
Challenge our chest to death itself!
O beloved, idolized homeland, hail! save!
Brazil, an intense dream, a vivid ray
Of love and hope descends to earth,
If in your beautiful sky, laughing and clear,
Cruzeiro's image shines.
Giant by nature itself,
You are beautiful, you are strong, fearless, colossus,
And your future reflects this greatness.
Lying eternally in a splendid cradle,
To the sound of the sea and the light of the deep sky,
Glory, oh Brazil, flower of America,
Illuminated by the sun of the New World!
Than the brightest land
Your smiling, beautiful fields have more flowers,
“Our forests have more life,
Our life”, in your breast, “more loves”.
O beloved, idolized homeland, hail! save!
Brazil, of eternal love be a symbol
The labarum that you display with stars,
And say the blond green of this pennant:
“Peace in the future and glory in the past.”
But if you lift the strong club from justice,
You will see that a son of yours does not run away from the fight,
Nor do those who adore you fear death itself.
chorus: Adored land, among a thousand others are you, Brazil,
O beloved homeland!
Of the children of this soil you are a gentle mother,
Beloved homeland, Brazil!

hymns.title: Independence Anthem
stanzas: You can now give birth to your homeland, children
Seeing the gentle mother happy,
Freedom has dawned
On the horizon of Brazil!
Freedom has dawned
Freedom has dawned
On the horizon of Brazil.
It barely sounded in the mountains in the distance
Our manly cry;
On the immense shoulders, then,
Head up Brazil!
On the immense shoulders, then,
On the immense shoulders, then,
Brazil's head rises.
The shackles that forged us
Of perfidy cunning ruse
There was a more powerful hand
Brazil mocked them.
There was a more powerful hand
There was a more powerful hand
Brazil mocked them!
Congratulations, Brazilians
Already with youthful grace
Of the Universe among the nations
Brazil shines.
Of the Universe among the nations
Of the Universe among the nations
Brazil shines.
chorus: Brave Brazilian people
Gone are servile fears
Or keep the country free
Or die for Brazil
Or keep the country free
Or die for Brazil

hymns.title: Anthem of the Proclamation of the Republic of Brazil
stanzas: Be an unfolded canopy of light
Under the wide expanse of these skies
This rebel song, that the past
Come and redeem the most vile things!
Be a hymn of glory that speaks
With hopes of a new future!
With visions of triumphs pack
Whoever fights for him emerges!
We don't even believe that slaves once
Have there been in such noble countries...
Today, the red flash of Aurora
Think brothers, not hostile tyrants.
We are all the same! To the future
We will know, together, to take
Our august banner that, pure,
Shine, ovante, of the Fatherland on the altar!
If it is necessary that from close range brave
Let there be blood on our banner,
Living blood of the hero Tiradentes
Named this bold pavilion!
Messengers of peace, we want peace,
And from love our strength and power,
But from war in trances we rise
You will see us fight and win!
From Ipiranga it is necessary that the cry
Be a superb cry of faith!
Brazil has already emerged free,
Standing on the royal purples!
So, Brazilians, go ahead!
Green blonds let us reap the praises!
Let our country be triumphant,
Free land of free brothers!
chorus: Freedom! Freedom!
Spread your wings over us!
From the fights in the storm
Let us hear your voice!
